主体世界建模：基础、能力、法则及其他Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond

Meng Chu1†, Xuan Billy Zhang2† {}^{2\dagger\text{\faIconFromMacro{faCube}}}, Kevin Qinghong Lin3†, Lingdong Kong2†,
Jize Zhang3†, Teng Tu2†, Weijian Ma2†, Ziqi Huang4, Senqiao Yang5, Wei Huang6,
Yeying Jin2, Zhefan Rao1, Jinhui Ye1, Xinyu Lin2, Xichen Zhang1, Qisheng Hu4,
Shuai Yang6, Leyang Shen2, Wei Chow2, Yifei Dong7, Fengyi Wu7, Quanyu Long4,
Bin Xia5 Shaozuo Yu5, Mingkang Zhu5, Wenhu Zhang1, Jiehui Huang1,
Haokun Gui1, Haoxuan Che1§, Long Chen1§, Qifeng Chen1§, Wenxuan Zhang9§,
Wenya Wang4§, Xiaojuan Qi6§, Yang Deng10§, Yanwei Li5§, Mike Zheng Shou2§,
Zhi-Qi Cheng7§, See-Kiong Ng2§, Ziwei Liu4§, Philip Torr3§, Jiaya Jia1§
†Core Contributor.    Project Lead.  §Senior Author.

摘要Abstract

随着人工智能系统从生成文本转向通过持续交互实现目标，对环境动态进行建模的能力成为一个中心瓶颈。操纵对象、导航软件、与他人协调或设计实验的代理需要预测环境模型，但术语As AI systems move from generating text to accomplishing goals through sustained interaction, the ability to model environment dynamics becomes a central bottleneck. Agents that manipulate objects, navigate software, coordinate with others, or design experiments require predictive environment models, yet the term世界模型world model在不同的研究团体中具有不同的含义。我们引入了“级别carries different meanings across research communities. We introduce a “levels×\times法律”分类法沿着两个轴组织。第一个定义了三个能力级别：laws” taxonomy organized along two axes. The first defines three capability levels:L1 预测器L1 Predictor，学习一步局部转移算子；, which learns one-step local transition operators;L2模拟器L2 Simulator，将它们组成尊重领域法则的多步骤、以动作为条件的部署；和, which composes them into multi-step, action-conditioned rollouts that respect domain laws; andL3进化者L3 Evolver，当新证据的预测失败时，它会自动修改自己的模型。第二个确定了四种管辖法律制度（物理、数字、社会和科学），它们决定了世界模型必须满足哪些约束以及最有可能失败的地方。使用这个框架，我们综合了 400 多个作品，总结了 100 多个代表性系统，涵盖基于模型的强化学习、视频生成、Web 和 GUI 代理、多代理社会模拟和人工智能驱动的科学发现。我们分析跨级别-制度对的方法、故障模式和评估实践，提出以决策为中心的评估原则和最小的可重复评估包，并概述架构指南、开放问题和治理挑战。由此产生的路线图连接了以前孤立的社区，并绘制了从被动的下一步预测到可以模拟并最终重塑代理运行环境的世界模型的路径。, which autonomously revises its own model when predictions fail against new evidence. The second identifies four governing-law regimes (physical, digital, social, and scientific) that determine what constraints a world model must satisfy and where it is most likely to fail. Using this framework, we synthesize over 400 works and summarize more than 100 representative systems spanning model-based reinforcement learning, video generation, web and GUI agents, multi-agent social simulation, and AI-driven scientific discovery. We analyze methods, failure modes, and evaluation practices across level–regime pairs, propose decision-centric evaluation principles and a minimal reproducible evaluation package, and outline architectural guidance, open problems, and governance challenges. The resulting roadmap connects previously isolated communities and charts a path from passive next-step prediction toward world models that can simulate, and ultimately reshape, the environments in which agents operate.

1 简介Introduction

人们可能会说，世界永恒的奥秘在于它的可理解性。One may say the eternal mystery of the world is its comprehensibility.

Einstein (1936)

建立现实的内部模型的野心有着悠久的思想历史，出现在心理模型的哲学描述中The ambition to build internal models of reality has a long intellectual history, appearing in philosophical accounts of mental models(Craik, 1943; Johnson-Laird, 1983)在现代机器学习中，作为学习的潜在动态，支持预测、控制、模拟和科学推理and in modern machine learning as learned latent dynamics that support prediction, control, simulation, and scientific reasoning(Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018; Hafner et al., 2020; Karniadakis et al., 2021)。这句话. The phrase世界模型world model现在在研究界广泛使用，但其精确的技术含义差异很大is now widely used across research communities, but its precise technical meaning varies considerably(Ding et al., 2025a; Zhu et al., 2024)。在强化学习中，智能体在行动之前学习过渡结构来想象未来. In reinforcement learning, agents learn transition structure to imagine futures before acting(Sutton, 1991; Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018; Hafner et al., 2020; Schrittwieser et al., 2020)。在计算机视觉中，. In computer vision,世界模特world models通常表示保持视觉动态和时间连贯性的视频或 3D 生成器often denote video or 3D generators that maintain visual dynamics and temporal coherence(Brooks et al., 2024; Bruce et al., 2024; Agarwal et al., 2025; Liang et al., 2026a; b; Bian et al., 2025; Kong et al., 2025)。在语言建模和代理系统中，该术语可以指用于规划、网络交互和社交环境的基于文本的模拟. In language modeling and agent systems, the term can refer to text-grounded simulation for planning, web interaction, and social environments(Wang et al., 2024d; Gu et al., 2025b; Park et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2026d; c)。在机器人技术中，学习动态有助于安全规划、数据高效的政策学习和模拟到真实的迁移. In robotics, learned dynamics serve safe planning, data-efficient policy learning, and sim-to-real transfer(Wu et al., 2023a; Yang et al., 2024b; Min et al., 2024)。对于科学而言，系统将代理模型与假设驱动的实验配对. For science, systems pair surrogate models with hypothesis-driven experimentation(Karniadakis et al., 2021; Lu et al., 2024a).

从互补的角度来看，世界模型和智能体是紧密耦合的。世界模型的核心是学习环境的状态转换动态：给定当前状态和动作，它预测产生的下一个状态。相反，代理根据任务目标及其当前观察结果选择操作。这两个组成部分是相互支持的。智能体依靠世界模型来预测候选行为的后果，从而实现前瞻规划和样本高效学习From a complementary perspective, world models and agents are closely coupled. At its core, a world model learns the state-transition dynamics of an environment: given a current state and an action, it predicts the resulting next state. An agent, conversely, selects actions given a task objective and its current observations. These two components are mutually supportive. Agents rely on world models to anticipate the consequences of candidate actions, enabling look-ahead planning and sample-efficient learning(Hafner et al., 2025; Schrittwieser et al., 2020; Dong et al., 2026; 2025)。相反，世界模型受益于智能体生成的经验，它提供了有针对性的、与任务相关的轨迹，从而提高了模型在状态空间决策关键区域的准确性. Conversely, world models benefit from agent-generated experience, which provides targeted, task-relevant trajectories that improve the model’s accuracy in decision-critical regions of the state space(Sutton, 1991)。这种紧密耦合激发了本次调查中采用的基于能力的观点：虽然世界模型有多种用途，但我们在操作上通过它们为下游代理提供的决策质量来定义它们的价值。. This close coupling motivates the capability-based perspective adopted in this survey: while world models serve many purposes, we operationally define their value by the quality of decisions they enable for downstream agents.

由于世界模型构成了一个基础组件，其价值超出了任何单一代理架构，因此它们日益增长的重要性使得概念清晰变得更加紧迫。然而，上述多样性也造成了概念碎片化：视觉研究人员可以通过生成的框架的视觉保真度来评估世界模型，而强化学习实践者则通过它是否提高任务绩效来判断同一个术语。因此，论文可能会在一种解释下报告强劲的进展Because world models constitute a foundational component whose value extends beyond any single agent architecture, their growing importance makes conceptual clarity all the more urgent. Yet the diversity outlined above also creates conceptual fragmentation: a vision researcher may evaluate a world model by the visual fidelity of its generated frames, while a reinforcement learning practitioner judges the same term by whether it improves task performance. As a result, papers may report strong progress under one interpretation of世界模型world model而在另一个人的统治下却保持着无可比拟的优势。本文通过提供一种通用语言来解决这种碎片化问题，该语言可以在不消除特定领域差异的情况下协调社区。while remaining incomparable under another. This paper addresses that fragmentation by providing a common language that can align communities without erasing domain-specific differences.

1.1 动机Motivation

  1. 1.

    当前的调查情况。Current survey landscape.最近的几项调查试图整理这些快速增长的文献。Several recent surveys have attempted to organize this rapidly growing literature.Ding et al. (2025a)提出双重分类法propose a dual taxonomy of理解understanding与versus预测predicting，将世界模型映射到自动驾驶、机器人和社交拟像等应用领域。, mapping world models onto application domains such as autonomous driving, robotics, and social simulacra.Zhu et al. (2024)专注于 Sora 催化的生成能力，调查视频生成、自动驾驶和自主代理的世界模型。focus on the generative capabilities catalyzed by Sora, surveying world models for video generation, autonomous driving, and autonomous agents.Yue et al. (2025)提供了 2D 视觉世界建模的路线图，其中包括应用于机器人、自动驾驶和游戏的四代能力分类法 (G1-G4)。他们的 G1-G4 分类法对于区分日益交互的视觉生成系统很有用；我们的 L1-L3 层次结构是互补的而不是竞争的，因为它从视觉模态中抽象出来，并询问系统是否支持跨物理、数字、社会和科学体系的本地预测、决策可用模拟或证据驱动的修订。粗略地说，早期的 G 级强调外观和动作条件预测，而我们的 L2/L3 边界是由约束有效推出和持久模型更新确定的。特定领域的调查也激增：provide a roadmap for 2D visual world modeling with a four-generation capability taxonomy (G1–G4) applied to robotics, autonomous driving, and gaming. Their G1–G4 taxonomy is useful for distinguishing increasingly interactive visual generation systems; our L1–L3 hierarchy is complementary rather than competing, because it abstracts away from the visual modality and asks whether a system supports local prediction, decision-usable simulation, or evidence-driven revision across physical, digital, social, and scientific regimes. Roughly, early G-levels emphasize appearance and action-conditioned prediction, whereas our L2/L3 boundary is determined by constraint-valid rollout and persistent model update. Domain-specific surveys have also proliferated:Li et al. (2025e)提供专门针对实体人工智能的三轴框架（功能、时间建模、空间表示）；provide a three-axis framework (functionality, temporal modeling, spatial representation) specifically for embodied AI;Feng et al. (2025c)和andTu et al. (2025)调查自动驾驶的世界模型；survey world models for autonomous driving;Kong et al. (2025)检查 3D 和 4D 世界建模；examine 3D and 4D world modeling;Zhang et al. (2025d)调查机器人操纵的世界模型；越来越多的立场文件质疑学习模型“理解”物理意味着什么survey world models for robotic manipulation; and a growing number of position papers question what it means for a learned model to “understand” physics(LeCun, 2022; Kang et al., 2025a)。在科学人工智能领域，. In AI for science,Wei et al. (2025b)调查生命科学、化学、材料和物理领域的自主科学发现，统一过程导向、自主导向和机制导向的观点。平行的一系列调查解决了代理的规划和推理问题：survey autonomous scientific discovery across life sciences, chemistry, materials, and physics, unifying process-oriented, autonomy-oriented, and mechanism-oriented perspectives. A parallel line of surveys addresses agent planning and reasoning:Wei et al. (2025a)调查法学硕士在计划生成和验证方面的规划能力，survey LLM planning capabilities across plan generation and verification,Huang et al. (2024c)将规划机制分类为分解、选择和反思，taxonomize planning mechanisms into decomposition, selection, and reflection,Cao et al. (2025a)提供微调与基于搜索的规划方法的系统比较，provide a systematic comparison of fine-tuning versus search-based planning methods,Zhao et al. (2025)将代理推理组织为单代理、基于工具和多代理框架，以及organize agentic reasoning into single-agent, tool-based, and multi-agent frameworks, andArunkumar et al. (2026)提出一个涵盖感知、规划、行动和协作的统一代理分类法。这些调查对我们的调查进行了补充：它们重点关注代理商如何propose a unified agent taxonomy spanning perception, planning, action, and collaboration. These surveys complement ours: they focus on how agents决定并采取行动decide and act，而我们关注的是使这些决策明智的预测基础（世界模型）。尽管它们做出了宝贵的贡献，但现有的调查有一个共同的组织原则，我们认为这一原则从根本上是有限的：它们通过以下方式划分领域：, whereas we focus on the predictive substrate (the world model) that makes those decisions informed. Despite their valuable contributions, existing surveys share a common organizational principle that we argue is fundamentally limiting: they partition the field by情态modality或通过or by应用领域application domain。我们的工作的不同之处在于，通过基于能力的分类法来组织该领域，该分类法跨越模式，涵盖从具体操纵和自动驾驶到网络代理、多代理协调和科学发现管道的决策领域。. Our work differs by organizing the field through a capability-based taxonomy that cuts across modalities, covering decision-making domains from embodied manipulation and autonomous driving to web agents, multi-agent coordination, and scientific discovery pipelines.

    现有调查的差距。Gaps in existing surveys.

    以模态为中心和以领域为中心的分类法留下了两个关键差距。首先，他们未能捕捉到The modality-centric and domain-centric taxonomies leave two critical gaps. First, they fail to capture the能力进步capability progression这跨越了各种模式。一个关键的例子是基于模型的强化学习，其中潜在空间“想象力”的推出可以匹配或超过跨不同领域（例如 Atari、连续控制和 Minecraft）的无模型基线that cuts across modalities. A key example is model-based reinforcement learning, where latent-space “imagination” rollouts can match or exceed model-free baselines across diverse domains such as Atari, continuous control, and Minecraft(Hafner et al., 2025; Schrittwieser et al., 2020; Hafner et al., 2020)。我们将这一进程形式化为三级能力层次结构：一步预测、长期模拟和证据驱动的模型修订。我们框架的第二个动机是关于大规模生成模型是否仅仅是合理的生成器还是真正的世界模拟器的激烈争论。现有的调查已经揭示了这种紧张局势. We formalize this progression as a three-level capability hierarchy: one-step prediction, long-horizon simulation, and evidence-driven model revision. A second motivation for our framework is the intensifying debate over whether large-scale generative models are merely plausible generators or genuine world simulators. Existing surveys have surfaced this tension(Brooks et al., 2024; Bruce et al., 2024; Kang et al., 2025a; Ding et al., 2025a)，但基于能力的分类法有助于在推出、干预敏感性和约束一致性方面更准确地陈述问题。我们确定了四种逐渐增强的能力，即推出、干预敏感性、约束一致性和闭环使用，它们表征了世界模型并超越了通用预测因子（在第 1 节中形式化）, but a capability-based taxonomy helps state the question more precisely in terms of rollout, intervention sensitivity, and constraint consistency. We identify four progressively stronger capabilities, namely rollout, intervention sensitivity, constraint consistency, and closed-loop use, that characterize world models and go beyond generic predictors (formalized in Section2）。此外，现有的调查低估了世界建模在代理人工智能应用中的作用，包括网络代理、工具使用代理和多代理系统，其中学习的环境动态对于规划和行动选择至关重要). Moreover, existing surveys underrepresent the role of world modeling in agentic AI applications, including web agents, tool-use agents, and multi-agent systems, where learned environment dynamics are essential for planning and action selection(Gu et al., 2025b; Wang et al., 2024d; Park et al., 2023)。本文的目标是建立一个具有清晰和可测试边界条件的基于能力的分类法，并用它来连接目前评估具有不同假设、目标和指标的世界建模系统的研究社区。. The goal of this paper is to establish a capability-based taxonomy with clear and testable boundary conditions, and to use it to connect research communities that currently evaluate world modeling systems with different assumptions, objectives, and metrics.

图Figure2这项调查相对于现有工作沿着两个轴定位：范围（特定领域到跨领域）和组织原则（以模式为中心到以能力为中心）。图positions this survey relative to existing work along two axes: scope (domain-specific to cross-domain) and organizing principle (modality-centric to capability-centric). 1.2 范围和组织原则Scope and Organizing Principle

跨领域的管理原则。Governing principles across domains.

我们沿着两个正交轴组织论文：（i）We organize the paper along two orthogonal axes: (i)能力水平capability level（L1/L2/L3，在第 1 节中正式定义(L1/L2/L3, defined formally in Section2）和（二）), and (ii)管辖法律制度governing-law regime，域中合法转移必须满足的约束。这些级别是世界建模能力的阶段，而不是相互排斥的模型类：同一系统可以根据任务需求在不同时刻调用不同的级别。图, the constraints that legitimate transitions must satisfy in a domain. These levels are stages of world-modeling capability rather than mutually exclusive model classes: the same system may invoke different levels at different moments depending on task demand. Figure3提供了这四种制度的示意性概述。provides a schematic overview of these four regimes.

  • •

    物质世界的法则Laws of the Physical World：感知；身体互动；机器人操纵、导航、自动驾驶、以自我为中心的视频预测、动作条件视频建模、3D 世界建模……: perception; physical interaction; robotic manipulation, navigation, autonomous driving, egocentric video prediction, action-conditioned video modeling, 3D world modeling..

  • •

    数字世界的法则Laws of the Digital World：程序语义；网络导航、软件工具使用、GUI 环境。: program semantics; web navigation, software tool use, GUI environments.

  • •

    社会世界的法则Laws of the Social World：信仰；目标；规范；社会协调、对话、多主体设置。: beliefs; goals; norms; social coordination, dialogue, multi-agent settings.

  • •

    科学世界的法则Laws of the Scientific World：潜在机制；实验观测值；因果结构；科学发现管道、测量耦合预测、假设驱动的实验。: latent mechanisms; experimental observables; causal structure; scientific discovery pipelines, measurement-coupled prediction, hypothesis-driven experimentation.

特别是，物理和科学体系因如何访问约束而分开：物理世界系统通常允许对转换进行分析或基于模拟器的验证，而科学世界系统通常需要经验验证，因为控制机制仅部分已知。In particular, the physical and scientific regimes are separated by how constraints are accessed: physical-world systems often admit analytic or simulator-based verification of transitions, whereas scientific-world systems typically require empirical validation because the governing mechanisms are only partially known.

制度不是“正交模式”：真实的系统将它们混合在一起。分类法的价值是诊断性的；它澄清了Regimes are not “orthogonal modalities”: real systems mix them. The value of the taxonomy is diagnostic; it clarifies其中which方法试图保留和的不变量invariants a method tries to preserve and哪个查询which queries它可以可靠地回答。it can answer reliably.

更一般地说，世界模型可以预测沿任何组织维度的转变，例如空间尺度、频带或因果深度，只要它保持沿该轴的能力标准。 在整个过程中，我们使用More generally, a world model can predict transitions along any organizing dimension, such as spatial scales, frequency bands, or causal depth, provided it maintains the capability criteria along that axis. Throughout, we use世界模型world model表示支持干预感知转换查询的学习（或混合）运算符，以及to denote learned (or hybrid) operators that support intervention-aware transition queries, and世界建模world modeling表示加强这些运营商的分阶段过程。to denote the staged process of strengthening those operators.

代理如何在运行时使用这三个级别。How an agent uses the three levels at runtime.

L1/L2/L3 分类法不是系统的静态分类，而是对代理在任何给定时刻调用的功能的描述。单个部署的系统可以根据任务需求在不同级别上运行：The L1/L2/L3 taxonomy is not a static classification of systems but a description of the capability an agent invokes at any given moment. A single deployed system can operate at different levels depending on the task demand:

  1. 1.

    L1（预测器）。L1 (Predictor).该代理执行快速、反应性的一步预测（例如感知、低级运动控制或逐个令牌生成），而无需维护多步计划。The agent executes fast, reactive one-step predictions (such as perception, low-level motor control, or token-by-token generation) without maintaining a multi-step plan.

  2. 2.

    L2（模拟器）。L2 (Simulator).当任务需要比较候选行动序列、对替代未来进行反事实推理或验证计划轨迹是否遵守管辖法律约束时，代理会升级到此级别；在这里，代理在提交之前推出了多步骤模拟。The agent upgrades to this level when the task requires comparing candidate action sequences, reasoning counterfactually about alternative futures, or verifying that a planned trajectory respects governing-law constraints; here the agent rolls out a multi-step simulation before committing.

  3. 3.

    L3（进化者）。L3 (Evolver).当当前模型产生系统性预测失败且无法通过在现有模型结构内重新规划来解决时，即当必须在下一次部署之前修改模型本身、提取资产并验证更新时，代理会升级到此级别。The agent escalates to this level when its current model produces systematic prediction failures that cannot be resolved by re-planning within the existing model structure, that is, when the model itself must be revised, assets distilled, and updates validated before the next deployment.

此运行时调度视图阐明了为什么 L3 不是 L1/L2 的替代品，而是一个在证据需要时改进堆栈的治理层。在完整的代理堆栈中，世界模型只是其中一个组成部分：工具的使用决定了代理如何对环境起作用，记忆决定了哪些证据在各个事件中持续存在，多代理协调塑造了社会环境中的有效过渡动态，而反思则决定了失败何时触发修正而不是仅仅重新规划。我们的重点是世界模型基底，但它的作用始终是为这些更广泛的代理循环服务。This runtime dispatch view clarifies why L3 is not a replacement for L1/L2 but a governance layer that improves the stack when evidence demands it. Within a full agentic stack, world models are only one component: tool use determines how the agent acts on the environment, memory determines what evidence persists across episodes, multi-agent coordination shapes the effective transition dynamics in social settings, and reflection determines when failures trigger revision rather than mere re-planning. Our focus is the world-model substrate, but its role is always in service of these broader agentic loops.

1.3 贡献与定位Contributions and Positioning

定位。Positioning.

我们将这篇论文作为We present this paper as a位置驱动的调查提出了世界建模的能力分类法position-driven survey proposing a capability taxonomy for world modeling。它提出了一个具体的概念框架，即 L1/L2/L3 能力层次结构与管辖法律制度分类法相结合，并主张在世界建模界采用它。与纯粹的调查不同，它提出可测试的边界条件，并使用它们重新检查现有系统的分类方式。与纯粹的立场文件不同，它通过涵盖计算机视觉、强化学习、机器人、自然语言处理和科学人工智能的全面文献综述来证实每个论点。本文并没有引入新的基准或排行榜；相反，它提供了一个统一的概念框架来解释和比较现有的系统和评估。. It advances a specific conceptual framework, namely the L1/L2/L3 capability hierarchy paired with a governing-law regime taxonomy, and argues for its adoption across the world modeling community. Unlike a pure survey, it proposes testable boundary conditions and uses them to re-examine how existing systems are classified. Unlike a pure position paper, it substantiates each argument with a comprehensive literature review spanning computer vision, reinforcement learning, robotics, natural language processing, and AI for science. This paper does not introduce a new benchmark or leaderboard; instead, it offers a unifying conceptual framework for interpreting and comparing existing systems and evaluations.

大纲。Outline.

部分Section2建立了概念和符号基础：它从认识论直觉中激发了三个能力阶段，为每个阶段提供了具有可测试边界条件的正式定义，并阐明了世界建模和通用预测、世界模型和规划者以及世界建模和常识之间的区别。 部分establishes the conceptual and notational foundations: it motivates the three capability stages from epistemological intuition, gives each a formal definition with testable boundary conditions, and clarifies the distinctions between world modeling and generic prediction, world models and planners, and world modeling and commonsense. Sections3–5通过代表性方法和跨领域分析详细介绍了三个能力级别。 部分present the three capability levels in detail with representative methods and cross-domain analysis. Section6讨论评估方法，部分discusses evaluation methodology, Section7解决架构和计算方面的考虑，以及节addresses architectural and computational considerations, and Section8识别新出现的趋势和未解决的问题。 部分identifies emerging trends and open problems. Section9结论是。 我们注意到 L3 并不是一个终点阶段；部分concludes. We note that L3 is not a terminal stage; Section8介绍introduces元世界建模meta-world modeling，其中管辖法律本身变得可以学习，并确定了由此带来的开放问题。, in which the governing laws themselves become learnable, and identifies the open problems this entails.

2 预赛Preliminaries

本节建立了整篇论文所使用的概念和符号基础。This section establishes the conceptual and notational foundations used throughout the paper.(1) 从认识论到能力层次(1) From epistemology to a capability hierarchy借鉴哲学传统，提出世界建模能力的三级分解（L1 预测器、L2 模拟器、L3 进化器），并解释为什么边界会落在它们所在的地方。draws on philosophical traditions to propose a three-level decomposition of world modeling capability (L1 Predictor, L2 Simulator, L3 Evolver) and to motivate why the boundaries fall where they do.(2) 符号和形式定义(2) Notation and formal definitions修复了统一的符号系统，并使用它为每个阶段（L1、L2、L3）提供具有可测试边界条件的精确定义。fixes a unified symbol system and uses it to give each stage (L1, L2, L3) a precise definition with testable boundary conditions.(3) 概念边界(3) Conceptual boundaries澄清了世界建模和通用预测之间、世界模型和规划者之间的区别，并将世界建模与更广泛的常识推理概念联系起来，常识推理保证了代理人必须在狭隘的预测任务之外表现出可靠的日常行动。clarifies the distinctions between world modeling and generic prediction, between world models and planners, and relates world modeling to the broader notion of commonsense reasoning that underwrites the reliable everyday action that agents must exhibit beyond narrow predictive tasks.

2.1 哲学动机Philosophical Motivations

对于任何世界建模调查来说，一个自然的问题是：A natural question for any world-modeling survey is:系统从模式匹配到真正的建模时会经历哪些理解阶段？what stages of understanding does a system pass through as it moves from pattern matching to genuine modeling?认识论是一门研究什么是知识以及知识如何增长的学科，它提供了一个有用的视角。 不同的哲学传统在性质上识别不同种类的认知成就；我们借鉴这些传统，为世界模型提出了一个三级能力层次结构。 这些哲学类比是启发式的，而不是历史的或一对一的。我们并不是说机器学习系统实现了哲学程序，但哲学上的区别可以帮助我们理解为什么某些能力边界会跨领域重复出现，以及每个阶段的前景是什么设计问题（图Epistemology, the study of what counts as knowledge and how knowledge grows, offers a useful lens. Different philosophical traditions identify qualitatively different kinds of epistemic achievement; we draw on these traditions to propose a three-level capability hierarchy for world models. These philosophical analogies are heuristic rather than historical or one-to-one. We do not claim that ML systems implement philosophical programmes, but that philosophical distinctions help us see why certain capability boundaries recur across domains and what design questions each stage foregrounds (Figure5）。 由于篇幅限制，详细的哲学动机和当代例子以及扩展的历史背景被推迟到附录). Due to space constraints, detailed philosophical motivations and contemporary examples, together with extended historical context, are deferred to AppendixA.

L1 预测器：从模式到一步预测。L1 Predictor: from pattern to one-step forecast.

最简单的认知成就是从数据中学习模式：根据过去的观察，预测下一个。 在哲学上，这就是休谟的领域The simplest epistemic achievement is learning patterns from data: given past observations, predict the next one. In philosophy, this is the terrain of Hume’s常连词constant conjunction (Hume, 1739);代理人记录统计上的共现，但没有证明它们成立的原因。 当模型从轨迹中学习一步潜在转换时，它恰好占据了这一认知位置：它从数据中提取连续性并押注该模式持续存在。 这种观点与认知科学中的预测编码框架相一致; an agent records statistical co-occurrences without certifying why they hold. When a model learns one-step latent transitions from trajectories, it occupies exactly this epistemic position: it extracts succession from data and bets that the pattern persists. This view aligns with predictive coding framework in cognitive science(Rao and Ballard, 1999; Friston, 2010)以及“贝叶斯大脑”假设，即感知是概率推理and the “Bayesian brain” hypothesis that perception is probabilistic inference(Clark, 2015)，激发单步潜在预测作为一种计算原语, motivating one-step latent forecasting as a computational primitive(Lake et al., 2017).

我们称这个阶段为We call this stageL1（预测器）L1 (Predictor)。 这种休谟主义立场具有内在的脆弱性。 i.i.d.大多数机器学习的假设实际上是休谟的假设. This Humean stance has inherent fragility. The i.i.d. assumption underlying most ML is effectively Hume’s均匀性原则Uniformity Principle（前提是未来与过去相似），因此当分布发生变化时，依赖学习规律的 L1 模型无法泛化。 尽管如此，这提供了最基本的归纳偏差，这是建模的基础。(the premise that the future will resemble the past), so when the distribution shifts, L1 models that rely on learned regularities fail to generalize. Nevertheless, this provides the most basic inductive bias, which is the foundation of modeling.

L2 模拟器：推出和反事实。L2 Simulator: rollout and counterfactual.

仅靠模式匹配并不能解决问题Pattern matching alone does not answer如果我们采取不同的行动会发生什么what would happen if we acted differently。 下一阶段增加了干预和反事实推理：能够在选定的行动或假设的初始条件下推出连贯的未来，并将结果用于决策。 大卫·刘易斯的理论. The next stage adds intervention and counterfactual reasoning: the ability to roll out coherent futures under chosen actions or hypothetical initial conditions and use the results for decision-making. David Lewis’s theory of最接近的可能世界closest possible worlds (Lewis, 1973)抓住了这一跳跃：有效的反事实推理探索了与我们自己的世界最相似的世界，在这个世界中，只有最小的干预才能区分实际结果和反事实结果，为推理智能体在决策点采取的替代行动下会发生什么提供了原则基础。captures this jump: effective counterfactual reasoning explores worlds maximally similar to our own, where only a minimal intervention distinguishes actual from counterfactual outcomes, providing a principled basis for reasoning about what would have happened under alternative actions taken by the agent at decision points.

我们称这个阶段为We call this stageL2（模拟器）L2 (Simulator)。 由于 L2 的推出与模型相关，因此它们的可靠性取决于学习模型自身的转换结构，而不是直接访问真实动态。 它们面临认知漂移的风险，这会为训练流形产生内部一致的轨迹。 柏拉图的洞穴寓言. Because L2 rollouts are model-relative, their reliability depends on the learned model’s own transition structure rather than on direct access to ground-truth dynamics. They risk epistemic drift, which produces internally coherent trajectories for the training manifold. Plato’s Allegory of the Cave(Plato, 1992)提供了一个生动的比喻：擅长预测墙上阴影的模拟器可能从根本上仍然受到墙壁尺寸的限制，无法访问投射这些阴影的火。offers a vivid metaphor: a simulator excelling at predicting shadows on a wall may remain fundamentally bounded by the wall’s dimensions, unable to access the fire casting those shadows.

L3 Evolver：根据证据进行模型修订。L3 Evolver: model revision from evidence.

即使是强大的模拟器最终也会遇到预测系统性失败的情况，不是因为参数错误，而是因为模型类本身太窄。 认识论为这一转变提供了丰富的词汇。 拉卡托斯区分Even a powerful simulator eventually encounters situations where its predictions systematically fail, not because of parameter error but because the model class itself is too narrow. Epistemology offers a rich vocabulary for this transition. Lakatos’s distinction between a硬核hard core（架构，归纳偏差）和(architecture, inductive biases) and a防护带protective belt（学习参数）(learned parameters)(Lakatos, 1978)提供了一个有用的相似之处。 梯度步骤主要调整皮带，而持久的结构化错误可能需要对核心进行更改，例如新模块、解析器、约束或模拟器挂钩。provides a useful parallel. Gradient steps mostly adjust the belt, while persistent structured errors may require changes to the core, such as new modules, parsers, constraints, or simulator hooks.

我们称这个阶段为We call this stageL3（进化者）L3 (Evolver)：当证据需要时重建实验室的能力。 这扩展了完整的设计-执行-观察-反思循环：系统不仅模拟，而且主动设计实验、执行实验、观察结果，并反思以修改其模型堆栈。 迪昂-蒯因整体论: the capacity to rebuild the laboratory when evidence demands it. This extends the full design–execute–observe–reflect loop: the system not only simulates but actively designs experiments, executes them, observes outcomes, and reflects to revise its model stack. Duhem–Quine holism(Duhem, 1954; Quine, 1951)解释了为什么责备分配是不平凡的。错误会在模块之间重新分布，直到诊断隔离出脆弱的组件。 拟议的修订应该对保留的探针、回归套件或实验结果产生可衡量的改进，而不是在环境中存在相反证据的情况下保留现有模型的事后调整。explains why blame-assignment is non-trivial. Errors redistribute across modules until diagnostics isolate the brittle component. Proposed revisions should yield measurable improvements on held-out probes, regression suites, or experimental outcomes, rather than post-hoc adjustments that preserve the existing model despite contrary evidence from the environment.

2.2 世界建模中的表示：科学理论的教训Representation in World Modeling: Lessons from Scientific Theories

部分中的能力层次结构The capability hierarchy in Section2.1地址addresses世界模型能做什么what a world model can do，但留下了一个先前的问题：, but leaves open a prior question:世界模型实际上应该以什么形式表示？in what form should the world model actually be represented?这个问题不应该仅仅被视为一个实现细节，但它决定了上面定义的功能，特别是 L3 修订版，是否可以在后面各节介绍的不同应用程序领域的实践中实现。This question should no just solely treated as an implementation detail, yet it determines whether the capabilities defined above, especially L3 revision, are realizable in practice across the diverse application domains covered in later sections.

从历史上看，机器智能的符号方法很难扩展（参见章节Historically, symbolic approaches to machine intelligence struggled to scale (see Section8.1），导致现代系统采用潜在的、隐式的表示。在这里，科学理论提供了明显的对比。牛顿定律、麦克斯韦方程组和标准模型是以紧凑形式表达的世界模型的实例), leading modern systems to adopt latent, implicit representations. Here scientific theories offer a telling contrast. Newton’s laws, Maxwell’s equations, and the Standard Model are instances of world models expressed in compact象征性的symbolic形式，并且可以说代表了 L3 系统最成功的人类实例：明确的、可修改的和可组合的。 这种对比引发了该领域很大程度上回避的一个问题：世界建模的终点是符号发现，以神经潜伏作为支架，还是潜伏动态本身就是目标？form, and arguably represent the most successful human instances of L3 systems: explicit, revisable, and composable. This contrast forces a question the field has largely avoided: is the endpoint of world modeling symbolic discovery, with neural latents as a scaffold, or are latent dynamics themselves the goal?

在科学发现中，模型更新出现在多个尺度上：小 异常会触发局部修改，而持续的差异 比如“两朵乌云”In scientific discovery, model updates arise at multiple scales: small anomalies trigger local modifications, while persistent discrepancies such as the “two dark clouds”(Kelvin, 1901)晚了 19 世纪的物理学暴露了认知差距，迫使人们对物理学进行修正。 理论的in late 19th-century physics expose epistemic gaps that force revisions to a theory’s不变性结构invariance structure。从牛顿学派到 例如，相对论力学用伽利略不变性取代 洛伦兹不变性。现代机器学习系统还对不变性进行编码，例如 卷积中的平移等方差和基于注意力的形状偏差 型号. The shift from Newtonian to relativistic mechanics, for instance, replaced Galilean invariance with Lorentz invariance. Modern ML systems also encode invariances, such as translation equivariance in convolutions and shape bias in attention-based models(Geirhos et al., 2018)，但这样做, but do so隐含地implicitly，通过 架构和培训，而不是明确可修改的 结构。这适合固定条件下的 L1 预测和 L2 模拟 模型，但在 L3（任务是修改模型结构 本身）它变成了一种责任。相比之下，符号表示 将治理原则公开为可以直接使用的一流对象 检查并修改。, through architecture and training, rather than as explicitly modifiable structures. This suits L1 prediction and L2 simulation under a fixed model, but at L3 (where the task is to revise the model structure itself) it becomes a liability. Symbolic representations, by contrast, expose governing principles as first-class objects that can be directly inspected and modified.

因此，我们将代表性视为一个基本问题 关于什么是世界模型We therefore take representation to be a foundational question about what a world modelis，不是可互换的选择 设计。潜在动力学作为 L1 和 L2 的支架是不可或缺的， 但L3的终点，即管辖法律的真正修订， 需要一个象征性的底物。在此观点下，L1, not a choice among interchangeable designs. Latent dynamics are indispensable as a scaffold for L1 and L2, but the endpoint of L3, namely genuine revision of governing laws, requires a symbolic substrate. On this view, L1→\rightarrowL2→\rightarrowL3 不仅是在推出深度上的进步，而且是在法律如何实施方面的进步 发现、撰写和修改。实际实例化或实现 制度在章节中进行了调查L3 is a progression not only in rollout depth, but in how laws are discovered, composed, and revised. Practical instantiations or implmentations across regimes are surveyed in Section7。 在下一节中. 2.4 能力的定义Definitions of Capabilities

随着章节中建立的符号系统With the symbol system established in Section2.3，我们现在为每个能力阶段提供了具有可测试边界条件的精确定义。, we now give each capability stage a precise definition with testable boundary conditions.

与 L1 的主要区别不是一步质量，而是The key difference from L1 is not one-step quality but构图下的推出保真度rollout fidelity under composition.

三个 L2 边界条件是互补的而不是冗余的。长期一致性涉及随着时间的推移，推出质量是否能经受住组合的考验；干预敏感性涉及行动或前提的变化是否会在预测的未来引起稳定且有方向性的有意义的变化；约束一致性涉及所得到的轨迹在目标政权的管辖法律下是否仍然有效。这些都不意味着其他一般情况：模型可能会生成连贯但对操作不敏感的推出，或者仍然违反域约束的操作敏感的推出。在实践中，它们也可以相互权衡，例如，当积极的约束执行以降低对干预的响应性为代价来稳定轨迹时。The three L2 boundary conditions are complementary rather than redundant. Long-horizon coherence concerns whether rollout quality survives composition over time; intervention sensitivity concerns whether changes in actions or premises induce stable and directionally meaningful changes in the predicted future; and constraint consistency concerns whether the resulting trajectories remain valid under the governing laws of the target regime. None of these implies the others in general: a model may generate coherent but action-insensitive rollouts, or action-sensitive rollouts that still violate domain constraints. In practice they can also trade off against one another, for example when aggressive constraint enforcement stabilizes trajectories at the cost of reduced responsiveness to interventions.

第四种能力，A fourth capability,闭环使用closed-loop use（通过与建模环境的交互支持规划、行动和自我改进），进一步将世界建模与通用预测分开，但与 L1/L2/L3 正交：天气模拟器可以是没有嵌入式规划器的 L2 世界模型（参见附录）(supporting planning, acting, and self-improvement through interaction with the modeled environment), further separates world modeling from generic prediction but is orthogonal to L1/L2/L3: a weather emulator can be an L2 world model with no embedded planner (see AppendixB以供扩展讨论）。 我们为两种不同的含义保留“闭环”，这两种含义不能混为一谈：在控制或规划循环内使用世界模型是一种正交部署属性，而根据部署证据修改世界模型堆栈本身是 L3 的定义标志。for extended discussion). We reserve “closed-loop” for two different senses that must not be conflated: using a world model inside a control or planning loop is an orthogonal deployment property, whereas revising the world-model stack itself from deployment evidence is the defining hallmark of L3.

The three levels form a containment hierarchy: L2 invokes L1 at each step, and L3 invokes L2 each time it probes the world for evidence before committing to a model update.

This triple, not a flat observation-to-action mapping, defines the interface between world model and planner. Building a usefulztz_{t}涉及构建部分的两个正交挑战involves two orthogonal challenges that structure Section3： (一): (i)空间表征spatial representation：压缩高维观察: compressing a high-dimensional observationoto_{t}形成一个紧凑的潜在模型，保留与决策相关的结构（几何、语义、可供性），并且 (二)into a compact latent that retains decision-relevant structure (geometry, semantics, affordances), and (ii)时间融合temporal fusion: 整合历史: integrating history(o≤t,a≤t−1)(o_{\leq t},a_{\leq t-1})这样so thatztz_{t}即使在部分可观察的环境中也近似马尔可夫信念。 动作不是平面变量：它们可以从表示学习中产生，而不是预先定义的，潜在表示捕获核心动态，而其他一切都充当解码器approximates a Markov belief even in partially observable settings. Actions are not flat variables: they can emerge from representation learning rather than being pre-defined, with the core dynamics captured by the latent representation and everything else serving as a decoder(LeCun, 2022)。 真实代理行为在时间尺度和抽象级别上分解，包括低级运动原语、中级技能和高级任务计划。世界模型必须以与规划器的查询范围相匹配的粒度来预测转换。该操作层次结构直接与 L1 交互. Real agent behavior decomposes across temporal scales and abstraction levels, including low-level motor primitives, mid-level skills, and high-level task plans. The world model must predict transitions at the granularity that matches the planner’s query horizon. This action hierarchy interacts directly with the L1→\toL2 边界：局部动力学足以进行原始级预测L2 boundary: local dynamics suffice for primitive-level prediction(Sun et al., 2025a)，但技能和任务级别的推出需要定义 L2 的多步骤一致性。 在 L3 级别，智能体不仅必须预测跨时间尺度的转换，还必须决定何时自己的转换模型不充分并启动模型修订。 L3 将世界建模堆栈本身视为操作对象。诊断探针、架构修改和回归测试成为对模型而不是环境本身进行操作的“元操作”，重塑系统的学习方式而不仅仅是其行为方式。, but skill- and task-level rollouts require the multi-step coherence that defines L2. At the L3 level, the agent must not only predict transitions across temporal scales but also decide when its own transition model is inadequate and initiate model revision. L3 treats the world-modeling stack itself as an object of action. Diagnostic probes, architecture modifications, and regression tests become “meta-actions” that operate on the model rather than on the environment itself, reshaping how the system learns rather than merely how it acts.

2.5 法律范围Scope of Laws

正如章节中介绍的As introduced in Section1.2，我们沿着两个正交轴组织调查：能力水平（L1/L2/L3）和管辖法律制度。本小节详细阐述了四种机制以及每种机制对学习到的转换函数施加的约束。 我们区分, we organize the survey along two orthogonal axes: capability level (L1/L2/L3) and governing-law regime. This subsection elaborates the four regimes and the constraints each imposes on the learned transition function. We distinguish物质世界的法则Laws of the Physical World（在物理环境中感知和行动的管理代理），(governing agents that perceive and act in physical environments),数字世界的法则Laws of the Digital World（控制确定性程序语义：代码、API 和状态机），(governing deterministic program semantics: code, APIs, and state machines),社会世界的法则Laws of the Social World（控制思想和机构的动态：信念、目标和规范）， 和(governing the dynamics of minds and institutions: beliefs, goals, and norms), and科学世界的法则Laws of the Scientific World（独立于人类设计而存在的管理系统，其动态必须通过经验观察来发现）。 这四种制度具有代表性，但并非详尽无遗。现实世界的系统通常同时在多种制度下运行。 例如，自动驾驶涉及物理动力学和社会规范，而药物设计则将自然机制与数字模拟管道结合起来。(governing systems that exist independently of human design, whose dynamics must be discovered from empirical observation). These four regimes are representative, not exhaustive. Real-world systems often operate under multiple regimes simultaneously. For example, autonomous driving involves both physical dynamics and social norms, while drug design couples natural mechanisms with digital simulation pipelines.

物质世界的法则Laws of the Physical World通过体现代理必须遵守的物理动力学来约束转换：接触力学、碰撞响应、重力加速度、摩擦力和运动学可行性。 在机器人操作、自动驾驶和交互式 3D 模拟中，学习的转变constrain transitions through the physical dynamics that embodied agents must respect: contact mechanics, collision response, gravitational acceleration, friction, and kinematic feasibility. In robotics manipulation, autonomous driving, and interactive 3D simulation, the learned transitionpθ​(zt∣zt−1,at)p_{\theta}(z_{t}\mid z_{t-1},a_{t})必须忠实地编码这些物理交互must encode these physical interactions faithfully(Todorov et al., 2012; Hu et al., 2023; Wang et al., 2024h)。 该状态的特点是可分析表征的控制方程。物理引擎或分析模型可以验证预测的转变是否与刚体约束和牛顿力学一致。 约束违规表现为对象相互穿过、重力在展开过程中反转或物理上不可能的变形。此类故障可以立即检测到，因为地面实况动力学允许封闭形式或数值精确的参考解。. This regime is distinguished by analytically characterizable governing equations. A physics engine or analytic model can verify whether a predicted transition is consistent with rigid-body constraints and Newtonian mechanics. Constraint violations appear as objects passing through each other, gravity reversing mid-rollout, or physically impossible deformations. Such failures are immediately detectable because the ground-truth dynamics admit closed-form or numerically exact reference solutions.

数字世界的法则Laws of the Digital World通过确定性程序语义（包括 API 契约、UI 状态机、文件系统逻辑和网络协议）来约束转换。 在 Web 导航、代码生成和软件测试中，转换函数constrain transitions through deterministic program semantics, including API contracts, UI state machines, file-system logic, and network protocols. In web navigation, code generation, and software testing, the transition functionpθ​(zt∣zt−1,at)p_{\theta}(z_{t}\mid z_{t-1},a_{t})很大程度上是is largely确定性的deterministic但通过错误代码、权限检查和边缘情况产生大量分支but branches heavily through error codes, permission checks, and edge cases(Gu et al., 2025b; Yao et al., 2022)。 这种制度是由过渡所定义的. This regime is defined by transitions that are both可指定的specifiable和and可验证的verifiable。可以执行该程序并将其输出与模型的预测进行比较。 约束违规表现为生成不存在的 API 调用、忽略返回的错误代码或违反类型约束。因为底层系统是一个正式的工件，所以这些错误是可以机械检查的。. The program can be executed and its output compared against the model’s prediction. Constraint violations appear as producing an API call that does not exist, ignoring returned error codes, or violating type constraints. Because the underlying system is a formal artifact, such errors are mechanically checkable.

社会世界的法则Laws of the Social World通过信仰、目标、规范、社会契约和制度规则来约束转变。 在社会模拟、对话系统和多主体交互中，constrain transitions through beliefs, goals, norms, social contracts, and institutional rules. In social simulation, dialogue systems, and multi-agent interaction,pθ​(zt∣zt−1,at)p_{\theta}(z_{t}\mid z_{t-1},a_{t})将联合行动和心理状态映射为新的心理状态和社会结果maps joint actions and mental states to new mental states and social outcomes(Park et al., 2023; Zhou et al., 2025b)。 有两个特性使这一制度与众不同。过渡是. Two properties set this regime apart. Transitions are反射性的reflexive，这意味着代理人对国家的信念会积极改变国家本身。他们也是, meaning that agents’ beliefs about the state actively change the state itself. They are also规范的normative，不仅取决于将要发生的事情，还取决于根据共同约定应该发生的事情。 违反约束表现为不承担任何后果地违背承诺、忘记事先的承诺或无视既定的社会规范。这种失败破坏了一致性，因为社会结果取决于相互的期望。, governed not only by what will happen but by what should happen according to shared conventions. Constraint violations appear as breaking a promise without consequence, forgetting a prior commitment, or ignoring established social norms. Such failures undermine coherence because social outcomes depend on mutual expectation.

科学世界的法则Laws of the Scientific World通过潜在的因果机制来限制转变，这些机制必须是constrain transitions through latent causal mechanisms that must be发现了discovered来自经验观察而不是指定from empirical observation rather than specified先验的a priori。 在天气预报、分子动力学、蛋白质折叠和药物设计中，. In weather prediction, molecular dynamics, protein folding, and drug design,pθ​(zt∣zt−1,at)p_{\theta}(z_{t}\mid z_{t-1},a_{t})编码大气动力学、化学动力学或生物过程，其确切功能形式未知或太复杂而无法分析编写encodes atmospheric dynamics, chemical kinetics, or biological processes whose exact functional forms are unknown or too complex to write analytically(Karniadakis et al., 2021; Lam et al., 2023; Abramson et al., 2024)。 这种制度的不同之处在于控制方程是. This regime differs in that the governing equations are不提供封闭形式not available in closed form。世界模型必须从数据中学习它们，并根据实验测量进行验证。 违反约束表现为预测物理上不可能的分子构型、违反经验上成立的守恒定律或忽略已知的因果依赖性。检测通常需要与实验室或观察数据进行比较，而不是符号验证。. The world model must learn them from data and be validated against experimental measurement. Constraint violations appear as predicting physically impossible molecular configurations, violating conservation laws that hold empirically, or ignoring known causal dependencies. Detection typically requires comparison with laboratory or observational data rather than symbolic verification.

3 L1 预测器：局部马尔可夫预测L1 Predictor: Local Markov Prediction

层次结构开始于The hierarchical structure begins withL1，它通过要求世界模型维持有意义的内部状态和使用来评估它的局部预测能力, which assesses a world model’s local predictive ability by requiring it to sustain a meaningful internal state and use本地的local预测下一个状态的机制，包括潜在的观察或行动。统一图形模型如图predictive mechanisms to anticipate the next state, including potential observations or actions. In the unified graphical model of Figure7,L1为单条边的范围, L1 is the scope of a single edgezt−1→ztz_{t-1}\to z_{t}以行动为条件conditioned on actionat−1a_{t-1};本节中的所有内容都详细阐述了填充这一一步转换的运算符，并研究了它们如何在当代世界模型系统中实现。; everything in this section elaborates the operators that populate this one-step transition and examines how they are realized in contemporary world-model systems.

3.1 定义Definition

L1 涉及世界模型对于在环境中行动以完成任务或目标的代理的局部预测能力。更准确地说，代理是一个系统，根据观察结果，做出决策并采取行动以满足目标。因此，在本文中，L1 世界模型的作用不仅仅是预测下一个信号，而是提供本地预测算子，以一步（或短固定范围）的粒度支持此类决策。这种认知立场与休谟的恒定连接一致：从观察到的数据中提取规律，而不声称因果必然性（第 1 节）L1 concerns the local predictive ability of a world model for an agent acting in an environment to accomplish a task or goal. More precisely, an agent is a system that, given observations, makes decisions and takes actions in order to satisfy an objective. In this paper, the role of an L1 world model is therefore not merely to predict the next signal, but to provide local predictive operators that support such decision-making at the granularity of one step (or a short fixed horizon). This epistemic stance aligns with Hume’s constant conjunction: regularities are extracted from observed data without claiming causal necessity (Section2.1).

L1 基础的 POMDP 公式源自强化学习文献，其中智能体必须在部分可观察性下选择行动，以最大化累积奖励The POMDP formulation that underlies L1 originates from the reinforcement learning literature, where an agent must select actions under partial observability to maximize cumulative reward(Kaelbling et al., 1998; Puterman, 1994)。在这种情况下，代理保持对隐藏状态的内部信念并制定策略. In this setting, the agent maintains an internal belief over hidden states and crafts a policyπ​(at∣bt)\pi(a_{t}\mid b_{t})将信念映射到行动。该公式构成了典型的主体-环境循环that maps beliefs to actions. This formulation constitutes the prototypical agent–environment loop(Sutton, 1991)。对于与环境交互以完成任务的代理，POMDP 分解为四个局部算子：状态推断、前向动力学、观察解码和逆向动力学。这些共同描述了 L1 级别的世界模型的基础学习问题。. For an agent that interacts with the environment to accomplish a task, the POMDP decomposes into four local operators: state inference, forward dynamics, observation decoding, and inverse dynamics. Together these describe the foundational learning problems for world models at the L1 level.

In practical terms,ztz_{t}从观察和行动中推导出来，并作为对潜在环境状态和/或信念的学习近似值is deduced from observations and actions and functions as a learned approximation to the latent environmental state and/or belief(Hafner et al., 2025; Schrittwieser et al., 2020)。学习这种潜在动态的概念可以追溯到用于控制的局部线性潜在模型. The concept of learning such latent dynamics can be traced back to locally linear latent models for control(Watter et al., 2015)和高斯过程动力学and Gaussian-process dynamics(Deisenroth and Rasmussen, 2011)，并通过当代深度学习架构得到增强, and has been enhanced by contemporary deep learning architectures(Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018; Hafner et al., 2020)。 “马尔可夫”一词. The term “Markov” inL1表示denotes the习得内部状态中的马尔可夫性质Markovian property in the learned internal state ztz_{t}，表明, indicating thatztz_{t}足以（或几乎足以）预测随后的局部步骤，而不是环境状态的直接可观测性is adequate (or nearly adequate) for predicting the subsequent local step, rather than the direct observability of the environmental state(Hafner et al., 2019; 2025; Gelada et al., 2019).

We devote the most space to forward dynamics because it is the operator that most directly determines whether an L1 system can later be elevated into an L2 simulator; the other components are still essential, but their role is primarily to make the latent state usable for that transition.

3.2.1 状态推断State Inference

状态推断将高维观察结果压缩为紧凑的潜在表示State inference condenses high-dimensional observations into a compact latent representationztz_{t}它保留了关键的决策信息，并整合了时间背景以确保that preserves crucial decision-making information, and it integrates temporal context to ensure thatztz_{t}近似于部分可观察场景的马尔可夫信念approximates a Markovian belief in partially observable scenarios(Lesort et al., 2018).

对比预测编码（CPC；Contrastive Predictive Coding (CPC;Oord et al. 2018）训练编码器通过 InfoNCE 损失最大化当前和未来嵌入之间的互信息，该损失将时间上相邻的正对与从同一批次中提取的负对进行对比。模拟CLR) trains an encoder to maximize mutual information between present and future embeddings via the InfoNCE loss, which contrasts temporally adjacent positive pairs against negatives drawn from the same batch. SimCLR(Chen et al., 2020)和莫科and MoCo(He et al., 2020)分别通过基于增强的正对和动量更新编码器建立了通用对比框架，为下游世界模型提供了预训练的视觉主干。然而，一般的视觉表示并不能保证established general-purpose contrastive frameworks through augmentation-based positive pairs and momentum-updated encoders, respectively, providing pretrained visual backbones that downstream world models build upon. However, general visual representations do not guarantee thatztz_{t}保留与控制相关的信息。卷曲preserves control-relevant information. CURL(Laskin et al., 2020)通过将对比学习扩展到 RL，以连续帧之间的时间邻接作为正对，实现了与 Atari 和连续控制中基于模型的方法相当的样本效率，从而解决了这个问题。自我预测表示（SPR；addressed this by extending contrastive learning to RL with temporal adjacency between consecutive frames as positive pairs, achieving sample efficiency comparable to model-based methods in Atari and continuous control. Self-Predictive Representations (SPR;Schwarzer et al. 2021）训练编码器来预测自己的未来表示，结合时间结构和决策相关的动态。两种方法在 Atari 100k 上都显示出强大的样本效率，证实世界模型表示受益于针对决策目标的定制。) trains an encoder to forecast its own future representations, incorporating temporal structure and decision-relevant dynamics. Both methods show strong sample efficiency on Atari 100k, confirming that world model representations benefit from being tailored to decision-making objectives.

另一类方法不是对比对，而是预测屏蔽区域直接嵌入到潜在空间中。 JEPA 及其变体，I-JEPARather than contrasting pairs, another family of methods predicts the embedding of masked regions directly in latent space. JEPA and its variants, I-JEPA(Assran et al., 2023)和V-JEPAand V-JEPA(Bardes et al., 2024)，预测隐藏区域嵌入，无需解码回像素, forecast hidden-region embeddings without decoding back to pixels(LeCun, 2022)。这种方法鼓励编码器掌握语义和结构的一致性，而不受像素级复杂重建的束缚。另一方面，DINOv2. This approach encourages the encoder to grasp semantic and structural consistencies without being bound to intricate reconstruction at the pixel level. On another front, DINOv2(Oquab et al., 2024)从基础模型域通过自蒸馏生成多功能的视觉特征，为后续任务建立强大的状态编码器。互补的方向使得推断的状态明确以对象为中心和程序化，而不是纯粹连续的。 Thinking with Blueprints 将图像转换为 JSON 样式的蓝图，记录与问题相关的对象的位置、大小和属性，然后对该结构化表示进行推理以回答空间查询from the foundation-model domain generates versatile visual features through self-distillation, establishing robust state encoders for subsequent tasks. A complementary direction makes the inferred state explicitly object-centric and programmatic rather than purely continuous. Thinking with Blueprints converts an image into a JSON-style blueprint that records the positions, sizes, and attributes of question-relevant objects, and then reasons over this structured representation to answer spatial queries(Ma et al., 2026)。虽然提出的是 VLM 空间推理而不是顺序控制，但它与 L1 状态推理高度相关，因为它表明有用的内部状态可以采取面向决策的场景描述的形式，而不仅仅是密集的潜在嵌入。. Although proposed for VLM spatial reasoning rather than sequential control, it is highly relevant to L1 state inference because it shows that useful internal state can take the form of a decision-oriented scene description, not only a dense latent embedding.

当单个观察值不够时，模型必须将过去的信息聚合成When a single observation is insufficient, the model must aggregate past information intoztz_{t}。循环状态空间模型 (RSSM). The Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) ofHafner et al. (2019)将潜在的分裂成确定性的循环路径splits the latent into a deterministic recurrent pathwayht=f​(ht−1,zt−1,at−1)h_{t}=f(h_{t-1},z_{t-1},a_{t-1})和一个随机分量and a stochastic componentzt∼qϕ​(zt∣ht,ot)z_{t}\sim q_{\phi}(z_{t}\mid h_{t},o_{t})，压缩任意长度的历史，同时保留随机不确定性。这种反复出现的信念状态, compressing arbitrary-length histories while preserving stochastic uncertainty. This recurrent belief state(ht,zt)(h_{t},z_{t})作为 Dreamer 系列中所有下游预测和控制的内部状态serves as the internal state for all downstream prediction and control in the Dreamer family(Hafner et al., 2020; 2021; 2025).

科学应用说明了当原始观察结果是高维的并且具有科学意义的状态是潜在的时，相同的状态推断原理是如何运作的。在结构生物学中，蛋白质结构预测可以被视为 L1 状态推断：将氨基酸序列（观察）映射到主要 3D 坐标状态。 AlphaFold 谱系是从学习到的基于距离的电位发展而来的Scientific applications illustrate how the same state-inference principle operates when raw observations are high-dimensional and the scientifically meaningful state is latent. In structural biology, protein structure prediction can be cast as L1 state inference: mapping an amino acid sequence (observation) to a dominant 3D coordinate state. The AlphaFold lineage progressed from learned distance-based potentials(Senior et al., 2020)具有接近实验精度的端到端 Evoformer 架构to end-to-end Evoformer architectures with near-experimental accuracy(Jumper et al., 2021)基于扩散的联合生物分子复杂结构预测to diffusion-based prediction of joint biomolecular complex structures(Abramson et al., 2024)。并行工作表明，通过三轨网络也可以实现强大的结构预测. Parallel efforts showed that strong structure prediction is also achievable through three-track networks(Baek et al., 2021)和蛋白质语言模型支持单序列推理and protein language models enabling single-sequence inference(Lin et al., 2023)。 在神经科学领域，HMM. In neuroscience, HMM(Baker et al., 2014),循环神经网络, RNN(Gohil et al., 2022)和变压器and Transformer(Khan et al., 2023)用于将电生理记录映射到一组潜在网络模式，遵循概念上类似于are used to map electrophysiological recordings to a set of latent network modes, following a state-inference paradigm conceptually similar toHa and Schmidhuber (2018)。 对学习到的可解释的潜在表征的分析揭示了各种发现：休息时的皮质活动可以通过短暂的、间歇性重复的事件来描述. Analysis of the learned interpretable latent representations reveals various findings: cortical activity at rest can be described by transient, intermittently recurring events(Vidaurre et al., 2018)组织成 300–1,000 ms 时间尺度的周期organized into cycles on 300–1,000 ms timescales(van Es et al., 2025).

3.2.2 Forward Dynamics：核心 L1 操作员Forward Dynamics: The Core L1 Operator

这些方法直接建立These approaches directly establishpθ​(zt∣zt−1,at)p_{\theta}(z_{t}\mid z_{t-1},a_{t})并形成and form the核心coreL1 的。动态网络的精度对于产生有价值的单步预测至关重要，并且必须具有足够的表达能力，以便能够在多个步骤中进行聚合，这一关键要求在 L2 中更为严格of L1. The precision of the dynamics network is crucial for producing valuable one-step forecasts and must be expressive enough to be aggregated over numerous steps, a critical requirement that is more stringent at L2(Moerland et al., 2023).

在基于模型的强化学习（RL）中，动作条件潜在转换模型起着关键作用。皮尔科In model-based Reinforcement Learning (RL), the action-conditioned latent transition model plays a pivotal role. PILCO(Deisenroth and Rasmussen, 2011)采用高斯过程动力学与分析不确定性传播相结合，以实现有效的连续控制。穆泽罗employed Gaussian-process dynamics coupled with analytical uncertainty propagation for efficient continuous control. MuZero(Schrittwieser et al., 2020)采用确定性动力学函数adopts a deterministic dynamics functionzt=fθ​(zt−1,at)z_{t}=f_{\theta}(z_{t-1},a_{t})进行端到端训练以进行值预测和蒙特卡罗树搜索，无需观察重建。高效零trained end-to-end for value prediction and Monte Carlo Tree Search without observation reconstruction. EfficientZero(Ye et al., 2021)通过结合自我监督的一致性损失，进一步增强了这种方法，仅用两个小时的体验就在 Atari 游戏中实现了超人的性能。相反，Dreamer 中的循环状态空间模型 (RSSM)further enhanced this approach by incorporating self-supervised consistency losses, achieving superhuman performance in Atari games with just two hours of experience. Conversely, the Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) in Dreamer(Hafner et al., 2020; 2021; 2025)利用随机动态来促进不确定性意识的推出。宠物leverages stochastic dynamics to facilitate uncertainty-aware rollouts. PETS(Chua et al., 2018)说明了一个illustrated that an合奏团ensemble动力学模型提供了可靠的认知不确定性估计，这对于稳健的规划至关重要。 TD-MPCof dynamics models offers reliable epistemic uncertainty estimation crucial for robust planning. TD-MPC(Hansen et al., 2022)通过时间差异目标学习潜在动态，直接将动态模型与价值估计对齐； TD-MPC2learns latent dynamics through temporal difference objectives, directly aligning the dynamics model with value estimation; TD-MPC2(Hansen et al., 2024)扩展到一个拥有 3.17 亿个参数的代理，能够熟练掌握跨不同领域的 104 项任务。scales up to a single 317 million-parameter agent proficient in mastering 104 tasks across various domains.

最近的趋势是从连续潜在动态转变为离散令牌或基于扩散的转变。例如，艾瑞斯A recent trend is the shift from continuous latent dynamics to discrete-token or diffusion-based transitions. For instance, IRIS(Micheli et al., 2023)使用 VQ-VAE 码本对观察结果进行标记tokenizes observations using a VQ-VAE codebook(van den Oord et al., 2017)并使用自回归 Transformer 对结果序列进行建模。与此同时，跨梦想者and models the resulting sequence with an autoregressive Transformer. Meanwhile, TransDreamer(Chen et al., 2022)将 RSSM 的 GRU 与 Transformer-XL 交换以增强远程注意力。swaps the GRU of RSSM with Transformer-XL to enhance long-range attention.Zhang et al. (2023a)将 Transformer 序列建模与随机 VAE 动力学相结合，而combine Transformer sequence modeling with stochastic VAE dynamics, whereasMicheli et al. On the diffusion front, DIAMOND(Alonso et al., 2024)采用扩散去噪作为一步转换算子，以保留低容量潜在动态可能会忽略的视觉复杂性。employs diffusion denoising as the one-step transition operator to preserve visual intricacies that may be overlooked by low-capacity latent dynamics.

基于预测编码的原则Building on the principles of predictive coding(Rao and Ballard, 1999; Friston, 2010)、CPC等方法论, methodologies such as CPC(Oord et al., 2018), SPR (Schwarzer et al., 2021)、和 JEPA, and JEPA(Bardes et al., 2024; Assran et al., 2023)预测forecast the潜在嵌入latent embedding即将发生的观察而不是观察本身。虽然简单of the forthcoming observation rather than the observation itself. While SimPLe(Kaiser et al., 2020)展示了像素级视频预测作为高效 Atari RL 世界模型的可行性，像素空间和潜在空间之间预测保真度的差异强调了抽象动态的进展以及从 L1 到 L2 的过渡。showcased the viability of pixel-level video prediction as a world model for efficient Atari RL, the discrepancy in prediction fidelity between pixel-space and latent-space underscores the progression towards abstract dynamics and the transition from L1 to L2.

除了利用梦想进行政策优化之外，一步动力学模型还可以充当经验生成器：MBPOBeyond using dreaming for policy optimization, one-step dynamics models also function as generators of experience: MBPO(Janner et al., 2019)将短模型推出集成到重播缓冲区中以提高样本效率；integrates short model rollouts into a replay buffer to enhance sample efficiency;Nagabandi et al. (2018)证明基于模型的预训练与无模型微调相结合，充分利用了两种方法的优势。白日梦想家demonstrated that model-based pre-training combined with model-free fine-tuning leverages the strengths of both approaches. DayDreamer(Wu et al., 2023a)将潜在的想象力转移到物理机器人上，transfers latent imagination to physical robots,Wang et al. (2024c)将此扩展至跨视觉领域转移强化学习（RL）知识，以及extend this to transfer reinforcement learning (RL) knowledge across visual domains, andHao et al. (2025)通过神经运动模拟推动世界模型获得长期物理技能。这些应用程序强调 L1 动态可作为数据催化剂和规划基础propel world models towards acquiring long-horizon physical skills through neural motion simulation. These applications underscore that L1 dynamics serve as a data catalyst, a planning foundation(Schrittwieser et al., 2020; Hafner et al., 2025; Hansen et al., 2024)，以及将原始交互压缩为高级行为的机制, and a mechanism for compressing raw interactions into high-level behaviors(Moerland et al., 2023).

3.2.3 观察解码Observation Decoding

解码器实现The decoder implementspψ​(ot∣zt)p_{\psi}(o_{t}\mid z_{t})并具有三个关键功能。它提供训练信号以确保and has three key functions. It provides a training signal to ensure thatztz_{t}保留足够的信息，充当诊断接口来检查模型的学习表示，并充当渲染引擎以在做梦期间生成设想的观察结果preserves sufficient information, serves as a diagnostic interface to examine the model’s learned representations, and acts as a rendering engine for generating envisioned observations during dreaming(Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018; Hafner et al., 2020).

变分自动编码器（VAE；The Variational Autoencoder (VAE;Kingma and Welling 2014, 独立地, independentlyRezende et al. 2014）提供了一个标准的概率框架：编码器) offers a standard probabilistic framework: the encoderqϕ​(zt∣ot)q_{\phi}(z_{t}\mid o_{t})将观察结果映射到潜在的后验，而解码器maps observations to a latent posterior, while the decoderpψ​(ot∣zt)p_{\psi}(o_{t}\mid z_{t})从潜在变量中重建观察结果，并通过 ELBO 同时训练。在世界建模工作流程中，VAE 将原始像素输入压缩为传输到动态模型的简洁代码reconstructs observations from latents, trained simultaneously through the ELBO. In world-modeling workflows, the VAE compresses raw pixel inputs into a concise code transmitted to a dynamics model(Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018; Hafner et al., 2019). β\beta-VAE (Higgins et al., 2017)放大 KL 散度项以鼓励解开因子，而 VQ-VAEamplifies the KL divergence term to encourage disentangled factors, while VQ-VAE(van den Oord et al., 2017)用离散密码本取代连续潜在变量，这是基于令牌的世界模型的基础replaces continuous latents with a discrete codebook, foundational for token-based world models(Micheli et al., 2023)。的. The世界模特World Models概念由concept byHa and Schmidhuber (2018)引入了 VAE 编码器、LSTM 动力学模型 (MDN-RNN) 和独特控制器的融合。随后，梦想家血统introduced the fusion of a VAE encoder, an LSTM dynamics model (MDN-RNN), and a distinct controller. Subsequently, the Dreamer lineage(Hafner et al., 2020; 2021; 2025)将这种范式扩展为端到端的潜在想象框架，其中策略和价值函数仅根据想象的潜在轨迹进行训练，解码器主要充当正则化器和辅助保真度检查，而不是本身作为生成目标。expanded this paradigm into an end-to-end latent imagination framework, where policy and value functions are trained solely on imagined latent trajectories, with the decoder acting mainly as a regularizer and auxiliary fidelity check rather than as a generative objective in its own right.

Sora 等大型视频生成模型Large-scale video generation models like Sora(Brooks et al., 2024)利用大容量观察解码器从潜在轨迹生成逼真的帧。潜在扩散模型leverage high-capacity observation decoders to produce photorealistic frames from latent trajectories. Latent Diffusion Models(Rombach et al., 2022)将图像压缩到较低维的潜在空间并在该空间中更有效地应用扩散过程，而扩散变换器（DiT；compress images into a lower-dimensional latent space and apply diffusion processes more efficiently in that space, while the Diffusion Transformer (DiT;Peebles and Xie 2023）通过用标准 Transformer 替换 U-Net 主干来增强可扩展性。最近的图像生成主干还探索了信息自适应标记化和生成，例如 Dynamic Generative Image Transformer) enhances scalability by replacing the U-Net backbone with a standard Transformer. Recent image-generation backbones also explore information-adaptive tokenization and generation, such as Dynamic Generative Image Transformer(Mao et al., 2026b)，这为观察级解码器提出了一个有用的设计方向，尽管它本身并不是一个多步世界模型。这些模型说明了实现高质量的可行性, which suggests a useful design direction for observation-level decoders even though it is not itself a multi-step world model. These models illustrate the feasibility of achieving high-qualitypψ​(ot∣zt)p_{\psi}(o_{t}\mid z_{t})规模化。然而，该产品的质量at scale. However, the quality of the潜在动力latent dynamics引导解码器，以及的能力that steer the decoder, and the ability ofztz_{t}为了促进连贯的多步预测，仍然是促使过渡到 L2 讨论的挑战。to facilitate coherent multi-step prediction, remain challenges that motivate the transition to the L2 discussion.

3.2.4 逆动力学Inverse Dynamics

逆动力学算子The inverse dynamics operatorπη​(at∣zt−1,zt)\pi_{\eta}(a_{t}\mid z_{t-1},z_{t})推断两个连续潜在状态之间采取的行动。该运算符在现代世界模型系统中扮演多种角色。deduces the action taken between two consecutive latent states. This operator serves multiple roles in modern world-model systems.Pathak et al. (2017)利用逆动力学作为好奇心驱动的探索策略，改进表示以仅捕获环境的可控方面。通过训练编码器来预测连续状态之间的动作，逆模型过滤掉与代理决策无关的外源视觉噪声（例如，移动的云、闪烁的背景）。在更广泛的背景下，逆动力学充当额外的训练信号，提示utilized inverse dynamics as a curiosity-driven exploration strategy, refining the representation to capture only the controllable aspects of the environment. By training the encoder to predict actions between consecutive states, the inverse model filters out exogenous visual noise (e.g., moving clouds, flickering backgrounds) that is irrelevant to the agent’s decisions. In a broader context, inverse dynamics acts as an additional training signal that promptsztz_{t}保留与动作相关的特征，补充前向动态和重建作为学习决策有用表示的机制to preserve action-relevant characteristics, complementing forward dynamics and reconstruction as a mechanism for learning decision-useful representations(Lesort et al., 2018).

逆动力学的一个特别有影响力的应用是大规模模仿学习的回顾性动作标记。A particularly impactful application of inverse dynamics is retrospective action labeling for large-scale imitation learning.Baker et al. (2022)在带有动作标记的《我的世界》游戏玩法的小型语料库上训练了逆动力学模型，然后将其应用于标记大量未标记的互联网视频，使视频预训练 (VPT) 能够仅通过被动观察来学习复杂的行为，例如钻石开采。该管道表明，逆动态可以弥合大量未标记视频和行为克隆所需的动作注释之间的差距，有效地将仅观察数据转换为用于政策学习的可用训练信号。逆向动态也支撑着以目标为条件的政策架构。给定当前状态trained an inverse dynamics model on a small corpus of action-labeled Minecraft gameplay and then applied it to label a vastly larger set of unlabeled internet videos, enabling Video PreTraining (VPT) to learn complex behaviors such as diamond mining from passive observation alone. This pipeline demonstrates that inverse dynamics can bridge the gap between abundant unlabeled video and the action annotations required for behavioral cloning, effectively transforming observation-only data into a usable training signal for policy learning. Inverse dynamics also underpins goal-conditioned policy architectures. Given a current statezt−1z_{t-1}和期望的目标状态and a desired goal statezgz_{g}，逆模型预测将向目标过渡的行动，为分层规划提供自然的界面，其中高层规划器选择子目标，低层逆模型执行它们, the inverse model predicts the action that would transition toward the goal, providing a natural interface for hierarchical planning where a high-level planner selects subgoals and a low-level inverse model executes them(Ghosh et al., 2021). Agrawal et al. (2016)证明机器人可以通过“戳”物体并训练逆模型来根据观察到的状态变化预测戳参数来学习直观的物理学，说明逆动力学如何通过交互来奠定物理理解的基础。demonstrated that a robot can learn intuitive physics by “poking” objects and training an inverse model to predict the poke parameters from observed state changes, illustrating how inverse dynamics can ground physical understanding through interaction.

许多有效的世界模型完全排除逆动力学，而其他模型则将其用作轻正则化技术。一个实际但未充分讨论的问题是动作标签质量：当回顾性地推断动作而不是直接记录动作时，逆模型误差精确地累积在世界模型最需要可靠监督的分布边缘处。此外，逆算子假设状态对之间有唯一或接近唯一的动作，这种假设在随机环境中或当多个动作导致相同结果时会失效，从而限制了其在此类设置中的可靠性。Many effective world models exclude inverse dynamics entirely, while others use it as a light regularization technique. A practical but under-discussed issue is action-label quality: when actions are inferred retrospectively rather than logged directly, inverse-model errors accumulate precisely at distribution edges where world models most need reliable supervision. Furthermore, the inverse operator assumes a unique or near-unique action between state pairs, an assumption that breaks down in stochastic environments or when multiple actions lead to the same outcome, limiting its reliability in such settings.

3.3 讨论Discussion

尽管本文重点关注以时间 t 为索引的时间局部预测，但相同的局部算子视图 可以沿非时间轴应用，例如扩散步骤、细化步骤或分层更新阶段。 我们将这些视为 L1 的边缘情况，而不是作为不同的能力级别，因为关键属性仍然是 局部转换预测而不是决策可用的多步骤推出。Although this paper focuses on temporal local prediction indexed by time t, the same local-operator view can apply along non-temporal axes such as diffusion steps, refinement steps, or hierarchical update stages. We treat these as edge cases of L1 rather than as a distinct capability level, because the key property is still local transition prediction rather than decision-usable multi-step rollout.

仅 L1 并不能确保长期行为的一致性。复合一步错误等挑战L1 alone does not ensure coherent behavior over long horizons. Challenges such as compounding one-step errors(Janner et al., 2019; Chua et al., 2018)、保持众多步骤的一致性以及缺乏干预或反事实推理的方法凸显了 L2 的必要性。同样，L1 和 L2 本身都不是基于新证据来调整模型的；这个能力是L3的重点。 L1和L2的根本区别在于系统的制定和评估是否针对, maintaining consistency across numerous steps, and lacking methods for intervention or counterfactual reasoning highlight the need for L2. Likewise, neither L1 nor L2 inherently adapt the model based on new evidence; this capability is the focus of L3. The fundamental distinction between L1 and L2 lies in whether the system is formulated and assessed for多步推出精度和约束遵守multi-step rollout accuracy and constraint adherence，而不是仅仅关注一步预测精度, rather than solely focusing on one-step prediction precision(Hafner et al., 2025; Ding et al., 2025a; Moerland et al., 2023)。 L1 的局限性并不是单步预测不重要，而是局部预测质量本身并不能保证组合下的决策可用行为。因此，实际问题是短期运营商何时不再满足规划者的需求。. The limitation of L1 is not that one-step prediction is unimportant, but that local predictive quality alone does not guarantee decision-usable behavior under composition. The practical question is thus when short-horizon operators stop meeting the planner’s needs.

4 L2 模拟器：决策可用的多步模拟L2 Simulator: Decision-Usable Multi-Step Simulation

L1 答案在哪里Where L1 answers“鉴于当前的状态和行动，下一个本地状态是什么？”“what is the next local state given the current state and action?”，L2 回答一个与决策相关的问题：, L2 answers a decision-relevant question:“如果智能体在任务限制下执行候选动作序列，未来的轨迹可能会展开什么？”“if the agent executes a candidate action sequence under task constraints, what future trajectory is likely to unfold?”这一提升将单步操作员变成了一个模拟器，代理可以在采取行动之前进行查询，从而提供了一种This elevation turns one-step operators into a simulator that an agent can query before committing to action, thus providing an想象力imagination无需真实环境交互即可预测未来。基于模型的规划正是利用了这种能力：通过在学习模型内推出候选计划，智能体可以比较结果并选择最有希望的行动方案of the future without requiring real-environment interaction. Model-based planning exploits exactly this capability: by rolling out candidate plans inside a learned model, the agent compares outcomes and selects the most promising course of action(Sutton, 1991; Hafner et al., 2025; Schrittwieser et al., 2020)。一个重要的推论是，任何用于为代理生成合成训练数据的系统都隐式地充当世界模型，因为它必须产生足够现实的状态转换以支持政策改进. An important corollary is that any system used to generate synthetic training data for an agent implicitly serves as a world model, since it must produce state transitions realistic enough to support policy improvement(Gu et al., 2025b; Fang et al., 2025)。值得注意的是，决策可用模拟侧重于合理的动力学，这与状态变化任意的 L1 保持着区别。例如，一个杯子穿过一张坚固的桌子，一辆汽车漂过车道边界而没有产生任何后果，或者一个社会承诺悄然消失，每一个都代表着未能保持目标制度的统治不变量。. It is worth noting that, decision-usable simulation focuses on plausible dynamics, which holds its distinction between L1 where state changes are arbitrary. For example, a cup passing through a solid table, a car drifting through lane boundaries without consequence, or a social commitment silently vanishing each represent failures to preserve the governing invariants of the target regime.

表Table4将三个 L2 边界条件映射到每个管辖法律制度中的具体实例。更准确地说，L2 系统支持以下形式的轨迹级查询maps the three L2 boundary conditions to concrete instantiations in each governing-law regime. More precisely, an L2 system supports trajectory-level queries of the form

Intervention-structured rollouts align with the interventional rung of Pearl’s causal hierarchy (Section2.1）。 L2 与 L1 的区别不仅仅在于一步预测质量，还在于). What separates L2 from L1 is not one-step predictive quality alone, but根据适用法律采取连贯的多步骤推广coherent multi-step rollout under the governing laws。因此，L2 将每条边的 L1 算子缝合成完整的轨迹. 4.1 标高要求Requirements for Elevation

通过多个步骤组合 L1 的本地算子并不会自动生成可用于决策的模拟器：复合错误、对动作不敏感的推出以及违反的域不变量都可能导致生成的轨迹对规划产生误导。这呼应了经典的框架问题Composing L1’s local operators over multiple steps does not automatically yield a decision-usable simulator: compounding errors, action-insensitive rollouts, and violated domain invariants can each render the resulting trajectories misleading for planning. This echoes the classical frame problem(McCarthy and Hayes, 1969; Shanahan, 1997)特别是，局部转换规则本身并没有指定哪些属性在动作下应保持不变，而这里的关注点是操作性的而不是逻辑性的。规划器和 L2 世界模型之间的接口是, in particular, local transition rules alone do not specify which properties should remain invariant under action, while the concern here is operational rather than logical. The interface between a planner and an L2 world model is the查询query：给定一个动作序列: given an action sequencea1:Ha_{1:H}来自州from statez0z_{0}在限制下under constraintscc，模型返回规划者用来比较候选者并选择最大化目标的滚动条。我们将闭环使用（与环境交互中的规划、行动或控制）视为正交部署属性：级别边界由世界模型查询的深度和可靠性决定，而不是由系统是否在反馈循环中运行决定。我们使用三个边界条件来标记从 L1 到 L2 的高程：, the model returns rollouts that the planner uses to compare candidates and select the one maximizing an objective. We treat closed-loop use (planning, acting, or control in interaction with an environment) as an orthogonal deployment property: the level boundary is determined by the depth and reliability of the world-model query, not by whether the system operates in a feedback loop. We use three boundary conditions to mark the elevation from L1 to L2:

  1. 1.

    长视域相干性：Long-horizon coherence:推出在多个步骤中仍然可用，而不是由于复合错误而立即降级。rollouts remain usable over multiple steps, rather than degrading immediately through compounding error.

  2. 2.

    干预敏感性：Intervention sensitivity:反事实编辑，例如，改变动作、前提或可控输入。这些会引起稳定且有方向意义的轨迹变化。counterfactual edits, for example, changing actions, premises, or controllable inputs. These induce stable and directionally meaningful trajectory changes.

  3. 3.

    约束一致性：Constraint consistency:生成的未来尊重目标制度的管辖法律约束，无论是物理的、数字的、社会的还是科学的。generated futures respect the governing-law constraints of the target regime, whether physical, digital, social, or scientific.

这些不仅仅是概念上的区别；而且是概念上的区别。它们共同引发了一个实际测试，以确定系统是否 不愧是L2模拟器。候选系统不应仅进行一步评估 预测质量，还取决于随着推出范围的增加，性能是否仍然可用于决策， 反事实干预是否会产生连贯且与政策相关的分歧，以及是否产生了分歧 轨迹继续满足特定制度的有效性约束。预测下一步的模型 准确但在组合下折叠、忽略操作编辑或违反域规则仍然更好 理解为具有强大局部预测的 L1，而不是完整的 L2 模拟器。These are not merely conceptual distinctions; together they induce a practical test for whether a system deserves to be called an L2 simulator. A candidate system should be evaluated not only on one-step prediction quality, but also on whether performance remains decision-usable as rollout horizon increases, whether counterfactual interventions produce coherent and policy-relevant divergence, and whether generated trajectories continue to satisfy regime-specific validity constraints. A model that predicts the next step accurately yet collapses under composition, ignores action edits, or violates domain rules remains better understood as L1 with strong local prediction, rather than as a full L2 simulator.

从L1到L2。From L1 to L2.
