每个要求都对应一个诊断信号和缓解策略。Each requirement maps to a diagnostic signal and a mitigation strategy.长视野保真度Long-horizon fidelity通过特定范围内的成功悬崖来诊断is diagnosed by a success cliff at a specific horizonHH。缓解这种情况的主要方法是通过频繁的重新规划来进行任务细分。. The primary mitigation of this is task segmentation with frequent replanning.动作可控性Action controllability通过部署过程中的动作不敏感来诊断（改变is diagnosed by action insensitivity across rollouts (changingata_{t}不会产生有意义的轨迹变化），其中缓解措施需要明确的行动一致性评估。produces no meaningful trajectory change), where mitigation requires explicit action-consistency evaluation.约束一致性Constraint consistency通过约束违反率来衡量。在这种情况下，缓解措施包括硬约束层和验证门。第四个属性，is measured by the constraint-violation rate. In such cases, mitigations include hard constraint layers and verification gates. A fourth property,校准calibration，要求置信度与分布偏移下的实际精度保持一致；在这种情况下，过度自信的错误预测预示着失败，而分布偏移检测是主要的补救措施。, requires that confidence aligns with actual accuracy under distribution shift; in such cases, overconfident wrong predictions signal failure, and distribution-shift detection is the main remedy.

残差框架问题的表现。Residual frame-problem manifestations.

现代神经世界模型通过从数据中隐式学习什么持续存在和什么变化来回避经典框架问题的表征负担Modern neural world models sidestep the classical frame problem’s representational burden by learning implicitly from data what persists and what changes(Goodfellow et al., 2016; Hafner et al., 2025)，实现可扩展的基于模型的强化学习, enabling scalable model-based RL(Hafner et al., 2020; Schrittwieser et al., 2020; Moerland et al., 2023)和视频预测and video prediction(Babaeizadeh et al., 2018; Brooks et al., 2024)没有明确的框架公理。然而，问题在推出时再次出现：上下文窗口限制和幻觉导致模型失去对相关过去信息的追踪，违反了长期一致性，而训练数据中罕见的先决条件代表性不足，破坏了约束一致性without explicit frame axioms. Yet the problem resurfaces at rollout time: context-window limits and hallucination cause models to lose track of relevant past information, violating long-horizon coherence, while rare preconditions under-represented in training data undermine constraint consistency(Ding et al., 2025a; Shanahan, 1997)。这些失效模式激发了下面调查的技术（参见附录. These failure modes motivate the techniques surveyed below (see AppendixB).

4.2 应用领域Applications

在本节中，我们将 L2 系统分为四种管辖法律制度。表格In this section, we categorize L2 systems into four governing-law regimes. Tables5和and6提供用于跨区域比较的锚定系统，并总结每个域如何实例化边界条件。provide anchor systems for cross-regime comparison and summarize how each domain instantiates the boundary conditions.

4.2.1 物质世界的法则Laws of the Physical World

在物理领域，L2 模型应遵循几何、运动学和守恒定律。 控制约束是接触、可达性、稳定性和能量守恒；违反其中任何一项都会误导规划者提出在实际执行中灾难性失败的行动。In the physical domain, L2 models should respect geometry, kinematics, and conservation laws. The governing constraints are contact, reachability, stability, and energy conservation; violations of any of these will mislead a planner into proposing actions that fail catastrophically in real execution.

物理模拟。Physics simulation.

刚体控制模拟器。Rigid-body control simulators.经典物理模拟器仍然是可执行文件的基础层 具身世界建模中的转换有效性。 MuJoCo 提供铰接式刚体动力学和丰富的接触控制， dm_control 将这些功能打包到标准化的连续控制中 套房Classical physics simulators remain the foundation layer for executable transition validity in embodied world modeling. MuJoCo provides articulated rigid-body dynamics and contact-rich control, with dm_control packaging these capabilities into a standardized continuous-control suite(Todorov et al., 2012; Tassa et al., 2020)。 Brax 将可微刚体模拟推向加速器规模 吞吐量. Brax pushes differentiable rigid-body simulation toward accelerator-scale throughput(Freeman et al., 2021)，而 Isaac Gym 和 Isaac Lab 则强调 大规模 GPU 并行机器人模拟, while Isaac Gym and Isaac Lab emphasize massive GPU-parallel robotics simulation(Makoviychuk et al., 2021; Mittal et al., 2025).

可扩展的通用仿真平台。Scalable and general-purpose simulation platforms.Genesis 将自己定位为生成式通用物理引擎Genesis positions itself as a generative and universal physics engine(Genesis Authors, 2024)，反映了更高吞吐量模拟器的更广泛趋势，可以共同支持控制和大规模合成数据生成。, reflecting the broader trend toward higher-throughput simulators that can jointly support both control and large-scale synthetic-data generation.

以交互为中心的具体模拟器。Interaction-centric embodied simulators.在图形和机器人接口上，SAPIEN 提供零件感知、 以交互为中心的模拟，ManiSkill3 扩展 GPU 并行渲染 对于可推广的具体人工智能At the graphics-and-robotics interface, SAPIEN provides part-aware, interaction-centric simulation, and ManiSkill3 scales GPU-parallel rendering for generalizable embodied AI(Xiang et al., 2020; Tao et al., 2024)。 这些系统不是经过学习的模拟器；他们是明确的法律执行者 价值在于精确的接触处理、铰接的约束以及 可重复的推出。. These systems are not learned simulators; they are explicit law executors whose value lies in precise contact handling, articulated constraints, and reproducible rollouts.

视频生成模型。Video generation models.

外观优先的长视距视频生成。Appearance-first long-horizon video generation.物理世界模拟的可扩展途径是A scalable route to physical-world simulation is the视频接口video interface： 给定当前观察和可选操作，模型返回想象的 未来的框架。 该系列从外观优先的推出开始，其中诸如 Sora 之类的系统， Lumiere 和 VideoPoet 展示了长时间内连贯的视觉动态 视野: given current observations and optional actions, the model returns imagined future frames. This line begins with appearance-first rollout, where systems such as Sora, Lumiere, and VideoPoet demonstrate coherent visual dynamics over extended horizons(Brooks et al., 2024; Bar-Tal et al., 2024; Kondratyuk et al., 2024), 几何感知结构日益超越像素级 现实主义, with geometry-aware structure increasingly emerging beyond pixel-level realism(Li et al., 2024d)。 框架包. FramePack(Zhang et al., 2025c)和 自我强迫and Self-Forcing(Huang et al., 2025c)通过帧上下文打包减少长范围漂移。reduce long-horizon drift through frame-context packing.

动作调节和互动视频世界。Action-conditioned and interactive video worlds.第二个方向是从被动延续转向有干预意识的生成。 Genie 从未标记的互联网视频中学习潜在的动作空间A second direction moves from passive continuation toward intervention-aware generation. Genie learns latent action spaces from unlabeled Internet video(Bruce et al., 2024)，而 GAIA-1 则以明确的控制信号来限制下一代进行反事实评估, while GAIA-1 conditions future generation on explicit control signals for counterfactual evaluation(Hu et al., 2023)。 最近的系统将这条线推向实时、长视野和流式交互： Oasis 在统一的变压器世界中探索开放式互动生成. More recent systems push this line toward real-time, long-horizon, and streaming interaction: Oasis explores open-ended interactive generation in a unified transformer world(Decart et al., 2024); WorldPlay 强调实时交互式世界建模的长期几何一致性; WorldPlay emphasizes long-term geometric consistency for real-time interactive world modeling(Sun et al., 2025b); Matrix-Game 3.0 将交互式生成扩展到具有显式长视野内存的流设置; Matrix-Game 3.0 extends interactive generation to streaming settings with explicit long-horizon memory(Wang et al., 2026b); Yume-1.5 研究文本控制的交互式世界生成; Yume-1.5 studies text-controlled interactive world generation(Mao et al., 2025); LongLive的目标是实时交互式长视频生成; and LongLive targets real-time interactive long video generation(Yang et al., 2025b)。 总而言之，这些系统标志着从被动视频预测到可控、干预感知和时间持久视频世界的转变。. Taken together, these systems mark a shift from passive video prediction toward controllable, intervention-aware, and temporally persistent video worlds.

面向决策的视频世界模型。Decision-oriented video world models.在基于模型的强化学习中，SimPLeIn model-based RL, SimPLe(Kaiser et al., 2020)和 钻石and DIAMOND(Alonso et al., 2024)使视频的决策理论作用 世界模型明确。 在机器人领域，DreamZeromake the decision-theoretic role of video world models explicit. In robotics, DreamZero(Ye et al., 2026b)和 梦幻道场and DreamDojo(Gao et al., 2026)展示零样本和通才政策 通过视频世界模型学习，同时 未来VLAdemonstrate zero-shot and generalist policy learning via video world models, while FutureVLA(Xu et al., 2026a)将视觉运动预测直接与视觉-语言-行动策略结合起来，以统一感知和控制。couples visuomotor prediction directly with Vision-Language-Action policies to unify perception and control.

评估和限制。Evaluation and limitations.然而，在我们的 L2 框架内，视觉合理性并不等于 决策可用性。 干预敏感性依然脆弱，长期一致性很容易 仅凭感知质量来判断被夸大了Within our L2 framing, however, visual plausibility does not equal decision-usability. Intervention sensitivity remains fragile, long-horizon coherence is easily overstated when judged by perceptual quality alone(Guo et al., 2025), 和 约束一致性很难从渲染帧中验证。 标准指标，例如 FVD, and constraint consistency is difficult to verify from rendered frames. Standard metrics such as FVD(Unterthiner et al., 2018)捕获分布式 现实主义； VBench 风格套件capture distributional realism; VBench-style suites(Huang et al., 2024d; 2025e)更好 分解可控性； VBench-2.0better decompose controllability; VBench-2.0(Zheng et al., 2025a)延伸 评估物理一致性和常识推理；和 维链extends evaluation to physics consistency and commonsense reasoning; and VChain(Huang et al., 2025d)引入因果视觉思维链 连贯性。 视频接口是最具可扩展性的观察层入口点，但规划器关键结构仍然隐含在像素中；附录introduces visual chain-of-thought for causal coherence. Video interfaces are the most scalable observation-layer entry point, but planner-critical structure remains implicit in pixels; AppendixC调查了使这种结构变得明确的几何承载替代方案。surveys geometry-carrying alternatives that make such structure explicit.

机器人技术和模拟到真实的传输。Robotics and sim-to-real transfer.

世界模型转移到真实的机器人上。World models transferred to real robots.白日梦想家DayDreamer(Wu et al., 2023a)表明梦想家家庭世界模型可以 从模拟转移到物理机器人，同时处理传感器噪声， 接触动力学和驱动延迟。 梦零showed that Dreamer-family world models can transfer from simulation to physical robots while handling sensor noise, contact dynamics, and actuation delays. DreamZero(Ye et al., 2026b)通过世界实现零样本政策学习 预测接下来的状态和行动的行动模型，以及 未来VLAachieves zero-shot policy learning via world action models that predict both next states and actions, and FutureVLA(Xu et al., 2026a)嵌入视觉运动预测 视觉-语言-行动模型可改善行动基础。embeds visuomotor prediction within Vision-Language-Action models to improve action grounding.

基于物理的电桥可实现从模拟到真实的鲁棒性。Physics-grounded bridges for sim-to-real robustness. PIN-WM (Li et al., 2025d)将可微分物理与学习的视觉世界建模相结合，通过物理感知随机化创建“数字表兄弟”。integrates differentiable physics with learned visual world modeling, creating “digital cousins” via physics-aware randomization.

代表性要求。Representation requirement.在这些系统中，关键问题不在于是否可以提供更丰富的表示。 可能的，但是仍然保留的最弱的表示是什么 规划器关键结构，例如对象持久性、自由空间、接触开始、 支持关系，以及在有用的范围内以行动为条件的变化。 有关 3D 结构世界模型和自动驾驶的详细信息出现在 附录Across these systems, the key question is not whether richer representations are possible, but what is the weakest representation that still preserves planner-critical structure, such as object persistence, free space, contact onset, support relations, and action-conditioned change over useful horizons. Extended details on 3D-structured world models and autonomous driving appear in AppendixC.

4.2.2 数字世界的法则Laws of the Digital World

数字世界的法则控制着由正式规范定义的系统的转变，从有限自动机（UI 状态机）和上下文无关语法（结构化数据格式）到图灵完备的程序（通用软件）。与物质世界的法则或社会世界的法则不同，这些约束是The Laws of the Digital World govern transitions in systems defined by formal specifications, from finite automata (UI state machines) and context-free grammars (structured data formats) to Turing-complete programs (general software). Unlike the Laws of the Physical World or the Laws of the Social World, these constraints are明确指定且可机械验证explicitly specified and mechanically verifiable：转换要么满足程序的语义，要么不满足。由于软件转换近似于确定性状态机，并且故障是可记录的（错误代码、弹出窗口、权限拒绝、超时），因此代码世界中模拟器的核心挑战是: a transition either satisfies the program’s semantics or it does not. Because software transitions approximate deterministic state machines and failures are loggable (error codes, popups, permission denials, timeouts), the core challenge for a Simulator in code worlds is结构化状态预测structured state prediction（DOM 树、程序状态、游戏状态）而不是视觉保真度。(DOM trees, program state, game state) rather than visual fidelity.

编码剂。Coding agents.

一种新兴的范式将世界模型表示为可执行程序而不是神经网络。代码WMAn emerging paradigm represents world models as executable programs rather than neural networks. CodeWM(Dainese et al., 2024)使用蒙特卡洛树搜索引导的法学硕士生成 Python 程序，作为跨 18 个环境的强化学习的明确、可解释的世界模型。世界编码器uses LLMs guided by Monte Carlo Tree Search to generate Python programs that serve as explicit, interpretable world models for reinforcement learning across 18 environments. WorldCoder(Tang et al., 2024)采用补充方法，LLM 代理通过环境交互逐步构建 Python 世界模型，以实现样本高效传输。 WKMtakes a complementary approach, with an LLM agent building a Python world model incrementally through environment interaction for sample-efficient transfer. WKM(Qiao et al., 2024)提供全局任务知识和动态状态知识来指导LLM代理规划，而CWMprovides both global task knowledge and dynamic state knowledge to guide LLM agent planning, while CWM(Copet et al., 2025)，一位专为代码世界模型研究训练的 32B 开放权重法学硕士，在 SWE-bench Verified 上取得了 65.8% 的成绩。概念上不同的变体更进一步：而不是使用法学硕士, a 32B open-weights LLM specifically trained for code world model research, achieves 65.8% on SWE-bench Verified. A conceptually distinct variant pushes further: rather than using an LLM to生成generate代码世界模型，世界模型a code world model, the world modelis一个正在运行的软件系统。网络世界模型a running software system. Web World Models(Feng et al., 2025a)将世界状态实现为普通 Web 代码（TypeScript 模块、HTTP 处理程序、数据库模式），将逻辑一致性委托给 Web 堆栈的确定性执行，同时 LLM 生成上下文和高级决策。 这些基于代码的方法产生了神经动力学只能近似的可解释、可组合和可验证的世界模型。implement world state as ordinary web code (TypeScript modules, HTTP handlers, database schemas), delegating logical consistency to deterministic execution of the web stack while LLMs generate context and high-level decisions. These code-based approaches yield interpretable, composable, and verifiable world models that neural dynamics can only approximate.

网络代理。Web agents.

网络代理通常会浏览网站；因此，对网站内的状态转换进行建模和模拟对于构建有效的网络世界模型至关重要。 网络梦想家Web agents usually browse websites; therefore, modeling and simulating state transitions within a website is crucial for building effective web world models. WebDreamer(Gu et al., 2025b)引入了使用法学硕士作为互联网隐式世界模型的想法，但随后的工作表明，现成的法学硕士是不够的：需要进行以过渡为中心的抽象的专门培训introduced the idea of using an LLM as an implicit world model of the internet, but subsequent work showed that off-the-shelf LLMs are insufficient: dedicated training with transition-focused abstraction is needed(Chae et al., 2025)。越来越多的工作致力于解决智能体和世界模型的共同演化问题。网络进化者. A growing body of work addresses the co-evolution of agent and world model. WebEvolver(Fang et al., 2025)将两者紧密结合在一个相互改进的循环中，而 DreamGymtightly couples the two in a mutual improvement loop, while DreamGym(Chen et al., 2025f)通过链式推理构建体验模型，在WebArena上实现了30%以上的提升。在更大范围内，WebSynthesisbuilds experience models with chain-of-thought reasoning, achieving over 30% improvement on WebArena. At larger scale, WebSynthesis(Gao et al., 2025)使用完全合成的数据和 WebWorld 将世界模型与基于 MCTS 的规划相结合combines world models with MCTS-based planning using entirely synthetic data, and WebWorld(Xiao et al., 2026)在超过 100 万条轨迹上训练开放网络模拟器，支持 30 多个步骤模拟。 急性肾损伤trains an open-web simulator on over one million trajectories supporting 30+ step simulation. AUI(Lin et al., 2025a)采用不同的方法，利用编码器在迭代协作循环中利用计算机使用代理的反馈来优化网站。 正交设计选择包括仅根据工具规格生成轨迹（Simia；takes a different approach, employing a Coder to optimize websites by leveraging feedback from a Computer-Use Agent in an iterative collaboration loop. Orthogonal design choices include generating trajectories from tool specifications alone (Simia;Li et al. 2025f），添加一个元认知层来决定), adding a metacognitive layer that decides是否whether每一步都参考世界模型（WAC；to consult the world model at each step (WAC;Shen et al. 2026）和代理收集的数据来处理分布外行为。) and agent-collected data to handle out-of-distribution behaviors.

GUI 代理。GUI agents.

图形用户界面代理GUI agents(Qin et al., 2025; Lin et al., 2025b; Xu et al., 2024b)通常在真实环境中执行操作。然而，在某些行为可能是危险的或导致不良结果的情况下，提前估计它们是有益的。 GUI世界模型可以模拟和评估这些动作，从而提供更可靠的评估。 因此，移动梦想家typically execute actions in real environments. However, in scenarios where actions may be dangerous or lead to undesired outcomes, it is beneficial to estimate them beforehand. A GUI world model can simulate and evaluate these actions, thereby providing a more reliable assessment. Therefore, MobileDreamer(Cao et al., 2026)将 GUI 图像转换为与任务相关的草图以进行结构化状态预测，而 MobileWorldBenchtransforms GUI images into task-related sketches for structured state prediction, while MobileWorldBench(Li et al., 2025c)提供 140 万个（状态、行动、未来状态）三元组的系统评估。作为对显式 GUI 世界模型的补充，UI-AGILE 表明，有效的强化学习和精确的推理时间基础对于强大的下游 GUI 代理性能仍然同样重要provides systematic evaluation with 1.4 million (state, action, future state) triplets. Complementary to explicit GUI world models, UI-AGILE shows that effective reinforcement learning and precise inference-time grounding remain equally important for strong downstream GUI-agent performance(Lian et al., 2025)。一个中心设计问题是输出表示：ViMo. A central design question is the output representation: ViMo(Luo et al., 2025)使用符号文本表示将未来的观察结果生成为图像，而 gWorldgenerates future observations as images using symbolic text representation, while gWorld(Koh et al., 2026)生成可渲染的 Web 代码作为预测的下一个状态，这表明生成渲染 GUI 的代码比直接生成像素更忠实。在操作系统层面，NeuralOSgenerates renderable web code as the predicted next state, suggesting that generating the code that renders the GUI can be more faithful than generating pixels directly. At the OS level, NeuralOS(Rivard et al., 2025)通过根据用户输入预测屏幕框架来模拟桌面 GUI，而 CUWMsimulates desktop GUIs by predicting screen frames from user inputs, while CUWM(Guan et al., 2026)面向桌面软件，其中必须在长期工作流程中保留持久文档状态。 代码世界targets desktop software where persistent document state must be preserved across long-horizon workflows. Code2World(Zheng et al., 2026)通过将代码视为可渲染的世界，生成的程序在执行时直接产生视觉状态（例如 HTML），从而进一步扩展了这条线。这使得能够将环境动态建模为可执行代码生成，紧密耦合交互式域（例如 GUI）中的感知、操作和状态转换。further extends this line by treating code as a renderable world, where generated programs directly produce visual states (e.g., HTML) upon execution. This enables modeling environment dynamics as executable code generation, tightly coupling perception, action, and state transition in interactive domains such as GUIs.

4.2.3 社会世界的法则Laws of the Social World

社会世界模型将 L2 扩展到人类互动，其中的统治法则是信念、欲望、意图、规范和制度，而不是物理学。社交世界表现出三个独特的属性，特别是Societal world models extend L2 to human interaction, where governing laws are beliefs, desires, intentions, norms, and institutions rather than physics. Social worlds exhibit three distinctive properties, in particular,不透明度opacity（代理人无法直接观察对方的心理状态），(agents cannot directly observe each other’s mental states),反身性reflexivity（对社会状态的信念创造了反馈循环），以及(beliefs about social state create feedback loops), and规范性normativity（过渡部分受共同规范管辖）。这些特征使得过渡功能部分由集体协议而非自然法构成(transitions are governed partly by shared norms). Such traits make the transition function partially constituted by collective agreement rather than natural law(Zheng et al., 2025c)。可用的社交模拟器将表面语言与底层社会状态分开：对话可以变化，但核心状态（目标、信仰、关系、规范）必须保持一致并产生可解释的转变，如理性言语行为框架所形式化的那样. A usable social simulator separates surface language from underlying social state: dialogue can vary, but core states (goals, beliefs, relations, norms) must remain consistent and yield interpretable transitions, as formalized by the Rational Speech Acts framework(Goodman and Frank, 2016; Degen, 2023)。具体来说，社会兼容性术语. Concretely, a social compatibility termϕc​(τ)\phi_{c}(\tau)可以编码承诺一致性：如果代理can encode commitment consistency: if agentii承诺行动promises actionbb在某个时间at timett，后来的状态在以下情况下兼容性较低, later states receive low compatibility whenii违反violatesbb无需解释、重新谈判或制裁。类似的术语可以对轨迹上的规范合规性、角色一致性或信念状态一致性进行评分。without explanation, renegotiation, or sanction. Similar terms can score norm compliance, role consistency, or belief-state coherence over the trajectory.

作为社会状态的心理理论。Theory of mind as social state.

贝叶斯理论 (BToM) 奠定了计算基础，它将心理状态推断形式化为理性主体的概率逆规划The computational foundation was laid by Bayesian ToM (BToM), which formalizes mental state inference as probabilistic inverse planning over rational agents(Baker et al., 2011)。神经方法始于 ToMnet. Neural approaches began with ToMnet(Rabinowitz et al., 2018)，其性格、心理状态和预测网络共同推断特征和信念，以及最近的工作，例如 LaBToM, whose character, mental state, and prediction networks jointly infer traits and beliefs, and recent work such as LaBToM(Ying et al., 2025)将贝叶斯逆向规划与正式的认知语言联系起来。然而，当前的模型缺乏强大的心理状态推理：FANToMbridges Bayesian inverse planning with formal epistemic language. However, current models lack robust mental state reasoning: FANToM(Kim et al., 2023)揭示了所有最先进的法学硕士和 ExploreToM 中的“虚幻 ToM”reveals “illusory ToM” across all state-of-the-art LLMs, and ExploreToM(Sclar et al., 2024)GPT-4o 的准确率低至 9%achieves accuracy as low as 9% for GPT-4o(Chen et al., 2025c)。一个互补的挑战是. A complementary challenge is the双结构dual-structure问题：社会主体必须同时模拟他人的心理状态（心理理论），并在长期互动中维持自己持久的内部状态，特别是目标、角色、记忆和知识。语言代理的认知架构（CoALA）problem: a social agent must simultaneously model others’ mental states (theory of mind) and maintain its own persistent internal state across long interactions, in particular, goals, persona, memory, and knowledge. Cognitive Architectures for Language Agents (CoALA)(Sumers et al., 2024)将这种双重结构形式化为必须保持相互一致的独立记忆和行动空间，并提供了一个原则框架来理解当前的 LLM 代理如何实现和不实现稳定的自我表征。formalizes this dual structure as separate memory and action spaces that must remain mutually consistent, and provides a principled framework for understanding how current LLM agents do and do not achieve stable self-representation.

战略互动。Strategic interaction.

西塞罗CICERO(Bakhtin et al., 2022)将语言模型与外交的 piKL 规划相结合，共同优化游戏动作和对话，同时建模二阶信念，实现了超过integrates a language model with piKL planning for Diplomacy, jointly optimizing game actions and dialogue while modeling second-order beliefs, achieving more than2×2\times人类平均得分。交易或不交易the average human score. Deal or No Deal(Lewis et al., 2017)率先推出对话，以向前模拟谈判动态。狼人杀和阿瓦隆游戏是欺骗、信任和信念操纵的集中测试平台pioneered dialogue rollouts for forward simulation of negotiation dynamics. Werewolf and Avalon games serve as concentrated testbeds for deception, trust, and belief manipulation(Xu et al., 2023; Light et al., 2023)，揭示了欺骗者始终通过利用认知局限性而获胜。, revealing that deceivers consistently prevail by exploiting cognitive limitations.

沙箱模拟。Sandbox simulation.

生成代理展示了新兴的社会动态：25 代理模拟Generative Agents demonstrated emergent social dynamics: a 25-agent simulation(Park et al., 2023)使用基于内存的状态跟踪和周期性反射，而 Sotopiaused memory-based state tracking and periodic reflection, while Sotopia(Zhou et al., 2024c)跨七个维度的正式社会模拟评估。规模急剧扩大：Sid 项目formalized social simulation evaluation across seven dimensions. Scale has increased dramatically: Project Sid(AL et al., 2024)部署了 1,000 名代理，展现出新兴的专业化和治理能力，以及 OASISdeployed 1,000 agents exhibiting emergent specialization and governance, and OASIS(Yang et al., 2024d)扩展到一百万个代理，再现信息传播和群体极化。在个人层面上，scaled to one million agents reproducing information spreading and group polarization. At the individual level,Argyle et al. (2023)展示了“硅抽样”，它以特定的人口统计资料为法学硕士的条件，以模拟目标亚群的调查反应，并显示出与美国国家选举研究数据的强烈一致性，为个人社会世界建模开辟了道路。生成性社会选择demonstrate “silicon sampling”, which conditions LLMs on specific demographic profiles to simulate survey responses from targeted subpopulations and shows strong alignment with American National Election Studies data, opening a path toward individual social world modeling. Generative Social Choice(Fish et al., 2024)将其扩展到民主聚合，利用法学硕士生成来自不同综合参与者的代表性声明并进行审议。extends this to democratic aggregation, using LLMs to generate representative statements from diverse synthetic participants and enabling deliberation.

挑战和设计原则。Challenges and design principles.

社会模拟仍然为时过早：法学硕士急剧退化超出二阶信念推理Social simulation remains premature: LLMs degrade sharply beyond second-order belief reasoning(Wu et al., 2023b)，代理遭受角色漂移和目标遗忘, agents suffer from role drift and goal forgetting(Park et al., 2023; Zhou et al., 2024c)，以及正式承诺跟踪, and formal commitment tracking(Telang et al., 2021)仍未集成到任何 LLM 架构中。实用的设计模式将紧凑的社会状态表示（承诺、约束、关系）、对话生成器和转换更新器分开，后者强制一致性并使状态转换可记录和可重播。灵活的角色生成对于使用多样化、可控的代理填充社交模拟器至关重要；人格健身房remains unintegrated into any LLM architecture. A practical design pattern separates a compact social state representation (commitments, constraints, relations), a dialogue generator, and a transition updater that enforces consistency and makes state transitions loggable and replayable. Flexible persona generation is essential for populating social simulators with diverse, controllable agents; PersonaGym(Samuel et al., 2025)提供了一个基准，用于评估法学硕士如何忠实地在复杂的社会任务中制定特定的角色，揭示了在对抗性探究下维持角色一致性的系统性失败。对于个人层面的个性化，LaMPprovides a benchmark for evaluating how faithfully LLMs enact specified personas across complex social tasks, revealing systematic failures in maintaining persona consistency under adversarial probing. For personalization at the individual level, LaMP(Salemi et al., 2024)引入了七个任务的基准，要求法学硕士生成与特定用户历史一致的输出，并表明检索增强方法可以显着缩小差距。有关 ToM 提示、沙箱架构、突发现象、数字孪生和制度方法的详细信息见附录introduces a benchmark of seven tasks requiring LLMs to generate outputs consistent with a specific user’s history, and shows that retrieval-augmented approaches significantly close the gap. Extended details on ToM prompting, sandbox architectures, emergent phenomena, digital twins, and institutional approaches appear in AppendixC.

4.2.4 科学世界的法则Laws of the Scientific World

在科学人工智能中，从 L1 到 L2 的转变将重点从局部状态或结构建模转移到模拟多个步骤的动力学。 这些动态沿着两个轴产生。 第一个涉及系统的时间演化，其中模型预测自然系统在给定条件或干预下如何随时间展开。 第二个涉及科学研究本身，模型模拟假设、实验和结果的序列以支持推理和行动。 这两种形式定义了科学世界模型中相应的模拟形式：系统动力学的正向模拟和基于候选实验的替代评估的决策模拟。In AI for Science, the transition from L1 to L2 shifts the focus from modeling local states or structures to simulating dynamics over multiple steps. These dynamics arise along two axes. The first concerns the temporal evolution of a system, where the model predicts how a natural system unfolds over time under given conditions or interventions. The second concerns the scientific research itself, where the model simulates sequences of hypotheses, experiments, and outcomes to support reasoning and action. These two forms define the corresponding forms of simulation in scientific world models: forward simulation of system dynamics, and decision simulation based on surrogate evaluation of candidate experiments.

正向模拟。Forward simulation.

世界模型通过用学习的转移算子取代昂贵的数值求解器来近似科学系统的演化。 全球导航卫星系统World models approximate the evolution of scientific systems by replacing expensive numerical solvers with learned transition operators. GNS(Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020)表明粒子图上的消息传递可以模拟具有可推广动力学的流体、刚体和可变形材料。 傅立叶神经算子showed that message passing on particle graphs can simulate fluids, rigid bodies, and deformable materials with generalizable dynamics. The Fourier Neural Operator(Li et al., 2021b)通过谱卷积建立分辨率不变算子学习，达到 1000established resolution-invariant operator learning via spectral convolutions, achieving 1000×\times比传统求解器加速并支撑随后的天气和流体替代品。 在行星尺度上，盘古天气speedup over traditional solvers and underpinning subsequent weather and fluid surrogates. At planetary scale, Pangu-Weather(Bi et al., 2023)和 GraphCastand GraphCast(Lam et al., 2023)在 90% 的验证目标上优于 ECMWF 操作系统。 根卡斯特outperform the ECMWF operational system on 90% of verification targets. GenCast(Price et al., 2024)通过扩散架构将这些扩展到概率预测，在 97.2% 的目标上优于集成系统。 神经GCMextends these to probabilistic forecasting via a diffusion architecture, outperforming the ensemble system on 97.2% of targets. NeuralGCM(Kochkov et al., 2024)将学习的参数化集成到可微分的大气环流模型中，产生热带气旋等突发现象，并说明机械结构与学习组件耦合的价值。 极光integrates learned parameterizations within a differentiable general circulation model, producing emergent phenomena such as tropical cyclones and illustrating the value of coupling mechanistic structure with learned components. Aurora(Bodnar et al., 2025)进一步将该范式扩展到地球系统的基础模型，以大幅降低的计算成本在多个预测任务中实现强大的性能。 在分子科学中，神经网络势由further scales this paradigm to a foundation model of the Earth system, achieving strong performance across multiple forecasting tasks at substantially reduced computational cost. In molecular science, neural network potentials pioneered byBehler and Parrinello (2007)使分子动力学的密度泛函理论实现了数量级的加速，为所有后续的机器学习领域奠定了基础。enabled orders-of-magnitude speedup over density functional theory for molecular dynamics, establishing the foundation for all subsequent ML fields.

决策模拟。Decision simulation.

世界模型通过在计算机中模拟实验决策循环来降低科学发现的成本。 代表性系统跨越分子设计（ChemBO；World models reduce the cost of scientific discovery by simulating the experimental decision loop in-silico. Representative systems span molecular design (ChemBO;Korovina et al. 2020）、基于群体的模型集成和元级搜索重新分配的生物序列优化（P3BO；), biological sequence optimization with population-based model ensembles and meta-level search reallocation (P3BO;Angermueller et al. 2020），以及由用户定义的算法目标引导的材料发现（BAX；), and materials discovery guided by user-defined algorithmic objectives (BAX;Chitturi et al. 2024）。 在这些系统中，该模型不仅模拟个体结果，还模拟实验选择的顺序过程，维护和更新对候选者的信念，同时识别优化过程中的不一致之处。 然而，这些功能仍然局限于固定的数据范围：模型无法主动设计和执行实验来获取). Across these systems, the model simulates not only individual outcomes but the sequential process of experiment selection, maintaining and updating beliefs over candidates while identifying inconsistencies during optimization. However, these capabilities remain confined to a fixed data regime: the model cannot actively design and execute experiments to acquire新信息new information这挑战了其当前的假设。 因此，虽然此类系统可以纠正优化错误，但它们无法解决因知识不完整而产生的不确定性，从而导致长期累积的偏差。 L3 世界模型（部分that challenges its current assumptions. As a result, while such systems can correct optimization errors, they cannot resolve uncertainty arising from incomplete knowledge, leading to accumulated bias over long horizons. L3 world models (Section5）通过积极收集证据来修改模型来克服这个问题。) overcome this by actively gathering evidence to revise the model.

4.2.5 跨域分析Cross-Domain Analysis

图Figure8将四种制度沿着两个诊断轴定位：控制约束的形式化和可观察性。在所有四种制度中，出现了一个反复出现的模式：一个好的模拟器不必看起来更像世界；而是一个好的模拟器。它看起来一定更像是约束。物理学使用几何/接触约束；软件使用状态机和结构化反馈通道；社会世界使用角色/规范的一致性；科学使用证据链和可证伪性。使约束变得明确（可记录、可重放、可回归）通常比提高感知保真度更能提高长期稳定性。表positions the four regimes along two diagnostic axes: formalizability and observability of the governing constraints. Across all four regimes, a recurring pattern emerges: a good Simulator does not have to look more like the world; it must look more like the constraints. Physics uses geometry/contact constraints; software uses state machines and structured feedback channels; social worlds use role/norm consistency; science uses evidence chains and falsifiability. Making constraints explicit (loggable, replayable, regressable) often improves long-horizon stability more than increasing perceptual fidelity. Table7总结了每个制度的管辖法律、状态类型、常见失效模式和评估重点。summarizes the governing laws, state types, common failure modes, and evaluation focus for each regime.

跨政权系统。Cross-regime systems.

许多现实世界的部署并不完全属于单一的管辖法律制度；相反，他们需要一个 L2 模拟器来保持一致的部署Many real-world deployments do not fall neatly into a single governing-law regime; instead, they require an L2 simulator to maintain coherent rollouts across多个multiple同时约束家庭。当制度相互作用时，一个领域的违规行为可能会蔓延到另一个领域：物理上不可信的车辆操纵可能会使社会意图预测变得毫无意义，或者软件错误可能会使原本合理的实验计划失效。因此，设计和评估跨制度系统需要联合约束满足，而不是孤立地评估每个制度。constraint families simultaneously. When regimes interact, a violation in one domain can cascade into another: a physically implausible vehicle maneuver may render a social-intent prediction meaningless, or a software bug may invalidate an otherwise sound experimental plan. Designing and evaluating cross-regime systems therefore demands joint constraint satisfaction rather than per-regime evaluation in isolation.

  • •

    自动驾驶：Autonomous driving:物理（车辆动力学、接触力学）+社会（行人意图预测、交通规范合规性）physical (vehicle dynamics, contact mechanics) + social (pedestrian intent prediction, traffic norm compliance)(Hu et al., 2023; Wang et al., 2024h).

  • •

    Minecraft 代理（Voyager）：Minecraft agents (Voyager):物理（3D 导航、战斗动态）+数字（制作配方、库存管理、游戏状态逻辑）physical (3D navigation, combat dynamics) + digital (crafting recipes, inventory management, game-state logic)(Wang et al., 2024b).

  • •

    外交（西塞罗）：Diplomacy (CICERO):社交（谈判、信任建模、联盟形成）+数字（游戏状态管理、规则执行）social (negotiation, trust modeling, alliance formation) + digital (game-state management, rule enforcement)(Bakhtin et al., 2022).

  • •

    自主实验室（A-Lab）：Autonomous laboratories (A-Lab):科学（实验设计、假设评估）+物理（样本操作、仪器限制）scientific (experiment design, hypothesis evaluation) + physical (sample manipulation, instrument constraints)(Szymanski et al., 2023; Boiko et al., 2023).

4.3 失效模式Failure Modes

在所有四个领域中，五种重复出现的故障模式限制了 L2 系统：Across all four domains, five recurring failure modes constrain L2 systems:

  1. 1.

    复合错误。Compounding error.随着时间的推移，每一步的微小偏差会被放大，将想象的轨迹推向与现实越来越无关的分支。最有效的缓解措施不是让一步预测看起来更好，而是使用多时间尺度结构缩短有效计划窗口（将长任务分解为可验证的短片段，并根据真实反馈频繁重新计划）Small per-step deviations are amplified over time, pushing imagined trajectories into branches increasingly unrelated to reality. The most effective mitigations are not making one-step predictions look better, but shortening effective planning windows (decomposing long tasks into verifiable short segments and replanning frequently with real feedback), using multi-timescale structure(Shaj et al., 2023)，并将证据收集行动纳入政策。, and baking evidence-gathering actions into policies.

  2. 2.

    状态混叠和漂移。State aliasing and drift.在复杂的环境中，不同的真实状态可能看起来非常相似（两个 UI 页面、略有不同的厨房布局或社交语气中的一个词的变化）。当表征瓦解这些状态时，特工可能会采取不可逆转的错误行动。有效的实践包括关键节点的显式验证、记忆和检索增强以及显式的故障归因标签In complex environments, distinct real states can look highly similar (two UI pages, slightly different kitchen layouts, or a one-word change in social tone). When representations collapse these states, agents can take irreversible wrong actions. Effective practices include explicit verification at key nodes, memory and retrieval augmentation, and explicit failure attribution labels(Xie et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2025a; Nasiriany et al., 2024).

  3. 3.

    可控性失效。Controllability failure.与响应动作的粗略模型相比，动作条件较弱的视觉丰富模型对于规划的用处较小。当模型对动作不敏感时，比较“做 A 与做 B”就变得毫无意义A visually rich model that is weakly action-conditioned is less useful for planning than a rough model that responds to actions. When the model is action-insensitive, comparing “do A vs. do B” becomes meaningless(Wu et al., 2024c; Liu et al., 2025; Brooks et al., 2024; Ball et al., 2025).

  4. 4.

    可利用性和模拟器逃逸。Exploitability and simulator escape.如果模拟器或评估工具存在漏洞，搜索/规划将系统地利用它们。这在软件世界和自动评估中尤其常见If a simulator or evaluation harness has loopholes, search/planning will exploit them systematically. This is especially common in software worlds and automated evaluation(Xie et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2025a; Zheng et al., 2025c).

  5. 5.

    分布偏移下校准失败。Calibration failure under distribution shift.环境变化（UI 版本、布局、重音、对象属性）常常会引发过度自信的错误预测。在实践中，自信但错误应该被视为进化的强烈信号Environment changes (UI versions, layouts, accents, object properties) often trigger overconfident wrong predictions. In practice, confident but wrong should be treated as a strong signal for evolution(Xie et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2025a; Nasiriany et al., 2024).

这些失败不仅仅是模型的缺陷，也是模型的缺陷。它们是由代表性、推广范围、控制程序和证据质量之间相互作用产生的系统级病症。结论是，除非系统能够（i）通过证据定位故障以及（ii）在转变和利用压力下改变行为，否则改善平均情况预测是不够的。These failures are not merely model shortcomings; they are system-level pathologies produced by the interaction between representation, rollout horizon, control procedure, and evidence quality. The takeaway is that improving average-case predictions is insufficient unless systems can (i) localize failures via evidence and (ii) change behavior under shift and exploit pressure.

这种约束优先的视角对于选择记录内容和回归测试内容也是一个有用的指南。如果违反核心约束（例如，不可能的行动成功，或者结构化反馈渠道消失），代理将学到错误的教训。相反，当约束明确且稳定时，即使是简单的代理也可以通过 Evolver 式的资产蒸馏进行可靠的改进This constraints-first lens is also a useful guide for choosing what to log and what to regress-test. If the core constraint is violated (e.g., impossible action succeeds, or a structured feedback channel disappears), the agent will learn the wrong lessons. Conversely, when constraints are explicit and stable, even simple agents can improve reliably via Evolver-style asset distillation(Xie et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2025a; Nasiriany et al., 2024; Zheng et al., 2025c; Ghugare et al., 2025).

5 L3 Evolver：证据驱动模型修订L3 Evolver: Evidence-Driven Model Revision

科学发现自然地组织成一个循环：研究人员Scientific discovery is naturally organized as a loop: a researcher设计designs实验，experiments,执行executes他们，them,观察observes结果，以及outcomes, and反映reflects来指导下一步。 最近的系统实现了这一过程的一个或多个组件，但许多系统在没有完全自主的循环的情况下运行。 决策模拟器（部分to guide the next step. Recent systems realize one or more components of this process, but many operate without a fully autonomous loop. Decision simulators (Section4.2.4）操作范围内) operate within the设计design步骤：他们模拟实验结果并更新信念，但所有更新都发生在固定的信息范围内，而无需主动收集数据。 另一方面，基于强化学习的自我反思系统，例如 VL-Rethinkerstep: they simulate experimental outcomes and update beliefs, but all updates occur within a fixed information regime without active data collection. At the other end, RL-based self-reflection systems such as VL-Rethinker(Wang et al., 2025c)实现realize the反映reflect逐步执行明确的验证和重新思考行为，但不维护持久的世界模型堆栈。 许多自动化研究管道step through explicit verify-and-rethink behavior, but do not maintain a persistent world-model stack. Many automated research pipelines(Yang et al., 2024c; Li et al., 2024c)链条chain设计design和and反映reflect（假设生成和文献综合）但缺乏(hypothesis generation and literature synthesis) but lack the执行execute和and观察observe将关闭整个循环的组件。components that would close the full loop.

L3 的主要区别在于如何获取和使用新信息。 L3 系统不是被动地拟合传入数据或利用固定模型进行规划，而是主动设计干预措施以减少其自身世界模型的不确定性。 在统一视图中The key distinction of L3 lies in how new information is acquired and used. Rather than passively fitting incoming data or exploiting a fixed model for planning, an L3 system actively designs interventions to reduce uncertainty in its own world model. In the unified view of Figure7，本次修正是垂直的, this revision is the vertical反映reflect连接顶部块的箭头（模型arrow that connects the top block (modelℳt\mathcal{M}_{t}运行环境operating over environment𝒳\mathcal{X}）到底部块（修改后的模型) to the bottom block (revised modelℳt+1\mathcal{M}_{t+1}在有效的环境中运作operating over an effective environment𝒳′\mathcal{X}^{\prime})：循环的每次迭代都会修改 L2 推出的潜在图。 循环的每次迭代都针对预测和观察之间的差异，使用它们来细化参数、扩展模型结构或修改基本假设。 从这个意义上说，L3 的驱动因素不仅仅是奖励最大化，而是通过在设计、执行和反思的多次迭代中积累的证据来系统地减少模型的不确定性。): each iteration of the loop modifies the latent graph that L2 rolls out on. Each iteration of the loop targets discrepancies between prediction and observation, using them to refine parameters, extend model structure, or revise underlying assumptions. In this sense, L3 is driven not by reward maximization alone, but by the systematic reduction of model uncertainty through evidence accumulated across many iterations of design, execution, and reflection.

元学习范式，特别是“学会学习”The meta-learning paradigm, notably “learning to learn”(Andrychowicz et al., 2016)它将优化器设计本身视为一个学习问题，预示着这种自我修正能力：系统改进自己的学习过程，而不仅仅是拟合数据。 L3 将这一原则从参数优化扩展到世界模型修订。其结果是世界建模下一阶段的范例：系统不仅可以模拟，而且可以自行进化，获得持续学习和自我修正的能力。在代理上下文中，这意味着代理的世界模型不再是推理时消耗的静态工件；相反，它成为一个好奇的活体组件，可以诊断自身的故障，设计有针对性的实验来解决歧义，并将所得证据提炼为持久的模型更新。这种自我进化的代理代表了从 L2（模型是用于规划的固定工具）到 L3（模型本身是由其自身部署经验驱动的持续改进对象）的质变。, which casts optimizer design itself as a learning problem, foreshadows this self-revision capability: a system improves its own learning procedure rather than merely fitting data. L3 extends this principle from parameter optimization to world-model revision. The result is a paradigm for the next stage of world modeling: systems that not only simulate but also evolve by themselves, acquiring continual learning and self-revision capabilities. In an agent context, this means that the agent’s world model is no longer a static artifact consumed at inference time; instead, it becomes a curious living component that diagnoses its own failures, designs targeted experiments to resolve ambiguities, and distills the resulting evidence into persistent model updates. Such self-evolving agents represent a qualitative shift from L2, where the model is a fixed tool for planning, to L3, where the model itself is the object of continual improvement driven by its own deployment experience.

5.1 正式定义Formal Definition

L3 将 L2 从固定信息范围内的模拟扩展到L3 extends L2 from simulation within a fixed information regime to闭环、证据驱动的模型修订closed-loop, evidence-driven model revision。 总之，L3 系统是通过实现整个设计-执行-观察-反思循环来定义的，在这个循环中，主动获取新的证据来挑战和修改模型。. In summary, L3 systems are defined by realizing the entire design–execute–observe–reflect loop, in which new evidence is actively acquired to challenge and revise the model across iterations.

形式上，L3 系统维护并更新世界建模堆栈：Formally, an L3 system maintains and updates a world-modeling stack:

ℳt→designat→executeot→observedt→reflectℳt+1\mathcal{M}_{t}\xrightarrow{\text{design}}a_{t}\xrightarrow{\text{execute}}o_{t}\xrightarrow{\text{observe}}d_{t}\xrightarrow{\text{reflect}}\mathcal{M}_{t+1}

哪里whereℳt\mathcal{M}_{t}表示迭代时当前的世界建模堆栈denotes the current world-modeling stack at iterationtt, ata_{t}设计的实验或行动，the designed experiment or action,oto_{t}原始结果，以及the raw outcome, anddtd_{t}用于更新堆栈的蒸馏证据（图the distilled evidence used to update the stack (Figure9).

重要的是，仅此环路的存在不足以建立 L3 功能。 L3 系统的区别在于证据被转化为Importantly, the presence of this loop alone is not sufficient to establish L3 capability. What distinguishes L3 systems is that evidence is translated into持久的、可重用的模型更新persistent, reusable model updates这些在回归检查下得到验证，而不是保留为短暂的、上下文中的调整。模型本身成为改进的对象，而不仅仅是规划的固定基础。that are validated under regression checks, rather than remaining as transient, in-context adjustments. The model itself becomes the object of improvement, not merely a fixed substrate for planning.

这一表述密切反映了科学实践的结构。 科学界可以被视为在共享模型上运行的 L3 系统This formulation closely mirrors the structure of scientific practice. A scientific community can be viewed as an L3 system operating over a shared modelℳt\mathcal{M}_{t}，由既定理论和已知异常组成。 在“正常科学”下, consisting of established theories together with known anomalies. Under “normal science”(Kuhn, 1962)，社区不断更新, the community continuously updatesℳt→ℳt+1\mathcal{M}_{t}\rightarrow\mathcal{M}_{t+1}通过保留底层模型类的增量改进。 当累积的异常超过当前模型的解释能力时，相同的更新过程会产生更实质性的转变，其中结构through incremental refinements that preserve the underlying model class. When accumulated anomalies exceed the explanatory capacity of the current model, the same update process produces a more substantial transition, in which the structure ofℳt\mathcal{M}_{t}它本身被修改，对应于范式的转变。 在这种观点中，渐进式细化和范式转变都是同一证据驱动更新的实例，只是规模不同。itself is revised, corresponding to a paradigm shift. In this view, both gradual refinement and paradigm shifts are instances of the same evidence-driven update, differing only in scale.

实际上，L3 系统的瓶颈通常不是生成候选修复，而是安全地验证它们。多模态批评模型In practice, the bottleneck of an L3 system is typically not generating candidate fixes but validating them safely. Multimodal critic models(Zhang et al., 2025b)和回归门控更新管道and regression-gated update pipelines(Ren et al., 2026; Jimenez et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2024a)为观察和反思阶段提供实用的基础设施。我们引用这些系统并不是作为完整的 L3 范例，而是作为持久更新和验证机制到位后演化设计空间的组件。provide practical infrastructure for the observe and reflect stages. We cite these systems not as full L3 exemplars, but as components of an evolver design space once persistent update and validation mechanisms are in place.

修订触发器和演变政策。Revision triggers and evolution policy.

反映阶段负责决定The reflect stage is responsible for deciding当when和and如何how应当修订世界模式，特别是区分渐进式改进和结构性变革。实际上，这个决定是由两种类型的信号驱动的。 安the world model should be revised, in particular distinguishing between incremental improvement and structural change. In practice, this decision is driven by two types of signals. An异常anomaly表示预测与观察之间的不匹配。虽然许多异常可以通过局部调整来吸收，但当前模型类中无法解决的持续异常揭示了denotes a mismatch between prediction and observation. While many anomalies can be absorbed through local adjustments, persistent anomalies that resist resolution within the current model class reveal an认知差距epistemic gap，表明底层表示或假设空间不足。解决此类差距通常需要对模型进行结构性改变，这对应于范式转变。 在本节的哲学框架中, indicating that the underlying representation or hypothesis space is insufficient. Resolving such gaps typically requires structural changes to the model, corresponding to a paradigm shift. In the philosophical framing of Section2.1，可以吸收的异常对应于拉卡托斯“保护带”（学习参数）内的调整，而暴露认知差距的持续异常则需要改变“硬核”（架构、归纳偏差）。从操作角度来看，这会引发响应的层次结构：小异常通过情节内的在线适应进行处理，持续异常会触发参数更新并提取到模型中，而认知差距则需要进行结构修改，例如引入新模块或扩展假设空间。 迪昂-蒯因整体论（部分, anomalies that can be absorbed correspond to adjustments within Lakatos’s “protective belt” (learned parameters), while persistent anomalies that expose epistemic gaps demand changes to the “hard core” (architecture, inductive biases). In operational terms, this induces a hierarchy of responses: small anomalies are handled via online adaptation within an episode, persistent anomalies trigger parameter updates that are distilled into the model, and epistemic gaps require structural modifications such as introducing new modules or expanding the hypothesis space. Duhem–Quine holism (Section2.1）强调这种归因本质上是不明确的：预测和观察之间的不匹配通常可以通过模型的多个组成部分来解释，包括表示、动态或辅助假设。因此，确定异常是否可以通过当前模型类内的局部更新来解决，或者反映更深层次的认知差距（需要对底层表示进行结构性改变）是非常重要的。) highlights that this attribution is inherently ambiguous: a mismatch between prediction and observation can often be explained by multiple components of the model, including representation, dynamics, or auxiliary assumptions. As a result, it is non-trivial to determine whether an anomaly can be resolved through local updates within the current model class or reflects a deeper epistemic gap that requires structural change to the underlying representation.

这种困难进一步取决于代表的选择。 认知差距通常涉及模型中缺失或不正确的归纳偏差或不变性。 虽然原则上可以通过学习模型的结构变化来解决这些差距，但这些变化通常是间接的：修改架构或训练程序并不能保证模型捕获的底层不变性发生可预测的变化。 相反，符号表示允许明确地表达和操纵这些不变性，如科学定律和原理中所见。 这表明，虽然潜在表征为通过参数更新吸收异常提供了灵活的基础，但解决认知差距可能需要显式暴露和操纵不变性的表征，正如符号科学模型中的标准一样。 我们回到第 1 节中潜在表征和符号表征之间的紧张关系。This difficulty is further shaped by the choice of representation. Epistemic gaps often involve missing or incorrect inductive biases or invariances in the model. While such gaps can, in principle, be addressed through structural changes in learned models, these changes are typically indirect: modifying architecture or training procedures does not guarantee a predictable change in the underlying invariances the model captures. In contrast, symbolic representations allow these invariances to be expressed and manipulated explicitly, as seen in scientific laws and principles. This suggests that while latent representations provide a flexible substrate for absorbing anomalies through parameter updates, resolving epistemic gaps may require representations that expose and manipulate invariances explicitly, as is standard in symbolic scientific models. We return to this tension between latent and symbolic representations in Section2.2.

5.2 与L2的区别Distinction from L2

我们用三个边界条件来标记L2We use three boundary conditions to mark L2→\rightarrowL3，每个对应于设计-执行-观察-反映循环中的一个转换：L3, each corresponding to a transition in the design–execute–observe–reflect loop:

  1. 1.

    主动信息扩展（Active information expansion (ℳt→et\mathcal{M}_{t}\rightarrow e_{t})：系统设计的实验主动探索不确定性或挑战其当前的信念，而不仅仅是在现有知识范围内进行优化。: the system designs experiments that actively probe uncertainty or challenge its current belief, rather than only optimizing within existing knowledge.

  2. 2.

    自主执行和观察（Autonomous execution and observation (et→dte_{t}\rightarrow d_{t})：系统通过交互进行实验并获取证据，而不是依赖模拟或预先存在的数据。: the system carries out experiments and acquires evidence through interaction, rather than relying on simulated or pre-existing data.

  3. 3.

    挑战下的信念修正（Belief revision under challenge (dt→ℳt+1d_{t}\rightarrow\mathcal{M}_{t+1})：观察结果用于反思和修改模型，包括更新参数、结构或资产，从而纠正先前的假设。: observations are used to reflect on and revise the model, including updating parameters, structure, or assets, enabling correction of prior assumptions.

上述边界条件可以统一为一个原则：世界模型在部署过程中是保持固定还是变为可塑的。 这种从L2到L3的转变体现在三个方面：模型在部署后是否可以更新其参数和结构，如何随着时间的推移积累新的能力，以及它是被动消耗数据还是通过实验主动生成数据。The boundary conditions above can be unified as a single principle: whether the world model remains fixed or becomes plastic during deployment. This transition from L2 to L3 manifests in three aspects: whether the model can update its parameters and structure after deployment, how it accumulates new capabilities over time, and whether it passively consumes data or actively generates it through experimentation.

固定与自适应。Fixed vs. adaptive.

L2 模拟器通常是在训练后固定的。它可以根据其训练数据生成无限的 rollouts，但其核心转换函数An L2 simulator is typically fixed post-training. It can generate infinite rollouts based on its training data, but its core transition functionpθ​(zt∣zt−1,at)p_{\theta}(z_{t}\mid z_{t-1},a_{t})不进化；它探索了其冻结知识的含义。相比之下，L3 系统是自适应部署后的：它将自己的参数或结构视为要更新的假设，即does not evolve; it explores the implications of its frozen knowledge. In contrast, an L3 system is adaptive post-deployment: it treats its own parameters or structure as a hypothesis to be updated, i.e.ℳt+1←ℳt+Evidence\mathcal{M}_{t+1}\leftarrow\mathcal{M}_{t}+\text{Evidence}.

增长模式。Modes of growth.

L3 增长超越了简单的数据缓冲，包含三种不同的模式：L3 growth goes beyond simple data buffering and encompasses three different modes:

  • •

    参数更新Parameter update：通过梯度下降或贝叶斯更新新证据来修改权重，例如在线学习、持续强化学习微调和贝叶斯模型更新。: modifying weights via gradient descent or Bayesian updates on new evidence, e.g., online learning, continual RL fine-tuning, and Bayesian model updates.

  • •

    架构更新Architecture update：动态添加新模块、专家或处理复杂性的能力，例如，扩展上下文窗口或分配新的内存插槽。: dynamically adding new modules, experts, or capacity to handle complexity, for example, expanding the context window or allocating new memory slots.

  • •

    假设空间扩展Hypothesis-space expansion：扩展模型类来表示以前无法表达的解释。这对应于引入新的变量、机制或抽象，从“我不知道其中哪一个: extending the model class to represent explanations that were previously inexpressible. This corresponds to introducing new variables, mechanisms, or abstractions, shifting from “I don’t know which of thesekk选项为真”到“正确的解释不在当前选项之中”options is true” to “the correct explanation is not among the currentkk选项。”这是最具挑战性的模式，与绑架和真正的科学发现密切相关。options.” This is the most challenging mode and is closely tied to abduction and genuine scientific discovery.

被动与主动。Passive vs. active.

虽然 L2 系统可能支持被动在线学习（更新传入数据流的权重）或决策模拟（第 1 节）While L2 systems may support passive online learning (updating weights on a stream of incoming data) or decision simulating (Section4.2.4），L3的特点是), L3 is characterized by活跃的active 试错循环trial-and-error loop。 它不只是等待数据；而是等待数据。它的作用是生成数据，最大限度地提高有关特定假设或不确定性领域的信息增益。这种积极的立场将代理人从经验的消费者转变为实验的设计者，这是一种质的转变，与溯因哲学和科学方法直接相关（第 1 节）. It does not just wait for data; it acts to generate data that maximizes information gain regarding a specific hypothesis or area of uncertainty. This active stance transforms the agent from a consumer of experience to a designer of experiments, a qualitative shift that connects directly to the philosophy of abduction and scientific method (Section2.1）。 L3 不应通过一般规划意义上的闭环使用来定义；相反，它是通过关闭证据到修订循环来定义的，以便部署结果用于在连续的使用迭代中诊断、更新和验证世界建模堆栈本身。). L3 should not be defined by closed-loop use in the generic planning sense; rather, it is defined by closing the evidence-to-revision loop, so that deployment outcomes are used to diagnose, update, and validate the world-modeling stack itself over successive iterations of use.

5.3 示例和应用Examples and Applications

L3 在高度仪器化、提供快速反馈并提供明确定义的评估标准的领域中最容易处理。 对 L3 的经验支持在各个领域并不均衡：自主科学和其他高度仪器化的环境提供了最清晰的演示，而社会、代码和具体环境仍然部分是经验的，部分是前瞻性的设计空间。 我们在图 4 中展示了四种管辖法律制度中的这种情况，以及每种情况下的特征证据信号和故障模式。L3 is most tractable in domains that are highly instrumented, offer rapid feedback, and provide well-defined evaluation criteria. Empirical support for L3 is uneven across domains: autonomous science and other highly instrumented settings provide the clearest demonstrations, whereas social, code, and embodied environments remain partly empirical and partly prospective design space. We illustrate this landscape, together with the characteristic evidence signals and failure modes in each, across four governing-law regimes in Figure10.

身体智力。Physical intelligence.

在具体设置中，L3 表现为自适应探测来推断和更新动态模型。当机器人遇到意外的接触动力学时，例如光滑的表面或可变形的物体，系统可以主动执行诊断操作（旨在消除有关接触模型的假设之间歧义的小扰动），并使用所得证据来更新其动力学模型。这种情况下的异常信号本质上是物理的：力/扭矩偏差、意外接触事件以及预测和观察到的末端执行器轨迹之间的差异为模型更新提供了定量证据。最近的工作表明，机器人可以自主检测物理损伤并重新训练持久的自我模型：In embodied settings, L3 manifests as adaptive probing to infer and update dynamics models. When a robot encounters unexpected contact dynamics, such as a slippery surface or a deformable object, the system can actively execute diagnostic actions (small perturbations designed to disambiguate between hypotheses about the contact model) and use the resulting evidence to update its dynamics model. The anomaly signals in this regime are inherently physical: force/torque deviations, unexpected contact events, and discrepancies between predicted and observed end-effector trajectories provide quantitative evidence for model updates. Recent work demonstrates that robots can autonomously detect physical damage and re-train persistent self-models:Hu et al. (2025b)表明以自我为中心的视觉自我模型通过预测与观察的不匹配来检测形态变化，并重新训练以恢复运动。适应模拟show that an egocentric visual self-model detects morphology changes via prediction-versus-observation mismatch and re-trains to recover locomotion. AdaptSim(Ren et al., 2023)元学习一种适应策略，该策略根据少量的现实世界任务性能数据迭代地修改模拟参数，通过证据驱动的模拟修正而不是固定域随机化来缩小模拟与真实的差距，每个现实世界的部署都会通知下一轮模拟更新（参见附录）meta-learns an adaptation policy that iteratively revises simulation parameters from small amounts of real-world task performance data, closing the sim-to-real gap through evidence-driven simulation revision rather than fixed domain randomization, with each real-world deployment informing the next round of simulation updates (see AppendixD一个有效的身体智力示例）。for a worked physical-intelligence example).

数字智能。Digital intelligence.

软件和 Web 环境自然适合 L3，因为状态是完全可观察的，操作是确定性可重放的，并且回归测试提供了内置的验证门。评估者驱动的发现循环就是这种制度的例证。Software and web environments are naturally suited to L3 because state is fully observable, actions are deterministically replayable, and regression testing provides a built-in validation gate. Evaluator-driven discovery loops exemplify this regime.Romera-Paredes et al. (2024)在进化循环中将预训练的法学硕士与自动评估器配对：法学硕士生成候选程序，评估器根据正式规范对其进行评分，然后反馈高分解决方案以进一步完善。该循环发现了上限集问题（组合学中长期存在的开放问题）的新结构以及优于已知基线的新装箱启发法。评估器充当自动回归门，这是一个关键的 L3 属性，尽管系统仅实现设计和观察组件（程序生成和自动评分），而没有主动信息扩展或持久模型修订。pair a pretrained LLM with an automated evaluator in an evolutionary loop: the LLM generates candidate programs, the evaluator scores them against a formal specification, and high-scoring solutions are fed back for further refinement. This loop discovered new constructions for the cap set problem (a long-standing open problem in combinatorics) and new bin-packing heuristics that outperform known baselines. The evaluator serves as an automated regression gate, a key L3 property, although the system realizes only the design and observe components (program generation and automated scoring) without active information expansion or persistent model revision.Novikov et al. (2025)扩展了这种进化编码范式：通过将 LLM 生成的程序突变与自动正确性评估器配对，该系统在 56 年后改进了 Strassen 的矩阵乘法算法，并解决了超出现有技术水平的 20% 的开放数学问题，展示了形式验证作为算法领域中的 L3 看门人的力量。代码它extend this evolutionary coding paradigm: by pairing LLM-generated program mutations with automated correctness evaluators, the system improved on Strassen’s matrix multiplication algorithm after 56 years and solved 20% of open mathematical problems beyond the prior state of the art, illustrating the power of formal verification as an L3 gatekeeper in algorithmic domains. CodeIt(Butt et al., 2024)闭合一个更紧密的循环：法学硕士通过优先的事后重播从其自己的搜索轨迹进行微调，以便生成模型本身（作为程序空间的隐式世界模型）在任务中持续改进。 AI 科学家-v2closes a tighter loop: the LLM is fine-tuned from its own search trajectories via prioritized hindsight replay, so that the generative model itself (serving as an implicit world model of program space) persistently improves across tasks. The AI Scientist-v2(Yamada et al., 2025)通过采用代理树搜索进行实验选择，进一步推进计算实验：系统自主制定假设、设计和执行实验、分析结果并撰写完整的手稿。 VLM 反馈循环迭代地完善图形和内容。 2025 年，该系统生成了一篇完全由人工智能生成的论文，并在 ICLR 研讨会上通过了同行评审。然而，该系统的实验是计算性的（运行机器学习训练作业），其修订循环根据论文质量而不是机械理解进行操作，这说明了仪器仪表齐全的计算领域中的 L3 与真正的科学发现的更艰巨的挑战之间的差距。 在 AUI 中pushes further into computational experiments by employing agentic tree search for experiment selection: the system autonomously formulates hypotheses, designs and executes experiments, analyzes results, and writes complete manuscripts. A VLM feedback loop iteratively refines figures and content. In 2025, this system produced an entirely AI-generated paper that passed peer review at an ICLR workshop. However, the system’s experiments are computational (running ML training jobs), and its revision loop operates on paper quality rather than mechanistic understanding, illustrating the gap between L3 in well-instrumented computational domains and the harder challenge of genuine scientific discovery. In AUI(Lin et al., 2025a)，编码器-计算机使用代理循环在网站中实例化了这一原理：编码器迭代地修改网站实现，而 CUA 通过执行任务轨迹和验证功能正确性（例如，导航成功和任务完成）充当自动评估器。由此产生的反馈基于可执行交互而不是静态检查，作为回归信号指导后续代码更新，形成与 L3 属性一致的闭环优化过程。, a Coder–Computer-Use Agent loop instantiates this principle in website: the Coder iteratively revises website implementations, while the CUA acts as an automated evaluator by executing task trajectories and verifying functional correctness (e.g., navigation success and task completion). The resulting feedback, grounded in executable interactions rather than static inspection, serves as a regression signal that guides subsequent code updates, forming a closed-loop optimization process aligned with L3 properties.

社会智力。Social intelligence.

当其他智能体的预测行为偏离观察到的行为时，社交领域的 L3 需要修改智能体的社交模型，例如，当心理理论预测系统性失败或当社会规范随着时间的推移而发生变化时。这是目前 L3 最难的制度，因为归因本质上是不明确的（失败的社会预测可能反映了对其他智能体目标的错误信念、过时的规范模型或随机行为），而且社会实验受到道德约束。关于多主体群体中规范出现和惯例形成的早期工作（第L3 in social domains requires revising the agent’s social model when predicted behavior of other agents deviates from observed behavior, for example, when Theory-of-Mind predictions fail systematically or when social norms drift over time. This is currently the hardest regime for L3 because attribution is inherently ambiguous (a failed social prediction may reflect incorrect beliefs about the other agent’s goals, an outdated norm model, or stochastic behavior) and because social experiments are ethically constrained. Early work on norm emergence and convention formation in multi-agent populations (Section4.2.3）代表了迈向社交 L3 的初步步骤，但根据部署证据对社交世界模型进行持续、经过验证的修订仍然在很大程度上处于开放状态。迈向社交 L3 的第一步是多智能体治理规则的进化综合：) represents a preliminary step toward social L3, but persistent, validated revision of social world models from deployment evidence remains largely open. A preliminary step toward social L3 is the evolutionary synthesis of multi-agent governance rules:Kumar et al. (2026)使用法学硕士驱动的遗传编程根据社会稳定性评分演化出可解释的宪法，比人类设计的规则高出 123%。use LLM-driven genetic programming to evolve interpretable constitutions from societal stability scores, surpassing human-designed rules by 123%.

科学情报。Scientific intelligence.

目前最完整的 L3 示例来自自主科学，其中完整的设计-执行-观察-反映循环由仪器封闭。 自主闭环科学发现范式由机器人科学家 Adam 建立The most complete current examples of L3 come from autonomous science, where the full design–execute–observe–reflect loop is closed by instrumentation. The paradigm of autonomous closed-loop scientific discovery was established by Robot Scientist Adam(Sparkes et al., 2010)，第一台自主设计基因功能实验、执行实验、观察结果并修改模型的机器。其后续系统展示了酵母系统生物学中实验设计、执行和模型修订的闭环循环，加速了生物模型的开发, the first machine to autonomously design experiments about gene function, execute them, observe the outcomes, and revise its model. Its successor system demonstrated closed-loop cycles of experiment design, execution, and model revision in yeast systems biology, accelerating biological model development(Coutant et al., 2019)。 客串. CAMEO(Kusne et al., 2020)通过贝叶斯主动学习在同步加速器光束线上实现闭环材料发现：系统预测候选成分将形成哪个相，对其进行合成，通过 X 射线衍射表征产品，更新其贝叶斯置信模型，并主动选择下一个实验以最大化信息增益。每个实验周期需要几秒到几分钟的时间，系统无需额外的人工训练就发现了一种新颖的相变存储材料。 A-实验室implements closed-loop materials discovery via Bayesian active learning at a synchrotron beamline: the system predicts which phase a candidate composition will form, synthesizes it, characterizes the product via X-ray diffraction, updates its Bayesian belief model, and actively selects the next experiment to maximize information gain. Each experimental cycle takes seconds to minutes, and the system discovered a novel phase-change memory material without additional human training. A-Lab(Szymanski et al., 2023)将其扩展到完全自主的合成：三个机械臂自动进行粉末定量、加热和 XRD 表征，并在目标失败时使用主动学习算法生成改进的配方。在17天的闭环运行中，A-Lab进行了353次实验，从57个目标中实现了36种化合物。至关重要的是，对失败合成的分析为完善未来的合成策略提供了结构化证据；失败并没有被丢弃，而是被提炼成持久的知识。extends this to fully autonomous synthesis: three robotic arms automate powder dosing, heating, and XRD characterization, with an active-learning algorithm generating improved recipes when targets fail. In 17 days of closed-loop operation, A-Lab performed 353 experiments and realized 36 compounds from 57 targets. Crucially, analysis of failed syntheses provided structured evidence to refine future synthesis strategies; the failures were not discarded but distilled into persistent knowledge.Strieth-Kalthoff et al. (2024)将自动驾驶实验室范式扩展到分布式、多站点操作：离域 SDL 通过根据地理上分离的设施的合成和表征数据迭代更新贝叶斯代理，自主发现新型有机激光发射器。细菌人工智能extend the self-driving laboratory paradigm to distributed, multi-site operation: a delocalized SDL autonomously discovers novel organic laser emitters by iteratively updating a Bayesian surrogate from synthesis and characterization data across geographically separated facilities. BacterAI(Dama et al., 2023)证明 L3 可以在零先验生物学知识的情况下运行：系统迭代地设计和执行实验来绘制微生物氨基酸需求，纯粹根据实验证据修改其代谢模型。 在计算化学领域，MOOSE-Chemdemonstrates that L3 can operate with zero prior biological knowledge: the system iteratively designs and executes experiments to map microbial amino acid requirements, revising its metabolic model purely from experimental evidence. In computational chemistry, MOOSE-Chem(Yang et al., 2025e)证明基于 LLM 的框架可以仅使用 2024 年之前的文献重新发现 2024 年在《自然》和《科学》上发表的化学假设，这提供了 L3 循环的假设生成组件对于自然科学领域已经可行的证据。其后继者 MOOSE-Chem2demonstrates that an LLM-based framework can rediscover chemistry hypotheses published in Nature and Science in 2024 using only pre-2024 literature, providing evidence that the hypothesis-generation component of the L3 loop is already feasible for natural-science domains. Its successor, MOOSE-Chem2(Yang et al., 2025d)，引入了对细粒度假设组件的分层搜索，以提高所生成发现的精度和新颖性。附录, introduces hierarchical search over fine-grained hypothesis components to improve both precision and novelty of generated discoveries. AppendixD介绍了涵盖所有四种制度的有效示例。 更广泛的代理系统正在将 L3 环路进一步推向生物医学领域。比奥姆尼presents worked examples spanning all four regimes. Broader agentic systems are pushing the L3 loop further into biomedicine. Biomni(Huang et al., 2025a)提供通用生物医学人工智能代理，集成了跨越 25 个子领域的 100 多种工具和 59 个数据库，能够自主执行从因果基因优先级排序到药物重新利用的任务。生物实验室provides a general-purpose biomedical AI agent that integrates over 100 tools and 59 databases spanning 25 subfields, enabling autonomous execution of tasks from causal gene prioritization to drug repurposing. BioLab(Jin et al., 2025)通过基于生物基础模型构建的多智能体系统，将其扩展到端到端自主生命科学研究。奥瑞基因extends this to end-to-end autonomous life-sciences research via a multi-agent system built on biological foundation models. OriGene(Zhang et al., 2025i)展示了一个自我进化的虚拟疾病生物学家，通过迭代假设细化自主发现治疗靶点。 AI联合科学家系统demonstrates a self-evolving virtual disease biologist that autonomously discovers therapeutic targets through iterative hypothesis refinement. The AI co-scientist system(Gottweis et al., 2025)采用生成-辩论-进化的方法来生成假设，并采用多智能体锦标赛流程，该流程已在药物重新利用和表观遗传靶标发现中得到验证。补充这些系统，employs a generate–debate–evolve approach to hypothesis generation, with multi-agent tournament processes that have been validated in drug repurposing and epigenetic target discovery. Complementing these systems,Yang et al. (2026)引入一个动态基准，揭示当前的法学硕士在真正的生物学知识推导方面仍然存在不足，强调了文献检索和真正更新底层模型的真正的 L3 修订之间持续存在的差距。introduce a dynamic benchmark revealing that current LLMs still fall short on genuine biological knowledge derivation, underscoring the persistent gap between literature retrieval and true L3 revision that actually updates the underlying model.

证据质量和可证伪性。Evidence quality and falsifiability.

进化的质量取决于证据的质量。表The quality of evolution depends on the quality of evidence. Table9组织在每个治理法律制度中触发 L3 模型更新的修订信号：代理检测到的内容、为什么它表明当前模型是错误的以及信号的可证伪性如何。organizes the revision signals that trigger L3 model updates in each governing-law regime: what the agent detects, why it indicates the current model is wrong, and how falsifiable the signal is.

一个有用的原则是优先选择可证伪的证据（第A useful principle is to prefer falsifiable evidence (Section2.1）。结合 DOM 快照、错误代码和操作序列的屏幕截图是可重现和可反驳的； “我认为页面没有加载”不是。人类反馈不应被视为单一的可证伪性类别：主观或偏好反馈的可证伪性较弱，而专家诊断反馈在随后通过测试、实验或结构化评估来检查其主张时，可证伪性较强。 Evolver 的进步取决于使教训可验证，并且在错误时可逆转。此要求直接连接到第 5 节中定义的异常和认知差距触发因素). A screenshot combined with a DOM snapshot, error code, and action sequence is reproducible and refutable; “I think the page didn’t load” is not. Human feedback should not be treated as a single falsifiability class: subjective or preference feedback is weakly falsifiable, whereas expert diagnostic feedback can be strongly falsifiable when its claims are subsequently checked by tests, experiments, or structured evaluation. Evolver’s progress depends on making lessons verifiable, and reversible when wrong. This requirement connects directly to the anomaly and epistemic-gap triggers defined in Section5.1：只有当预测和观察之间的偏差可以从记录的证据中量化时，异常才是可操作的，并且只有当系统可以证明现有假设没有充分解释观察结果时，认知差距才是可识别的。在大规模部署中，证据还必须是可压缩和可索引的。实际系统维护多分辨率证据：紧凑的错误类别与状态指纹和差异摘要相结合以进行快速检索，以及指向较重工件（屏幕截图、DOM 快照、完整日志）的指针以进行深度审计。证据质量还与隐私和安全约束紧密耦合：Evolver 管道必须将持久存储的内容（经过清理的日志、散列指纹）与暂时存储或访问控制后面的内容分开，在保留审计跟踪的同时保护敏感数据: an anomaly is actionable only when the deviation between prediction and observation can be quantified from recorded evidence, and an epistemic gap is recognizable only when the system can demonstrate that no existing hypothesis adequately accounts for the observation. In large-scale deployments, evidence must also be compressible and indexable. Practical systems maintain multi-resolution evidence: a compact error category combined with a state fingerprint and diff summary for fast retrieval, together with pointers to heavier artifacts (screenshots, DOM snapshots, full logs) for deep audits. Evidence quality is also tightly coupled to privacy and safety constraints: an Evolver pipeline must separate what is stored persistently (sanitized logs, hashed fingerprints) from what is kept transient or behind access controls, protecting sensitive data while retaining an audit trail(Xie et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2025a).

持续的自我改进还带来了治理挑战，包括基准过度拟合、知识污染以及将故障错误归因于错误组件。这些风险以及缓解这些风险的实际措施（版本控制、回滚、回归门）将在第 1 节中作为未决问题进行讨论Continuous self-improvement also introduces governance challenges, including benchmark overfitting, knowledge contamination, and misattribution of failures to wrong components. These risks and the practical measures to mitigate them (versioning, rollback, regression gates) are discussed as open problems in Section8.

5.4 L3 背景：成熟度、治理和前景L3 in Context: Maturity, Governance, and Outlook

建立了 L3 进化循环、其领域实例以及证据质量的作用后，我们现在检查其实际状态和含义。本小节解决两个互补的问题：Having established the L3 evolution loop, its domain instantiations, and the role of evidence quality, we now examine its practical status and implications. This subsection addresses two complementary questions:成熟度maturity，即 L3 系统已在各个管辖法律制度中成功实现；和, i.e., where L3 systems have been successfully realized across governing-law regimes; and治理governance，即持续的、自动化的模型修订会产生哪些风险。这些观点共同将 L3 描述为一种建模范式和一个必须在现实世界约束下可靠发展的已部署系统。, i.e., what risks arise from persistent, automated model revision. Together, these perspectives characterize L3 both as a modeling paradigm and as a deployed system that must evolve reliably under real-world constraints.

不同领域的成熟度。Maturity across different domains.

我们总结了四种管辖法律制度的成熟度：We summarize maturity across the four governing-law regimes:

  1. 1.

    科学（已成立）。Scientific (Established).最成熟的机制，提供快速、结构化的反馈、明确的异常信号（假设证伪）和明确的修订目标（替代模型参数、合成配方）The most mature regime, offering fast, structured feedback, unambiguous anomaly signals (hypothesis falsification), and well-defined revision targets (surrogate model parameters, synthesis recipes)(Kusne et al., 2020; Szymanski et al., 2023; Sparkes et al., 2010; Dama et al., 2023)。主要瓶颈：仪器访问和实际数据预算。. Primary bottleneck: instrument access and real-data budget.

  2. 2.

    数字（部分）。Digital (Partial).回归测试提供了自动验证门，但许多系统仍然缺乏主动的信息扩展边界条件Regression testing provides an automated validation gate, but many systems still lack the active information-expansion boundary condition(Romera-Paredes et al., 2024; Novikov et al., 2025; Butt et al., 2024)。主要瓶颈：经常缺乏主动的实验设计。. Primary bottleneck: active experiment design is often absent.

  3. 3.

    物理（新兴）。Physical (Emerging).有希望，但受到归因难度的限制：失败的操作可能源于感知、动力学、驱动或环境变化，并且隔离脆弱的成分需要仔细的实验设计Promising but limited by attribution difficulty: a failed manipulation can stem from perception, dynamics, actuation, or environmental change, and isolating the brittle component requires careful experimental design(Ren et al., 2023; Hu et al., 2025b)。主要瓶颈：感知、动态和驱动方面的故障归因。. Primary bottleneck: failure attribution across perception, dynamics, and actuation.

  4. 4.

    社会（愿望）。Social (Aspirational).社会实验受到道德约束，归因本质上是模糊的，行为的基本事实是嘈杂的Social experiments are ethically constrained, attribution is inherently ambiguous, and behavioral ground truth is noisy(Kumar et al., 2026)。主要瓶颈：归因模糊性和社会实验的伦理约束。. Primary bottleneck: attribution ambiguity and ethical constraints on social experimentation.

治理挑战。Governance challenges.

持续的、自动化的模型修订特别会产生三种治理风险。Three governance risks arise specifically from persistent, automated model revision.基准过度拟合Benchmark overfitting当回归门太接近训练分布时发生；系统学会通过测试而不是真正改进。occurs when the regression gate is too close to the training distribution; the system learns to pass tests rather than improve genuinely.知识污染Knowledge contamination当修订循环包含本身有偏见或敌对性构建的证据时，就会发生这种情况，从而默默地降低 OOD 输入的模型质量。occurs when the revision loop incorporates evidence that is itself biased or adversarially constructed, silently degrading the model on OOD inputs.错误归因级联Misattribution cascades当对一种故障模式的修复无意中降低了另一个组件的性能时，就会发生这种情况；如果没有全面的回归套件，更新的净效果可能是负面的。缓解措施包括独立于训练数据进行刷新的保留探针集、在全面推出之前显示回归的金丝雀部署，以及隔离每次更新的贡献的因果消融。occur when a fix for one failure mode inadvertently degrades another component; without comprehensive regression suites, the net effect of an update can be negative. Mitigations include held-out probe sets that are refreshed independently of training data, canary deployment that surfaces regressions before full rollout, and causal ablations that isolate the contribution of each update.

与各部分的关系Relationship to Sections6和and7.

从评估的角度来看（第From an evaluation perspective (Section6），评估 L3 需要超越单集准确性的协议：关键指标是系统是否在整个修订周期中得到改进), assessing L3 requires protocols that go beyond single-episode accuracy: the key metric is whether the system improves across revision cycleskk不会对保留的探针进行回归。从实施的角度来看（第without regressing on held-out probes. From an implementation perspective (Section7），L3 对系统堆栈（持久存储、重放基础设施、回归工具和回滚机制）提出了最严格的要求，而这些要求在当前架构中通常未得到明确规定。因此，向 L3 方向发展意味着对评估基础设施的投资与对模型能力的投资一样多。), L3 places the heaviest demands on the system stack (persistent storage, replay infrastructure, regression harnesses, and rollback mechanisms) that are often underspecified in current architectures. Building toward L3 therefore means investing in evaluation infrastructure as much as in model capacity.

6 评价Evaluations

评估代理人工智能的世界模型需要超越标准生成指标，转向围绕三个边界条件组织的以决策为中心的协议：长期一致性、干预敏感性和约束一致性。本节首先激发了这种转变（第Evaluating world models for agentic AI requires moving beyond standard generative metrics toward decision-centric protocols organized around three boundary conditions: long-horizon coherence, intervention sensitivity, and constraint consistency. This section first motivates this shift (Section6.1），然后按管辖法律制度绘制基准景观，并为每种条件提供详细的评估协议（第), then maps the benchmark landscape by governing-law regime and provides detailed evaluation protocols for each condition (Section6.2），最后展示了如何), and finally shows how the一样same基准测试可以根据评估协议测试 L1、L2 或 L3（第 1 节）benchmark can test L1, L2, or L3 depending on the evaluation protocol (Section6.3）。针对世界模型的评估表明，即使是前沿模型仍然存在巨大的能力差距，而没有一个基准能够完全捕获感兴趣的空间。如需进一步说明，请参阅附录). World-model-specific evaluations show that even frontier models still suffer from substantial capability gaps, while no single benchmark fully captures the space of interest. For further clarification, AppendixE提供能力覆盖矩阵和最小可重复评估包（MREP）。provides a capability coverage matrix and a Minimal Reproducible Evaluation Package (MREP).

6.1 从以预测为中心到以决策为中心的评估From prediction-centric to decision-centric evaluation

虽然 Fréchet 起始距离 (FID)、Fréchet 视频距离 (FVD)、SSIM 和每像素重建损失等标准生成指标可以捕获感知质量，但它们充其量只是较弱的指标While standard generative metrics such as Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), Fréchet Video Distance (FVD), SSIM, and per-pixel reconstruction loss capture perceptual quality, they are at best weak indicators(Brooks et al., 2024; Ball et al., 2025)代理能力，并为代理一旦嵌入现实世界环境最终必须做出的下游决策提供有限的预测能力。of agentic capability and offer limited predictive power for the downstream decisions an agent must ultimately make once embedded in the real-world environment.

因此，世界模型可以生成视觉上令人信服的卷展，但在规划过程中仍然会因为幻觉的对象动力学、对动作不敏感的过渡或微妙的物理违规而崩溃。这些错误通常对于分发级别的指标来说是不可见的，但对于下游决策来说却是毁灭性的。As a result, a world model can generate visually convincing rollouts while still breaking down during planning because of hallucinated object dynamics, action-insensitive transitions, or subtle physics violations. These errors are often invisible to distribution-level metrics but devastating for downstream decision-making.

根本原因是测量的内容与重要的内容之间不匹配。评估的对象不应该是单步预测The root cause is a mismatch between what is measured and what matters. The object of evaluation should not be a single-step predictionpθ​(zt∣zt−1,at)p_{\theta}(z_{t}\mid z_{t-1},a_{t})孤立地，但in isolation, but the轨迹级推出trajectory-level rollout

p^​(τ∣z0,a1:H,c),τ=(z1,…,zH),\hat{p}(\tau\mid z_{0},a_{1:H},c),\qquad\tau=(z_{1},\ldots,z_{H}),

具体来说，这种推出是否足够可靠，可供规划人员采取行动（第and specifically whether this rollout is reliable enough for a planner to act on (Section4）。诸如平均成功率之类的聚合指标通过掩盖任务实例之间的高方差进一步模糊了情况). Aggregate measures such as mean success rates further obscure the picture by masking high variance across task instances(Agarwal et al., 2021; Henderson et al., 2018).

因此我们围绕这三个方面来组织评估We therefore organize evaluation around the three边界条件boundary conditions那个标记L1that mark L1→\toL2（部分L2 (Section4.1):

  1. 1.

    长视域相干性：Long-horizon coherence:推出仍然可以决策使用rollouts remain decision-usable overHH步骤而不是因错误而降级。steps rather than degrading via error.

    干预敏感性：Intervention sensitivity:反事实编辑（动作或前提变化）会引起稳定且有方向意义的轨迹变化。counterfactual edits (action or premise changes) induce stable and directionally meaningful trajectory changes.

    约束一致性：Constraint consistency:生成的期货尊重目标制度的管辖法律（第generated futures respect the governing laws of the target regime (Section4).

这三个条件适用于第 4 节中介绍的四个管辖法律制度。These three conditions hold across the four governing-law regimes introduced in Section4，它们共同提供了一个共同框架，我们可以在其中组织本节其余部分描述的评估协议、基准分析和报告标准。, and together they give a common framework within which we can organize the evaluation protocols, benchmark analyses, and reporting standards described in the remainder of this section.

世界模型评估最终只有在反映下游决策质量时才有意义。捕捉长期一致性、干预敏感性或约束一致性的基准不仅作为诊断有价值，而且因为这些属性应该转化为更好的计划选择、更少昂贵的无效行动以及在分配转移下更大的任务成功率。因此，相关的桥梁不是“模型看起来真实吗？”但是“模型有效性的提高是否会改变智能体的选择，这种选择的转变是否会反过来改善现实世界的任务结果？”World-model evaluation is ultimately meaningful only insofar as it reflects downstream decision quality. Benchmarks that capture long-horizon coherence, intervention sensitivity, or constraint consistency are valuable not merely as diagnostics, but because these properties should translate into better plan selection, fewer costly invalid actions, and greater task success under distribution shift. The relevant bridge is therefore not “Does the model look realistic?” but “Does improved model validity change what the agent chooses, and does that shift in choice in turn improve real-world task outcomes?”

两个聚合指标将这些条件用于下游决策。的Two aggregate metrics operationalize these conditions for downstream decision-making. The行动成功率Action Success Rate(ASR) 衡量规划者使用世界模型的展示来选择操作在真实环境中实现任务目标的频率：(ASR) measures how often a planner that uses the world model’s rollouts to select actions achieves the task goal in the real environment:

ASR=1N​∑i=1N𝟏​[taski​ succeeds under policy derived from ​p^].\mathrm{ASR}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\mathbf{1}\bigl[\text{task}_{i}\text{ succeeds under policy derived from }\hat{p}\bigr].

的The反事实结果偏差Counterfactual Outcome Deviation(COD) 通过比较两种政策下的推出结果来衡量干预敏感性(COD) measures intervention sensitivity by comparing rollout outcomes under two policiesa1:H(1)a^{(1)}_{1:H}和anda1:H(2)a^{(2)}_{1:H}单个干预步骤有所不同that differ at a single intervention stepkk:

COD​(k)=𝔼​[d​(z^H(1),z^H(2))],\mathrm{COD}(k)=\mathbb{E}\bigl[d\bigl(\hat{z}^{(1)}_{H},\,\hat{z}^{(2)}_{H}\bigr)\bigr],

哪里wheredd是与任务相关的距离（例如，物理任务中的目标状态距离、软件任务中的编辑距离）。当 COD 较低时，世界模型对行动的变化基本上没有反应，这使得它无法为反事实规划提供信息。 ASR 和 COD 共同提供了世界模型质量和下游代理绩效之间更直接的联系：ASR 评估模型是否支持良好决策，而 COD 评估模型是否以有意义的方式响应行动层面的干预。is a task-relevant distance (e.g., goal-state distance in physical tasks, edit distance in software tasks). When COD is low, a world model is largely unresponsive to changes in action, which makes it uninformative for counterfactual planning. Together, ASR and COD provide a more direct link between world-model quality and downstream agentic performance: ASR assesses whether the model supports good decisions, whereas COD assesses whether the model responds in a meaningful way to action-level interventions.

6.2 评估三个边界条件Evaluating the three boundary conditions

没有任何单一的基准可以评估代理人对所有世界规则的掌握程度。由于基准选择在很大程度上决定了实际测试的边界条件，因此我们首先按管辖法律制度勾勒出景观。No single benchmark can evaluate an agent’s mastery of all world rules. Because benchmark selection heavily shapes which boundary conditions are actually tested, we first sketch the landscape by governing-law regime.
