AD-R1(Yan et al., 2026)通过将公正的世界建模与丰富的可能碰撞和越野事件课程相结合，构建了第一个闭环模拟器。builds the first closed-loop simulator by combining impartial world modeling with a rich curriculum of plausible collisions and off-road events.

进一步的工作关注点A further line of work concerns政策微调中policy alignment under fine-tuning而不是单独的基本表示： 阿达WMrather than base representation alone: AdaWM(Wang et al., 2025d)解决 RL 期间的表征退化问题 通过低阶对齐进行微调，保留预先训练的结构，同时 适应新的驾驶政策。这一进展也标志着从 开环场景生成到闭环控制支持，其中动作是 不仅仅是条件变量，还有候选干预措施 执行前必须比较后果。addresses representation degradation during RL fine-tuning via low-rank alignment that preserves pre-trained structure while adapting to new driving policies. This progression also marks a shift from open-loop scene generation to closed-loop control support, where actions are not merely conditioning variables but candidate interventions whose consequences must be compared before execution.

C.2 软件、网络和游戏系统Software, Web, and Game Systems

游戏世界模型。Game world models.

游戏世界在物理和数字智能的交叉点上占据着独特的地位：视觉动力学遵循类似物理的规则（渲染、物体运动、碰撞），但过渡最终由确定性游戏逻辑（分数更新、关卡触发、库存变化）控制。这种重叠使得游戏成为世界模型的天然测试平台，必须将感知预测与基于规则的推理相结合。氮气Game worlds occupy a distinctive position at the intersection of physical and digital intelligence: visual dynamics follow physics-like rules (rendering, object motion, collision), yet transitions are ultimately governed by deterministic game logic (score updates, level triggers, inventory changes). This overlap makes games a natural testbed for world models that must integrate perceptual prediction with rule-based reasoning. NitroGen(Magne et al., 2026)NVIDIA 的开放视觉-动作基础模型经过 1000 多款游戏的 4 万小时游戏训练，通过大规模行为克隆，对未见过的游戏实现了 52% 的改进。 L1 的早期工作，包括 DIAMOND, NVIDIA’s open vision-action foundation model trained on 40K hours of gameplay across 1000+ games, achieves 52% improvement on unseen games via large-scale behavior cloning. Earlier work at L1, including DIAMOND(Alonso et al., 2024)和精灵and Genie(Bruce et al., 2024)（节(Section3），建立逐帧预测； L2 挑战是长视野、动作条件模拟，尊重视觉动态和基本游戏规则。游戏生成器), established frame-by-frame prediction; the L2 challenge is long-horizon, action-conditioned simulation respecting both visual dynamics and underlying game rules. GameNGen(Valevski et al., 2025)证明了在《DOOM》游戏中训练的扩散模型可以作为 20 FPS 的实时神经游戏引擎，生成与原始引擎无法区分的交互式帧。视频游戏demonstrated that a diffusion model trained on DOOM gameplay can serve as a real-time neural game engine at 20 FPS, generating interactive frames indistinguishable from the original engine. Video2Game(Xia et al., 2024)将单个视频转换为具有实时物理和渲染的交互式 3D 游戏环境，将被动视频理解与交互式世界模拟联系起来。在这些领域中，状态包括 DOM 结构、焦点、文件系统和应用程序状态机；跨操作系统的可评估任务converts a single video into an interactive 3D game-like environment with real-time physics and rendering, bridging passive video understanding with interactive world simulation. Across these domains, state includes DOM structure, focus, file system, and application state machines; evaluable tasks span OS(Xie et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2025a), 网络, web(Zhou et al., 2024b; Deng et al., 2023; Yao et al., 2022)，以及软件调试工作流程, and software debugging workflows(Jimenez et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2024a; Shi et al., 2017).

C.3 社会模拟和多代理系统Social Simulation and Multi-Agent Systems

ToM 提示和推理。ToM prompting and reasoning.

结构化提示策略表明社会推理的瓶颈是推理结构而不是知识。符号理论Structured prompting strategies suggest the bottleneck in social reasoning is reasoning structure rather than knowledge. SymbolicToM(Sclar et al., 2023)在每个故事事件之后构建明确的每个角色信念图，通过图遍历支持高达三阶信念（ACL 2023 杰出论文）。模拟仿真软件constructs explicit per-character belief graphs after each story event, supporting up to third-order beliefs through graph traversal (ACL 2023 Outstanding Paper). SimToM(Wilf et al., 2024)受认知科学模拟理论启发，将观点采择作为一个两阶段过程来实现：首先过滤上下文以获取目标角色所知道的内容，然后从过滤后的视图中进行回答。 K级推理implements perspective-taking as a two-stage process inspired by Simulation Theory from cognitive science: first filtering context to what the target character knows, then answering from that filtered view. K-Level Reasoning(Zhang et al., 2025h)在 LLM 中递归地实施行为经济学 Level-K 框架以进行谈判。思维追踪implements the behavioral economics Level-K framework recursively in LLMs for negotiation. Thought-Tracing(Kim et al., 2025)通过类似蒙特卡洛的假设生成实现近似贝叶斯推理，显着优于 o3-mini 等推理模型，这表明社会推理可能需要与数学推导完全不同的计算机制。implements approximate Bayesian inference via Sequential Monte Carlo-like hypothesis generation, significantly outperforming reasoning models like o3-mini, suggesting social reasoning may require fundamentally different computational mechanisms than mathematical deduction.

沙箱架构和规模。Sandbox architectures and scale.

希德计划Project Sid(AL et al., 2024)使用 PIANO 架构（通过神经编排进行并行信息聚合）在 Minecraft 的六个城镇部署了多达 1,000 名代理，这是一种受大脑启发的模块化设计，具有用于认知、规划、运动执行和语音的单独并发模块。新兴现象包括自主专业化、个性驱动的社会网络形成、民主治理和文化传播（包括自发的宗教改变）。 Sotopia 扩展包括 Sotopia-deployed up to 1,000 agents across six towns in Minecraft using the PIANO architecture (Parallel Information Aggregation via Neural Orchestration), a brain-inspired modular design with separate concurrent modules for cognition, planning, motor execution, and speech. Emergent phenomena included autonomous professional specialization, personality-driven social network formation, democratic governance, and cultural transmission including spontaneous religious proselytization. Sotopia extensions include Sotopia-π\pi (Wang et al., 2024e)（社交技能的交互式自我强化学习）和 Lifelong-Sotopia（多片段长期一致性评估）。代理协会(interactive self-reinforcement learning for social skills) and Lifelong-Sotopia (multi-episode long-term consistency evaluation). AgentSociety(Piao et al., 2025)通过受马斯洛层次结构启发的情感和认知模型，模拟了 10,000 多个智能体，在一体化的城市-社会-经济环境中产生了 500 万次互动。已部署的平台，例如 Moltbooksimulated 10,000+ agents generating 5 million interactions in an integrated urban-social-economic environment with emotion and cognitive modeling inspired by Maslow’s hierarchy. Deployed platforms such as Moltbook111https://www.moltbook.com/提供持久的社交环境，人工智能代理可以在其中自主发布、讨论和形成社区规范，从而弥合模拟社会与现实世界代理社会之间的差距。provide persistent social environments where AI agents autonomously post, discuss, and form community norms, bridging the gap between simulation and real-world agent societies.

新兴的社会现象。Emergent social phenomena.

15 名法学硕士中只有 2 名在公地困境场景中实现可持续合作Only 2 of 15 LLMs achieve sustainable cooperation in commons dilemma scenarios(Piatti et al., 2024)，并且跨代 LLM 代理的合作演变被证明强烈依赖于模型, and cooperation evolution across generations of LLM agents proves strongly model-dependent(Vallinder and Hughes, 2025)。然而规范和惯例确实出现了：. Yet norms and conventions do emerge:Ren et al. (2024)记录法学硕士社团的规范形成，以及document norm formation in LLM societies, andAshery et al. (2025)找到具有临界质量临界点的社会惯例，其中集体偏见出现在群体层面，而个体代理人不存在。熔炉find social conventions with critical mass tipping points, where collective biases appear at the group level that do not exist in individual agents. Melting Pot(Leibo et al., 2021)提供 50 多个涵盖合作、竞争、欺骗和协调的基础，用于系统评估此类动态。角色扮演系统，例如 RoleLLMprovides 50+ substrates covering cooperation, competition, deception, and coordination for systematic evaluation of such dynamics. Role-playing systems such as RoleLLM(Wang et al., 2024i), 性格法学硕士, CharacterLLM(Shao et al., 2023)、和聊天春日, and ChatHaruhi(Li et al., 2023a)通过角色微调和基于内存的维护来探测字符一致性。probe character-consistency through persona fine-tuning and memory-based maintenance.Shanahan et al. (2023)认为法学硕士通过分布表征维持人物情境的隐式世界模型。 《狼人》和《阿瓦隆》是欺骗和信任的集中试验台：《阿瓦隆》综合调查argue that LLMs maintain implicit world models of character situations through distributional representations. Werewolf and Avalon serve as concentrated testbeds for deception and trust: comprehensive Avalon investigation(Lan et al., 2024)记录紧急领导力和伪装策略，ReCondocumented emergent leadership and camouflage strategies, ReCon(Wang et al., 2024f)引入了用于欺骗处理的递归视角转换，以及叛徒introduced recursive perspective transitions for deception handling, and The Traitors(Curvo, 2025)发现欺骗者总是通过利用诚实参与者的认知局限性而获胜。found that deceivers consistently prevail by exploiting the cognitive limitations of honest participants.

数字孪生社会。Digital twin societies.

S3 (Gao et al., 2023)模拟社交媒体平台上的信息传播、情绪传染和态度极化；扩展版本成功预测了 2024 年美国总统大选结果，证明了对现实世界现象的预测有效性。社会宇宙simulates information propagation, emotion contagion, and attitude polarization on social media platforms; an extended version successfully predicted 2024 US presidential election results, demonstrating predictive validity for real-world phenomena. SocioVerse(Zhang et al., 2025f)针对 1000 万现实世界用户验证社会模拟，从而以前所未有的规模实现选举预测、突发新闻响应和经济调查复制。劝善validates social simulation against a pool of 10 million real-world users, enabling election prediction, breaking-news response, and economic survey replication at unprecedented scale. PersuasionForGood(Wang et al., 2019)将说服建模为社会状态转变过程，跟踪 10 种不同的策略如何改变态度，确定社会动态是个性化的而不是普遍的。modeled persuasion as a social state transition process, tracking how 10 distinct strategies shift attitudes, establishing that social dynamics are personalized rather than universal.

制度化和正式的方法。Institutional and formal approaches.

As Dignum and Dignum (2025)认为，当前基于法学硕士的代理人在没有明确推理结构的情况下表现出行为自主性。 BDI（信念-欲望-意图）架构argue, current LLM-based agents exhibit behavioral autonomy without explicit reasoning structures. The BDI (Belief–Desire–Intention) architecture(Rao and Georgeff, 1995)、规范的多智能体系统, normative multi-agent systems(Boella and van der Torre, 2007)、电子机构, electronic institutions(Esteva et al., 2001)，以及正式的承诺模型, and formal commitment models(Telang et al., 2021)提供缺失的机制：对心理状态、社会义务和机构角色的明确、可检查的表征。元GPTprovide the missing machinery: explicit, inspectable representations of mental states, social obligations, and institutional roles. MetaGPT(Hong et al., 2024)通过标准化操作程序和 ChatDev 对组织知识进行编码encodes organizational knowledge through Standardized Operating Procedures, and ChatDev(Qian et al., 2024)实现了具有沟通幻灭功能的聊天链架构，两者都表明，明确的制度约束优于促进组织一致性的个体代理。战略对话系统进一步测试社会动态：CraigslistBargainimplements chat-chain architectures with communicative dehallucination, both showing that explicit institutional constraints outperform individual agent prompting for organizational coherence. Strategic dialogue systems further test social dynamics: CraigslistBargain(He et al., 2018)与生成脱钩的策略，NegotiationArenadecoupled strategy from generation, NegotiationArena(Bianchi et al., 2024)量化非理性行为，共识游戏quantifies irrational behaviors, the Consensus Game(Jacob et al., 2024)将 LM 解码形式化为均衡搜索，以及博弈论 LLM 框架formalizes LM decoding as equilibrium search, and the Game-theoretic LLM framework(Hua et al., 2024)将逆向归纳纳入代理工作流程中。incorporates backward induction into agent workflows.

C.4 人工智能科学系统AI-for-Science Systems

神经动力学和可解释性。Neural dynamics and interpretability.

迪尼莫DyNeMo(Gohil et al., 2022; Khan et al., 2023)将观察结果映射到潜在网络模式的编码器与捕获其时间演化的记忆模型相结合，形成一个生成动力系统。通过这种结构，DyNeMo 支持未来潜在状态的前向模拟和对外部干预的神经反应的预测combines an encoder mapping observations to latent network modes with a memory model capturing their temporal evolution, forming a generative dynamical system. With this structure, DyNeMo supports forward simulation of future latent states and prediction of neural responses to external interventions(Helfrich et al., 2014; Ngo et al., 2013)通过计算机模拟而不是直接实验。然而，与已建立良好控制法则的物理系统不同，大规模神经活动的动力学在很大程度上仍然未知，这使得主要科学目标转向可解释的机制发现。 DyNeMo 通过学习结构化和可解释的潜在表示来促进这一点，这些潜在表示捕获功能性大脑网络的空间模式，其时间统计数据揭示了更高层次的组织原则，包括网络激活中的结构化循环via in-silico simulation rather than direct experimentation. However, unlike physical systems where governing laws are well established, the dynamics of large-scale neural activity remain largely unknown, shifting the primary scientific objective toward interpretable mechanism discovery. DyNeMo facilitates this by learning structured and interpretable latent representations that capture spatial patterns of functional brain networks, whose temporal statistics reveal higher-level organizational principles including structured cycles in network activations(van Es et al., 2025)。这凸显了科学世界模型的独特作用：不仅模拟已知的动态，而且通过可解释的表示及其统计规律发现状态空间和过渡结构本身。. This highlights a distinct role of scientific world models: not only simulating known dynamics, but discovering the state space and transition structure themselves through interpretable representations and their statistical regularities.

算子学习和分子替代品。Operator learning and molecular surrogates.

神经算子框架The neural operator framework(Kovachki et al., 2023)为学习无限维函数空间之间的映射、建立支撑 FNO、DeepONet 和后续架构的近似理论和误差界限提供了统一的理论基础。皮诺provides a unified theoretical foundation for learning maps between infinite-dimensional function spaces, establishing approximation theory and error bounds that underpin FNO, DeepONet, and subsequent architectures. PINO(Li et al., 2024e)将神经算子架构与基于物理的 PDE 残差损失相结合，实现零样本超分辨率并提高稀疏数据下的泛化能力。 PI-DeepONetcombines the neural operator architecture with physics-informed PDE residual losses, enabling zero-shot super-resolution and improved generalization under sparse data. PI-DeepONet(Goswami et al., 2023)通过基于物理的训练扩展了 DeepONet 框架，将控制 PDE 残差直接嵌入到算子学习目标中。施耐特extends the DeepONet framework with physics-informed training, embedding governing PDE residuals directly into the operator learning objective. SchNet(Schütt et al., 2017)为分子图引入了连续滤波器卷积，无需手工制作特征即可实现量子化学性质的端到端学习，并成为等变 GNN 势的架构先驱。有关分子模拟的 ML 方法的综合处理，包括神经电位、粗粒度模型和生成采样，请参阅introduced continuous-filter convolutions for molecular graphs, enabling end-to-end learning of quantum chemical properties without handcrafted features and serving as the architectural precursor to equivariant GNN potentials. For a comprehensive treatment of ML approaches to molecular simulation, including neural potentials, coarse-grained models, and generative sampling, seeNoé et al. (2020)。玻尔兹曼发生器. Boltzmann Generators(Noé et al., 2019)开创了用于采样分子系统热力学平衡状态的深度生成模型，绕过了传统分子动力学的顺序瓶颈。气候Xpioneered deep generative models for sampling thermodynamic equilibrium states of molecular systems, bypassing the sequential bottleneck of traditional molecular dynamics. ClimaX(Nguyen et al., 2023)引入了天气和气候的基础模型范例，通过自我监督学习对 CMIP6 再分析数据进行预训练，并对预报和气候预测任务进行微调。introduced the foundation-model paradigm for weather and climate, pretraining on CMIP6 reanalysis data with self-supervised learning and fine-tuning to both forecasting and climate projection tasks.

本附录提供了说明性的工作示例，展示了 L3 演化循环如何在每个管辖法律制度中运作。这些是建设性的说明，而不是已部署系统行为的报告。This appendix provides illustrative worked examples showing how the L3 evolution loop operates in each governing-law regime. These are constructive illustrations, not reports of deployed system behavior.

D.1 抓取失败的动力学模型修正Dynamics Model Revision from Grasp Failure

尽管规划者预测会成功，但机器人还是不断地掉落物体。A robot repeatedly drops an object despite the planner predicting success.

  1. 1.

    异常Anomaly：力/扭矩传感器日志和接触时间戳揭示了与预测摩擦力的系统偏差。: force/torque sensor logs and contact timestamps reveal systematic deviation from predicted friction.

  2. 2.

    归因Attribution：动力学模型低估了光滑圆柱形物体的摩擦力。: the dynamics model underestimates friction for smooth cylindrical objects.

  3. 3.

    修订版Revision：更新摩擦力先验；添加预抓取诊断挤压以在线估计摩擦力；使用 5 种材料变体创建回归测试。: update the friction prior; add a pre-grasp diagnostic squeeze to estimate friction online; create a regression test with 5 material variants.

  4. 4.

    验证Validation：在 RoboCasa 上重播: replay across RoboCasa(Nasiriany et al., 2024)确认更新不会降低其他材料类别的任务。tasks to confirm the update does not degrade other material classes.

D.2 服务环境下的策略修正Strategy Revision in a Service Environment

尽管社会世界模型预测折扣可以解决对话，但模拟服务环境中的对话代理始终无法留住威胁要取消的用户。A conversational agent in a simulated service environment consistently fails to retain users who threaten to cancel, despite the societal world model predicting that a discount would resolve the conversation.

  1. 1.

    异常Anomaly：在 50 次取消对话中，折扣优惠只有 20% 的成功率，远低于模型预测的 70% 保留率。: across 50 cancellation dialogues, the discount offer succeeds only 20% of the time, far below the model’s predicted 70% retention rate.

  2. 2.

    归因Attribution：社交模型假设威胁取消的用户对价格敏感，但对话分析显示，大多数人对服务质量而不是价格感到沮丧。该模型的信念归因是系统性错误的。: the social model assumes users who threaten cancellation are price-sensitive, but conversation analysis reveals that most are frustrated by service quality, not price. The model’s belief attribution is systematically wrong.

  3. 3.

    修订版Revision：更新用户意图分类器，以区分对价格敏感的用户和对质量不满意的用户；对于质量不佳的用户，用确认和升级策略取代折扣策略；添加回归测试，确保对价格敏感的用户仍然可以获得折扣。: update the user-intent classifier to distinguish price-sensitive from quality-frustrated users; for quality-frustrated users, replace the discount strategy with an acknowledgment-and-escalation strategy; add a regression test ensuring price-sensitive users still receive discounts.

  4. 4.

    验证Validation：在接下来的 100 次取消交互中对修订后的策略进行 A/B 测试，测量保留率、用户满意度以及修订是否引入了新的故障模式（例如，对真正价格敏感的用户进行不必要的升级）。: A/B test the revised strategy on the next 100 cancellation interactions, measuring retention rate, user satisfaction, and whether the revision introduces new failure modes (e.g., unnecessary escalations for genuinely price-sensitive users).

D.3 安装失败产生可重用技能Installation Failure Producing Reusable Skill

代理运行“安装依赖项”，遇到错误，然后重试，但没有结果。An agent runs “install dependencies,” encounters an error, and retries fruitlessly.

  1. 1.

    异常Anomaly：错误代码和权限状态揭示了: error codes and permission status reveal a许可被拒绝permission denied故障等级。failure class.

  2. 2.

    归因Attribution：权限不足，不是拼写错误或网络错误。: insufficient privileges, not a typo or network error.

  3. 3.

    修订版Revision：创建技能模板（关于权限错误：检查权限: create a skill template (on permission errors: check privileges→\rightarrow选择替代安装路径choose alternative install path→\rightarrow重新验证），加上受限权限环境中的回归测试。re-verify), plus a regression test in a restricted-permission environment.

  4. 4.

    验证Validation：跨 OSWorld 和 macOSWorld 变体重播: replay across OSWorld and macOSWorld variants(Xie et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2025a)确认提取的技能转移超出了原始失败案例。to confirm that the extracted skill transfers beyond the original failure case.

D.4 闭环材料发现Closed-Loop Materials Discovery

贝叶斯代理预测了特定的晶相，但合成产生了意想不到的混合相。A Bayesian surrogate predicts a specific crystal phase, but synthesis yields an unexpected mixed phase.

  1. 1.

    异常Anomaly： XRD 衍射图与预测的单相输出存在偏差。: XRD diffraction pattern deviates from the predicted single-phase output.

  2. 2.

    归因Attribution：替代方案低估了合成温度对相稳定性的影响。: the surrogate underweights the effect of synthesis temperature on phase stability.

  3. 3.

    修订版Revision：用新数据点更新贝叶斯模型；扩展假设空间以包括温度相关的相边界；设计一个中间温度下的后续实验。: update the Bayesian model with the new data point; expand the hypothesis space to include temperature-dependent phase boundaries; design a follow-up experiment at an intermediate temperature.

  4. 4.

    验证Validation：下一个合成证实了修改后的预测，并且校准改进了保留的成分: the next synthesis confirms the revised prediction, and calibration improves on held-out compositions(Kusne et al., 2020; Szymanski et al., 2023).

E.1 长视距相干性Long-Horizon Coherence

长视野一致性询问预测是否组合Long-horizon coherence asks whether composed predictionsp^​(τ∣z0,a1:H,c)\hat{p}(\tau\mid z_{0},a_{1:H},c)保持可用作为推出范围remain usable as the rollout horizonHH成长。签名失败是grows. The signature failure is复合误差compounding error：每步的小偏差会随着时间的推移而放大，将想象的轨迹推入无法到达的分支（第: small per-step deviations amplify over time, pushing imagined trajectories into unreachable branches (Section4.3，故障模式 1)。次要故障是, failure mode 1). A secondary failure is状态别名state aliasing（失败模式 2），不同的真实状态崩溃为相似的表示，导致部署悄然偏离现实。(failure mode 2), where distinct real states collapse into similar representations, causing the rollout to silently diverge from reality.

在操作上，一致性是通过跟踪与任务相关的指标作为范围的函数来测量的。对于物理操作，RoboCasaOperationally, coherence is measured by tracking a task-relevant metric as a function of horizon. For physical manipulation, RoboCasa(Nasiriany et al., 2024)和ManiSkill3and ManiSkill3(Tao et al., 2024)提供多步骤任务，其中成功率会随着时间的推移而降低；退化曲线本身就是诊断。 SWE-长凳offer multi-step tasks where success rate degrades predictably with horizon; the degradation curve itself is the diagnostic. SWE-bench(Jimenez et al., 2024)对代码提出了类似的挑战：多文件解析率揭示了模型是否在跨文件中保持一致的代码库状态poses an analogous challenge for code: multi-file resolution rate reveals whether the model maintains a coherent codebase state acrosskk相互依赖的编辑步骤。社交环境引入了一种不同的漂移风格。索托皮亚interdependent editing steps. Social settings introduce a different flavour of drift. Sotopia(Zhou et al., 2024c)跟踪承诺、联盟和关系变量在多轮交互中是否保持稳定，而不是默默地侵蚀。科学推理需要另一种形式的连贯性：在《科学世界》中tracks whether commitments, alliances, and relational variables remain stable across multi-turn interactions rather than silently eroding. Scientific reasoning demands another form of coherence: in ScienceWorld(Wang et al., 2022)，实验室操作的顺序必须保持因果顺序（例如，在测量温度之前而不是之后加热物质）。, sequences of lab actions must preserve causal ordering (e.g., heating a substance before measuring its temperature, not after).

当前实践中的一个重大差距是，大多数基准测试报告固定范围内的成功率，而没有退化曲线：系统是在范围内进行测试的A significant gap in current practice is that most benchmarks report fixed-horizon success rates without degradation curves: a system is tested at horizonHH但性能与性能之间的关系but the relationship between performance andHH没有特征。长视频理解技术，例如选择性检索和推理远处片段的时间搜索方法is not characterized. Techniques from long-form video understanding, such as temporal search methods that selectively retrieve and reason over distant segments(Ye et al., 2025)，提出了大规模诊断一致性的有希望的方向。开放世界环境提供了最强大的现有长期一致性测试，正是因为它们需要跨越数百个步骤的技能组合。 Minecraft 任务（通过 MCU, suggest a promising direction for diagnosing coherence at scale. Open-world environments provide the strongest existing tests of long-horizon coherence precisely because they demand skill composition across hundreds of steps. Minecraft tasks (via MCU(Zheng et al., 2025c)或航行者号or Voyager(Wang et al., 2024b)）需要按顺序收集资源、制作工具和导航地形，这些操作可能超过一千个。工匠) require gathering resources, crafting tools, and navigating terrain in sequences that can exceed a thousand actions. Crafter(Stanić et al., 2023)将类似的构图需求压缩到更受控制的设置中，而 NetHackcompresses similar compositional demands into a more controlled setting, while NetHack(Kurenkov et al., 2023)增加了程序生成和符号复杂性。在基于模型的强化学习中，MBPO 式水平截断adds procedural generation and symbolic complexity. In model-based RL, MBPO-style horizon truncation(Janner et al., 2019)通过将推出长度限制在模型保持准确的范围内，隐式承认一致性限制，但这种自适应截断本身很少被评估为一致性度量。implicitly acknowledges coherence limits by restricting rollout length to a range where the model remains accurate, but this adaptive truncation is rarely evaluated as a coherence metric in its own right.

E.2 干预敏感性Intervention Sensitivity

干预敏感性询问推出是否对行动序列的变化做出有意义的响应Intervention sensitivity asks whether the rollout responds meaningfully to changes in the action sequencea1:Ha_{1:H}或初始条件or the initial conditionz0z_{0}。即使每个单独的帧在感知上都是真实的，无论采取什么行动都会产生相同轨迹的模型对于规划来说是无用的。这个直接测试. A model that produces the same trajectory regardless of the action taken is useless for planning, even if each individual frame is perceptually realistic. This directly tests可控性controllability（节(Section4.3，故障模式 3), failure mode 3)(Wu et al., 2024c; Brooks et al., 2024).

核心协议是The core protocol is反事实分歧测试counterfactual divergence testing: 来自同一个: from the samez0z_{0},执行两个动作序列, execute two action sequencesa1:Ha_{1:H}和anda1:H′a^{\prime}_{1:H}一步不同，并测量结果轨迹是否一致that differ at a single step, and measure whether the resulting trajectoriesτ\tau和andτ′\tau^{\prime}以与任务相关的方式发散。两个互补的指标反映了这一点：diverge in a task-relevant way. Two complementary metrics capture this: the动作灵敏度比action sensitivity ratio（产生可检测的结果变化的行动扰动的分数）和(fraction of action perturbations that produce a detectable outcome change) and the反事实结果分歧counterfactual outcome divergence（任务相关变量之间的差异大小(magnitude of difference in task-relevant variables betweenτ\tau和andτ′\tau^{\prime}，通过动作变化幅度标准化）。在操作系统世界中, normalized by the action change magnitude). In OSWorld(Xie et al., 2024)，这对应于注入弹出中断或网络故障并测试代理是否重新计划而不是盲目点击。在 RoboCasa 中，它对应于扰动对象放置并验证操作策略是否适应。在 Sotopia 中，它相当于改变一个智能体的开局动作并检查谈判结果是否相应变化。, this corresponds to injecting pop-up interruptions or network failures and testing whether the agent replans rather than clicking blindly. In RoboCasa, it corresponds to perturbing object placement and verifying that the manipulation strategy adapts. In Sotopia, it corresponds to changing one agent’s opening move and checking whether the negotiation outcome shifts accordingly.

在当前的评估实践中，干预敏感性受到的关注明显少于其他两个边界条件。大多数基准衡量输出质量（成功率、感知保真度），但没有明确测试模型预测是否随操作适当变化。缩小这一差距需要评估协议明确改变行动并衡量产出质量之外的结果差异。In current evaluation practice, intervention sensitivity receives markedly less attention than the other two boundary conditions. Most benchmarks measure output quality (success rate, perceptual fidelity) but do not explicitly test whether model predictions change appropriately with actions. Closing this gap requires evaluation protocols that explicitly vary actions and measure outcome divergence beyond output quality.

E.3 约束一致性Constraint Consistency

约束一致性询问推出是否尊重管辖法律Constraint consistency asks whether rollouts respect the governing lawsc​(τ)c(\tau)目标制度（第of the target regime (Section4.1，条件 3)。因为, condition 3). Becausec​(τ)c(\tau)取决于整个轨迹，违规行为通常对于每步指标来说是不可见的，但对于规划来说却是灾难性的。此条件也是主要表面depends on entire trajectory, violations are often invisible to per-step metrics but catastrophic for planning. This condition is also the primary surface for可利用性exploitability（故障模式 4）(failure mode 4)(Xie et al., 2024; Zheng et al., 2025c)和and分布偏移下的校准失败calibration failure under distribution shift（故障模式 5）。(failure mode 5).

验证方法因适用法律而异。对于物理学来说，关键信号是穿透深度、违反能量守恒定律和支撑关系一致性； VBBenchVerification methods vary with the governing law. For physics, the key signals are penetration depth, energy conservation violation, and support-relation consistency; VBench(Huang et al., 2024d)将视频生成质量分解为细粒度的物理合规性检查，而 BuilderBenchdecomposes video generation quality into fine-grained physical compliance checks, while BuilderBench(Ghugare et al., 2025)测试物理负载下的结构稳定性。软件环境前台收据匹配率、类型约束满意度以及 API 合同遵守情况（与 OSWorld 和 macOSWorld）tests structural stability under physical load. Software environments foreground receipt match rate, type-constraint satisfaction, and API contract adherence, with OSWorld and macOSWorld(Yang et al., 2025a)提供可记录的收据流。通过 Sotopia 的七维框架评估，社会模拟提高了规范违规检测率、承诺一致性和心理理论准确性providing loggable receipt streams. Social simulation raises norm violation detection rate, commitment consistency, and Theory of Mind accuracy, assessed through Sotopia’s seven-dimensional framework(Zhou et al., 2024c)和 ExploreToM 的对抗性探测and ExploreToM’s adversarial probing(Sclar et al., 2024)。科学领域使用守恒定律满足、因果图一致性和证据链有效性；发现台. Scientific domains use conservation law satisfaction, causal graph consistency, and evidence-chain validity; DiscoveryBench(Majumder et al., 2025)和未来Xand FutureX(Zeng et al., 2025)测试证据接地。移动和跨平台环境（AppAgenttest evidence grounding. Mobile and cross-platform environments (AppAgent(Zhang et al., 2025a), 安卓世界, AndroidWorld(Rawles et al., 2025)）扩展数字世界约束测试，而 AgentBench) extend digital-world constraint testing, while AgentBench(Liu et al., 2024a)提供跨域广度。化学乌鸦provides cross-domain breadth. ChemCrow(Bran et al., 2024)在严格的有效性约束下评估化学合成，其中一次违规就会导致整个计划无效。evaluates chemical synthesis under strict validity constraints where a single violation renders the entire plan invalid.

E.4 世界模型特定评估World-Model-Specific Evaluation

世界模拟平台WorldSimBench(Qin et al., 2024)引入了对用作世界模拟器的视频生成模型的双重评估（感知质量和操纵能力），揭示了感知现实性和动作条件保真度可能存在巨大差异。世界模特台introduces a dual evaluation (perceptual quality and manipulative capability) for video generation models used as world simulators, revealing that perceptual realism and action-conditioned fidelity can diverge sharply. WorldModelBench(Li et al., 2025a)跨越 7 个域、56 个子域和 350 个提示以及 67K 个人工标签，在所有测试的 14 个前沿模型中发现了广泛的约束一致性差距。spans 7 domains, 56 subdomains, and 350 prompts with 67K human labels, finding widespread constraint consistency gaps across all 14 frontier models tested.Vafa et al. (2024)应用 Myhill-Nerode 定理表明，通过每步测试并不能保证长期一致性：模型可以保持高度不连贯的内部世界状态，同时在标准诊断上表现良好。apply the Myhill-Nerode theorem to show that passing per-step tests does not guarantee long-horizon coherence: models can maintain highly incoherent internal world states while performing well on standard diagnostics.Kang et al. (2025a)发现视频生成模型执行“基于案例”的模仿，而不是学习可概括的物理原理，即使是在规模上也是如此。find that video generation models perform “case-based” mimicry rather than learning generalizable physical principles, even at scale.

E.5 能力覆盖矩阵Capability Coverage Matrix

没有一个基准能够涵盖所有三个边界条件和四个管辖法律制度；研究人员应该明确地将他们选择的评估套件映射到这些轴上，以避免过度概括。No single benchmark covers all three boundary conditions and four governing-law regimes; researchers should explicitly map their chosen evaluation suites to these axes to avoid over-claiming generalization.

E.6 最小可重复评估包 (MREP)Minimal Reproducible Evaluation Package (MREP)

代理评估缺乏标准化导致结果不可比和“排行榜黑客”The lack of standardization in agent evaluation leads to non-comparable results and “leaderboard hacking”(Henderson et al., 2018)。我们建议将 MREP 作为社区标准：. We propose the MREP as a community standard:

  1. 1.

    版本锁定：Version Locking:环境和任务集定义的精确提交哈希。Exact commit hashes for the environment and task set definition.

  2. 2.

    跟踪日志：Trace Logs:中间步骤的完整日志，包括观察、操作和收据，足以重放并事后归因故障。Full logs of intermediate steps, including observations, actions, and receipts, sufficient to replay and attribute failures post hoc.

  3. 3.

    失败分类：Failure Taxonomy:自动分类与我们的五个 L2 故障类别一致。Automated classification aligned with our five L2 failure categories.

  4. 4.

    尾部统计：Tail Statistics:分层引导置信区间、IQM 和性能概况，而不是点估计Stratified bootstrap confidence intervals, IQM, and performance profiles rather than point estimates(Agarwal et al., 2021).

  5. 5.

    边界条件映射：Boundary Condition Mapping:明确声明测试的边界条件。Explicit declaration of the boundary conditions tested.

多个 MREP 组件已经具有工具支持（通过 LangSmith/W&B Weave 进行跟踪记录；通过容器化进行版本锁定；每个Several MREP components already have tooling support (trace logging via LangSmith/W&B Weave; version locking via containerization; tail statistics perAgarwal et al. 2021）。需要新基础设施的组件是自动故障分类和边界条件映射。 MREP 框架直接连接到 L3 控制的验证（第 1 节）). The components requiring new infrastructure are automated failure taxonomy and boundary condition mapping. The MREP framework connects directly to L3 governed validation (Section5.1）：MREP 所需的评估资产正是 L3 看门人决定是否应升级或回滚模型更新所需的资产。): the evaluation assets MREP requires are precisely what an L3 gatekeeper needs to decide whether a model update should be promoted or rolled back.

F.1 实际实施注意事项Practical Implementation Considerations

培训范例：端到端与模块化。Training paradigms: end-to-end vs. modular.

存在两种主导策略。在Two dominant strategies exist. In端到端end-to-end训练时，编码器、动态模型、解码器和策略通过 ELBO 或价值感知损失等共享目标进行联合优化。梦想家家族training, the encoder, dynamics model, decoder, and policy are optimized jointly through a shared objective such as the ELBO or a value-aware loss. The Dreamer family(Hafner et al., 2020; 2021; 2025)举例说明了这一点：所有组件共享梯度，并且策略完全根据想象的潜在推出进行训练。在exemplifies this: all components share gradients, and the policy trains entirely on imagined latent rollouts. In模块化modular训练，每个组件都根据自己的目标进行训练：通过自我监督学习表示training, each component is trained with its own objective: representation via self-supervised learning(Assran et al., 2023; Bardes et al., 2024)，通过最大似然或 TD 目标进行动态, dynamics via maximum likelihood or TD objectives(Hansen et al., 2024)，以及通过无模型强化学习或规划制定的政策。 StarVLA等模块化开发框架, and policy via model-free RL or planning. Modular development frameworks such as StarVLA(Community, 2026)提供可组合的代码库以进行系统的消融和重组。端到端避免了不稳定时的跨模块错误传播；模块化系统更容易调试，但存在接口不匹配的风险。provide composable codebases for systematic ablation and recombination. End-to-end avoids cross-module error propagation while unstable; modular systems are easier to debug but risk mismatched interfaces.

延迟、计算和 O(1) 参数。Latency, compute, and the O(1) argument.

动态模型的选择受到延迟预算的严格限制。机器人控制循环通常需要 100 毫秒以下的推理，有利于短时间推出的轻量级潜在动态The choice of dynamics model is tightly constrained by the latency budget. Robotics control loops typically require sub-100 ms inference, favoring lightweight latent dynamics with short-horizon rollouts(Hansen et al., 2024; Chua et al., 2018)。 Web 和操作系统代理可以容忍秒级延迟，从而允许更丰富的搜索和收据解析。高保真生成模型. Web and OS agents tolerate seconds-scale latency, allowing richer search and receipt parsing. High-fidelity generative models(Brooks et al., 2024)每次部署可能需要几分钟的时间，从而将其限制为离线规划或数据增强。may take minutes per rollout, restricting them to offline planning or data augmentation.

一个基本的计算论点是学习世界模型吸引力的基础：神经前向传递运行在A fundamental computational argument underlies the appeal of learned world models: a neural forward pass runs inO​(1)O(1)时间相对于模拟系统的复杂性而言，而显式模拟的尺度为time with respect to the complexity of the simulated system, whereas explicit simulation scales asO​(N)O(N)或者更糟。这个or worse. ThisO​(1)O(1)在分析模拟难以处理的情况下，属性使学习的世界模型变得可行。然而，常数因素很重要：property makes learned world models viable where analytic simulation is intractable. However, the constant factor matters: theO​(1)O(1)大扩散模型的前向传递可能仍然比forward pass of a large diffusion model may still be slower than theO​(N)O(N)轻量级物理引擎的通行证pass of a lightweight physics engine for modestNN.

世界模型缩放法则也不同于 LLM 缩放法则。语言模型必须记住大量的事实知识；世界模型主要需要捕捉过渡结构。这种过滤和组织作用表明了一种不同的计算最优机制，其中架构归纳偏差可以比语言建模更有效地替代原始参数计数。World-model scaling laws also differ from LLM scaling laws. Language models must memorize vast factual knowledge; world models primarily need to capture transition structure. This filtering-and-organizing role suggests a different compute-optimality regime where architectural inductive biases may substitute for raw parameter count more effectively than in language modeling.

模拟到真实的传输。Sim-to-real transfer.

对于实体系统来说，训练模拟器和部署之间的差距是一个持续存在的瓶颈。域随机化For embodied systems, the gap between the training simulator and deployment is a persistent bottleneck. Domain randomization(Tobin et al., 2017)仍被广泛使用。补充策略包括系统识别、渐进迁移以及将学习到的残差动力学与分析物理模型相结合的混合方法remains widely used. Complementary strategies include system identification, progressive transfer, and hybrid approaches combining learned residual dynamics with analytic physics models(Nagabandi et al., 2018)。白日梦想家. DayDreamer(Wu et al., 2023a)证明了梦想家式的潜在想象力可以通过在线收集的真实传感器数据进行训练来转移到物理机器人上，以较慢的数据收集速度为代价避开了模拟与真实的差距。demonstrated that Dreamer-style latent imagination can transfer to physical robots by training on real sensor data collected online, sidestepping the sim-to-real gap at the cost of slower data collection.

错误处理和优雅降级。Error handling and graceful degradation.

当预测变得不可靠时，成熟的世界模型系统必须优雅地降级。 MBPOA mature world-model system must degrade gracefully when predictions become unreliable. MBPO(Janner et al., 2019)将推出长度限制在准确的范围内，在更长的范围内回退到真实数据。乐团分歧limits rollout length to the accurate regime, falling back to real data for longer horizons. Ensemble disagreement(Chua et al., 2018)提供触发重新计划或升级的实用信号。在软件环境中，收据解析起着类似的作用：意外的错误代码表明假设可能被违反provides a practical signal for triggering replanning or escalation. In software environments, receipt parsing serves an analogous role: unexpected error codes signal that assumptions may be violated(Xie et al., 2024).

F.2 生成动力学的少步蒸馏Few-Step Distillation for Generative Dynamics

由扩散和流匹配框架驱动的生成模拟系统本质上受到迭代去噪延迟的限制。最初的努力依赖于免训练的高阶 ODE 求解器Generative simulation systems driven by diffusion and flow-matching frameworks are inherently constrained by iterative denoising latency. Initial efforts relied on training-free, high-order ODE solvers(Dockhorn et al., 2022; Karras et al., 2022; Lu et al., 2022; 2025a; Sabour et al., 2024; Zhang and Chen, 2023; Zheng et al., 2023)，但这些都达不到实时代理所要求的低步预算。, but these fall short of the low-step budgets demanded by real-time agents.

该领域已转向少步蒸馏。早期策略侧重于通过匹配大步幅过渡来压缩教师模型轨迹The field has pivoted toward few-step distillation. Early strategies focused on compressing teacher model trajectories by matching long-stride transitions(Lipman et al., 2023; Salimans and Ho, 2022)。这种范式演变成一致性模型. This paradigm evolved into Consistency Models(Geng et al., 2025b; Lu and Song, 2025; Song and Dhariwal, 2024; Song et al., 2023b)，它通过学习从噪声到干净数据的直接 PF-ODE 映射来规避迭代采样。流程图模型进一步概括了这个概念, which circumvent iterative sampling by learning a direct PF-ODE mapping from noise to clean data. Flow-map models further generalize this concept(Boffi et al., 2025; Frans et al., 2025; Heek et al., 2024; Kim et al., 2024a; Wang et al., 2024a)。 TiM 等大规模预培训计划. Large-scale pre-training initiatives like TiM(Wang et al., 2025f)和平均流量and MeanFlow(Geng et al., 2025a)已经推进了这种方法。分布匹配蒸馏have advanced this approach. Distribution-matching distillation(Salimans et al., 2024; Sauer et al., 2024b; a; Yin et al., 2024a; Zhou et al., 2024a; Yu et al., 2025b)已成为一种替代方案，使学生的产出与教师的目标分布保持一致。has emerged as an alternative, aligning student output with teacher target distributions.

随着世界模型越来越依赖视频生成，视频采样成本的提高促使加速技术适应时空域As world models increasingly rely on video generation, the higher sampling costs of video have catalyzed adaptation of acceleration techniques to the spatiotemporal domain(Ding et al., 2025b; Lin et al., 2025d; Zhang et al., 2024b; Zheng et al., 2025b; Nie et al., 2026; Yang et al., 2025b)。这些效率提升将生成模型从离线模拟器转变为用于实时规划的可行引擎。. These efficiency gains transform generative models from offline simulators into viable engines for real-time planning.

F.3 模型压缩：量化和剪枝Model Compression: Quantization and Pruning

量化将高精度权重映射为较低位格式（例如 INT/FP-8、INT/FP-4），从而减少内存带宽限制。修剪删除冗余参数或结构块。对于世界建模，主要的挑战是减轻复合错误：即使是很小的量化噪声或修剪引起的退化也可能导致长期严重的语义漂移。Quantization maps high-precision weights into lower-bit formats (e.g., INT/FP-8, INT/FP-4), reducing memory bandwidth constraints. Pruning removes redundant parameters or structural blocks. For world modeling, the primary challenge is mitigating compounding errors: even minor quantization noise or pruning-induced degradation can lead to severe semantic drift over long horizons.

基础训练后量化技术Foundational post-training quantization techniques(Frantar et al., 2023; Lin et al., 2024; Huang et al., 2026c; 2024b; Dettmers et al., 2022; Huang et al., 2024a)专为 LLM 设计，但适用于 LLM 变压器和 DiT。挤压LLMwere designed for LLMs but are applicable to both LLM transformers and DiTs. SqueezeLLM(Kim et al., 2024b)将基于灵敏度的非均匀量化与密集和稀疏分解相结合，以实现超低精度。在服务端，高效的内存管理同样重要：vLLMcombines sensitivity-based non-uniform quantization with dense-and-sparse decomposition for ultra-low precision. On the serving side, efficient memory management is equally critical: vLLM(Kwon et al., 2023)引入了 PagedAttention，它以类似于操作系统虚拟内存的方式管理非连续块中的 KV 缓存内存，从而显着提高了大型模型推理的吞吐量。对于扩散模型，QAT 方法如 QDMintroduced PagedAttention, which manages KV cache memory in non-contiguous blocks analogous to OS virtual memory, dramatically improving throughput for large-model inference. For diffusion models, QAT methods like QDM(Li et al., 2023c)和特迪特and TerDiT(Lu et al., 2024b)保持 1-2 位精度的性能，但需要大量的训练开销。基于 UNet 的扩散模型的 PTQ 方法包括 QDiffusionmaintain performance at 1-2 bit precision but require substantial training overhead. PTQ approaches for UNet-based diffusion models include QDiffusion(Li et al., 2023b), PTQ4DM (Shang et al., 2023)、高效DM, and EfficientDM(He et al., 2023)。对于变压器骨干，Q-DiT. For transformer backbones, Q-DiT(Chen et al., 2025b), PTQ4DiT (Wu et al., 2024b), SVD 定量, SVDQuant(Li et al., 2024b)和 ViDiTQ, and ViDiTQ(Zhao et al., 2024)通过注意力感知校准来解释扩散变压器的独特激活分布。account for the unique activation distributions of diffusion transformers through attention-aware calibration.

网络修剪包括非结构化方法Network pruning includes unstructured approaches(Dong et al., 2017; Park et al., 2020; Sanh et al., 2020; Lee et al., 2019)和结构化修剪and structured pruning(Ding et al., 2019; Liu et al., 2021)。代币合并. Token merging(Bolya and Hoffman, 2023; Bolya et al., 2023)提供免培训的替代方案。对于世界模型，rollout-aware 剪枝是一个有前途的前沿：剪枝标准必须保留对长范围一致性至关重要的参数，与第 2 节中定义的时间一致性的 L2 边界条件保持一致provides training-free alternatives. For world models, rollout-aware pruning is a promising frontier: pruning criteria must preserve the parameters that are critical for long-horizon coherence, aligning with the L2 boundary condition of temporal consistency defined in Section4.1.

F.4 内存和KV缓存压缩Memory and KV Cache Compression

随着 KV 缓存线性增长，自回归令牌动态在长期部署期间会受到严重的内存限制。主要压缩策略包括：Autoregressive token dynamics are severely memory-bound during long-horizon rollouts as the KV cache grows linearly. Key compression strategies include:

  1. 1.

    令牌驱逐：Token eviction:重击者保留heavy-hitter retention(Zhang et al., 2023b)和注意力池保存and attention-sink preservation(Xiao et al., 2024)丢弃低显着性条目以限制缓存大小。discard low-salience entries to bound cache size.

  2. 2.

    块级自回归生成：Chunk-level autoregressive generation:现代视频模型以块的形式生成modern video models generate in chunks(Yin et al., 2024b; Huang et al., 2025c; Feng et al., 2025b)，尽管硬件限制通常将输出限制为, though hardware constraints often limit output to∼60{\sim}60秒。seconds.

  3. 3.

    KV量化：KV quantization:KIVI 等方案schemes such as KIVI(Liu et al., 2024b), KVQuant (Hooper et al., 2024), 夸罗特, QuaRot(Ashkboos et al., 2024)、旋转KV, and RotateKV(Su et al., 2025b)对于LLM服务来说已经很成熟，但是由于不同的激活统计数据，将它们移植到视频扩散会导致严重的质量损失。are mature for LLM serving, but porting them to video diffusion causes severe quality loss due to different activation statistics.

  4. 4.

    时空感知压缩：Spatiotemporal-aware compression:有效的视频 KV 压缩需要明确利用视频特定时空冗余的框架effective video KV compression requires frameworks that explicitly leverage video-specific spatiotemporal redundancy(Yang et al., 2025c).
